 175 |     |     TokenConfig memory config = getTokenConfigByCToken(cToken);

 222 |     |   function pokeFailedOverPrice(bytes32 symbolHash) public {

 224 |     |     require(priceData.failoverActive, "Failover must be active");
 225 |     |     TokenConfig memory config = getTokenConfigBySymbolHash(symbolHash);
 226 |     |     uint anchorPrice = calculateAnchorPriceFromEthPrice(config);
 227 |     |     require(anchorPrice < 2 ** 248, "Anchor price too large");
 228 |     |     prices[config.symbolHash].price = uint248(anchorPrice);
 229 |     |     emit PriceUpdated(config.symbolHash, anchorPrice);
 230 |     |   }

 232 |     |   /**
 233 |     |    * @notice Calculate the anchor price by fetching price data from the TWAP
 234 |     |    * @param config TokenConfig
 235 |     |    * @return anchorPrice uint
 236 |     |    */
 237 |     |   function calculateAnchorPriceFromEthPrice(
 238 |     |     TokenConfig memory config
 239 |     |   ) internal returns (uint anchorPrice) {
 240 |     |     uint ethPrice = fetchEthAnchorPrice();
 241 |     |     require(
 242 |     |       config.priceSource == PriceSource.REPORTER,
 243 |     |       "only reporter prices get posted"
 244 |     |     );
 245 |     |     if (config.symbolHash == ethHash) {
 246 |     |       anchorPrice = ethPrice;
 247 |     |     } else {
 248 |     |       anchorPrice = fetchAnchorPrice(config.symbolHash, config, ethPrice);
 249 |     |     }
 250 |     |   }

 252 |     |   /**
 253 |     |    * @notice Convert the reported price to the 6 decimal format that this view requires
 254 |     |    * @param config TokenConfig
 255 |     |    * @param reportedPrice from the reporter
 256 |     |    * @return convertedPrice uint256
 257 |     |    */
 258 |     |   function convertReportedPrice(
 259 |     |     TokenConfig memory config,
 260 |     |     int256 reportedPrice
 261 |     |   ) internal pure returns (uint256) {
 262 |     |     require(reportedPrice >= 0, "Reported price cannot be negative");
 263 |     |     uint256 unsignedPrice = uint256(reportedPrice);
 264 |     |     uint256 convertedPrice = mul(unsignedPrice, config.reporterMultiplier) /
 265 |     |       config.baseUnit;
 266 |     |     return convertedPrice;
 267 |     |   }

 269 |     |   function isWithinAnchor(
 270 |     |     uint reporterPrice,
 271 |     |     uint anchorPrice
 272 |     |   ) internal view returns (bool) {
 273 |     |     if (reporterPrice > 0) {
 274 |     |       uint anchorRatio = mul(anchorPrice, 100e16) / reporterPrice;
 275 |     |       return
 276 |     |         anchorRatio <= upperBoundAnchorRatio &&
 277 |     |         anchorRatio >= lowerBoundAnchorRatio;
 278 |     |     }
 279 |     |     return false;
 280 |     |   }

 282 |     |   /**
 283 |     |    * @dev Fetches the current token/eth price accumulator from uniswap.
 284 |     |    */
 285 |     |   function currentCumulativePrice(
 286 |     |     TokenConfig memory config
 287 |     |   ) internal view returns (uint) {
 288 |     |     (uint cumulativePrice0, uint cumulativePrice1, ) = UniswapV2OracleLibrary
 289 |     |       .currentCumulativePrices(config.uniswapMarket);
 290 |     |     if (config.isUniswapReversed) {
 291 |     |       return cumulativePrice1;
 292 |     |     } else {
 293 |     |       return cumulativePrice0;
 294 |     |     }
 295 |     |   }

 297 |     |   /**
 298 |     |    * @dev Fetches the current eth/usd price from uniswap, with 6 decimals of precision.
 299 |     |    *  Conversion factor is 1e18 for eth/usdc market, since we decode uniswap price statically with 18 decimals.
 300 |     |    */
 301 |     |   function fetchEthAnchorPrice() internal returns (uint) {
 302 |     |     return
 303 |     |       fetchAnchorPrice(
 304 |     |         ethHash,
 305 |     |         getTokenConfigBySymbolHash(ethHash),
 306 |     |         ethBaseUnit
 307 |     |       );
 308 |     |   }
 309 |     | 
 310 |     |   /**
 311 |     |    * @dev Fetches the current token/usd price from uniswap, with 6 decimals of precision.
 312 |     |    * @param conversionFactor 1e18 if seeking the ETH price, and a 6 decimal ETH-USDC price in the case of other assets
 313 |     |    */
 314 |     |   function fetchAnchorPrice(
 315 |     |     bytes32 symbolHash,
 316 |     |     TokenConfig memory config,
 317 |     |     uint conversionFactor
 318 |     |   ) internal virtual returns (uint) {
 319 |     |     (
 320 |     |       uint nowCumulativePrice,
 321 |     |       uint oldCumulativePrice,
 322 |     |       uint oldTimestamp
 323 |     |     ) = pokeWindowValues(config);
 324 |     | 
 325 |     |     // This should be impossible, but better safe than sorry
 326 |     |     require(block.timestamp > oldTimestamp, "now must come after before");
 327 |     |     uint timeElapsed = block.timestamp - oldTimestamp;
 328 |     | 
 329 |     |     // Calculate uniswap time-weighted average price
 330 |     |     // Underflow is a property of the accumulators: https://uniswap.org/audit.html#orgc9b3190
 331 |     |     FixedPoint.uq112x112 memory priceAverage = FixedPoint.uq112x112(
 332 |     |       uint224((nowCumulativePrice - oldCumulativePrice) / timeElapsed)
 333 |     |     );
 334 |     |     uint rawUniswapPriceMantissa = priceAverage.decode112with18();
 335 |     |     uint unscaledPriceMantissa = mul(rawUniswapPriceMantissa, conversionFactor);
 336 |     |     uint anchorPrice;
 337 |     | 
 338 |     |     // Adjust rawUniswapPrice according to the units of the non-ETH asset
 339 |     |     // In the case of ETH, we would have to scale by 1e6 / USDC_UNITS, but since baseUnit2 is 1e6 (USDC), it cancels
 340 |     | 
 341 |     |     // In the case of non-ETH tokens
 342 |     |     // a. pokeWindowValues already handled uniswap reversed cases, so priceAverage will always be Token/ETH TWAP price.
 343 |     |     // b. conversionFactor = ETH price * 1e6
 344 |     |     // unscaledPriceMantissa = priceAverage(token/ETH TWAP price) * expScale * conversionFactor
 345 |     |     // so ->
 346 |     |     // anchorPrice = priceAverage * tokenBaseUnit / ethBaseUnit * ETH_price * 1e6
 347 |     |     //             = priceAverage * conversionFactor * tokenBaseUnit / ethBaseUnit
 348 |     |     //             = unscaledPriceMantissa / expScale * tokenBaseUnit / ethBaseUnit
 349 |     |     anchorPrice =
 350 |     |       mul(unscaledPriceMantissa, config.baseUnit) /
 351 |     |       ethBaseUnit /
 352 |     |       expScale;
 353 |     | 
 354 |     |     emit AnchorPriceUpdated(
 355 |     |       symbolHash,
 356 |     |       anchorPrice,
 357 |     |       oldTimestamp,
 358 |     |       block.timestamp
 359 |     |     );
 360 |     | 
 361 |     |     return anchorPrice;
 362 |     |   }
 363 |     | 
 364 |     |   /**
 365 |     |    * @dev Get time-weighted average prices for a token at the current timestamp.
 366 |     |    *  Update new and old observations of lagging window if period elapsed.
 367 |     |    */
 368 |     |   function pokeWindowValues(
 369 |     |     TokenConfig memory config
 370 |     |   ) internal returns (uint, uint, uint) {
 371 |     |     bytes32 symbolHash = config.symbolHash;
 372 |     |     uint cumulativePrice = currentCumulativePrice(config);
 373 |     | 
 374 |     |     Observation memory newObservation = newObservations[symbolHash];
 375 |     | 
 376 |     |     // Update new and old observations if elapsed time is greater than or equal to anchor period
 377 |     |     uint timeElapsed = block.timestamp - newObservation.timestamp;
 378 |     |     if (timeElapsed >= anchorPeriod) {
 379 |     |       oldObservations[symbolHash].timestamp = newObservation.timestamp;
 380 |     |       oldObservations[symbolHash].acc = newObservation.acc;
 381 |     | 
 382 |     |       newObservations[symbolHash].timestamp = block.timestamp;
 383 |     |       newObservations[symbolHash].acc = cumulativePrice;
 384 |     |       emit UniswapWindowUpdated(
 385 |     |         config.symbolHash,
 386 |     |         newObservation.timestamp,
 387 |     |         block.timestamp,
 388 |     |         newObservation.acc,
 389 |     |         cumulativePrice
 390 |     |       );
 391 |     |     }
 392 |     |     return (
 393 |     |       cumulativePrice,
 394 |     |       oldObservations[symbolHash].acc,
 395 |     |       oldObservations[symbolHash].timestamp
 396 |     |     );
 397 |     |   }
 398 |     | 
 399 |     |   /**
 400 |     |    * @notice Activate failover, and fall back to using failover directly.
 401 |     |    * @dev Only the owner can call this function
 402 |     |    */
 403 |     |   function activateFailover(bytes32 symbolHash) external onlyOwner {
 404 |     |     require(!prices[symbolHash].failoverActive, "Already activated");
 405 |     |     prices[symbolHash].failoverActive = true;
 406 |     |     emit FailoverActivated(symbolHash);
 407 |     |     pokeFailedOverPrice(symbolHash);
 408 |     |   }
 409 |     | 
 410 |     |   /**
 411 |     |    * @notice Deactivate a previously activated failover
 412 |     |    * @dev Only the owner can call this function
 413 |     |    */
 414 |     |   function deactivateFailover(bytes32 symbolHash) external onlyOwner {
 415 |     |     require(prices[symbolHash].failoverActive, "Already deactivated");
 416 |     |     prices[symbolHash].failoverActive = false;
 417 |     |     emit FailoverDeactivated(symbolHash);
 418 |     |   }
 419 |     | 
 420 |     |   /// @dev Overflow proof multiplication
 421 |     |   function mul(uint a, uint b) internal pure returns (uint) {
 422 |     |     if (a == 0) return 0;
 423 |     |     uint c = a * b;
 424 |     |     require(c / a == b, "multiplication overflow");
 425 |     |     return c;
 426 |     |   }

  5 |     | // Based on code from https://github.com/Uniswap/uniswap-v2-periphery
  6 |     | 
  7 |     | // a library for handling binary fixed point numbers (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Q_(number_format))
  8 |     | library FixedPoint {
  9 |     |   // range: [0, 2**112 - 1]
 10 |     |   // resolution: 1 / 2**112
 11 |     |   struct uq112x112 {
 12 |     |     uint224 _x;
 13 |     |   }
 14 |     | 
 15 |     |   // returns a uq112x112 which represents the ratio of the numerator to the denominator
 16 |     |   // equivalent to encode(numerator).div(denominator)
 17 |     |   function fraction(
 18 |     |     uint112 numerator,
 19 |     |     uint112 denominator
 20 |     |   ) internal pure returns (uq112x112 memory) {
 21 |     |     require(denominator > 0, "FixedPoint: DIV_BY_ZERO");
 22 |     |     return uq112x112((uint224(numerator) << 112) / denominator);
 23 |     |   }
 24 |     | 
 25 |     |   // decode a uq112x112 into a uint with 18 decimals of precision
 26 |     |   function decode112with18(uq112x112 memory self) internal pure returns (uint) {
 27 |     |     // we only have 256 - 224 = 32 bits to spare, so scaling up by ~60 bits is dangerous
 28 |     |     // instead, get close to:
 29 |     |     //  (x * 1e18) >> 112
 30 |     |     // without risk of overflowing, e.g.:
 31 |     |     //  (x) / 2 ** (112 - lg(1e18))
 32 |     |     return uint(self._x) / 5192296858534827;
 33 |     |   }
 34 |     | }
 35 |     | 
 36 |     | // library with helper methods for oracles that are concerned with computing average prices
 37 |     | library UniswapV2OracleLibrary {
 38 |     |   using FixedPoint for *;
 39 |     | 
 40 |     |   // helper function that returns the current block timestamp within the range of uint32, i.e. [0, 2**32 - 1]
 41 |     |   function currentBlockTimestamp() internal view returns (uint32) {
 42 |     |     return uint32(block.timestamp % 2 ** 32);
 43 |     |   }
 44 |     | 
 45 |     |   // produces the cumulative price using counterfactuals to save gas and avoid a call to sync.
 46 |     |   function currentCumulativePrices(
 47 |     |     address pair
 48 |     |   )
 49 |     |     internal
 50 |     |     view
 51 |     |     returns (
 52 |     |       uint price0Cumulative,
 53 |     |       uint price1Cumulative,
 54 |     |       uint32 blockTimestamp
 55 |     |     )
 56 |     |   {
 57 |     |     blockTimestamp = currentBlockTimestamp();
 58 |     |     price0Cumulative = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).price0CumulativeLast();
 59 |     |     price1Cumulative = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).price1CumulativeLast();
 60 |     | 
 61 |     |     // if time has elapsed since the last update on the pair, mock the accumulated price values
 62 |     |     (
 63 |     |       uint112 reserve0,
 64 |     |       uint112 reserve1,
 65 |     |       uint32 blockTimestampLast
 66 |     |     ) = IUniswapV2Pair(pair).getReserves();
 67 |     |     if (blockTimestampLast != blockTimestamp) {
 68 |     |       // subtraction overflow is desired
 69 |     |       uint32 timeElapsed = blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast;
 70 |     |       // addition overflow is desired
 71 |     |       // counterfactual
 72 |     |       price0Cumulative +=
 73 |     |         uint(FixedPoint.fraction(reserve1, reserve0)._x) *
 74 |     |         timeElapsed;
 75 |     |       // counterfactual
 76 |     |       price1Cumulative +=
 77 |     |         uint(FixedPoint.fraction(reserve0, reserve1)._x) *
 78 |     |         timeElapsed;
 79 |     |     }
 80 |     |   }
 81 |     | }
 82 |     |

   3 |     | // From https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts/blob/master/contracts/math/Math.sol
   4 |     | // Subject to the MIT license.
   5 |     | 
   6 |     | /**
   7 |     |  * @dev Wrappers over Solidity's arithmetic operations with added overflow
   8 |     |  * checks.
   9 |     |  *
  10 |     |  * Arithmetic operations in Solidity wrap on overflow. This can easily result
  11 |     |  * in bugs, because programmers usually assume that an overflow raises an
  12 |     |  * error, which is the standard behavior in high level programming languages.
  13 |     |  * `SafeMath` restores this intuition by reverting the transaction when an
  14 |     |  * operation overflows.
  15 |     |  *
  16 |     |  * Using this library instead of the unchecked operations eliminates an entire
  17 |     |  * class of bugs, so it's recommended to use it always.
  18 |     |  */
  19 |     | library SafeMath {
  20 |     |   /**
  21 |     |    * @dev Returns the addition of two unsigned integers, reverting on overflow.
  22 |     |    *
  23 |     |    * Counterpart to Solidity's `+` operator.
  24 |     |    *
  25 |     |    * Requirements:
  26 |     |    * - Addition cannot overflow.
  27 |     |    */
  28 |     |   function add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
  29 |     |     uint256 c = a + b;
  30 |     |     require(c >= a, "SafeMath: addition overflow");
  31 |     | 
  32 |     |     return c;
  33 |     |   }
  34 |     | 
  35 | *   |   /**
  36 |     |    * @dev Returns the addition of two unsigned integers, reverting with custom message on overflow.
  37 |     |    *
  38 |     |    * Counterpart to Solidity's `+` operator.
  39 |     |    *
  40 | *   |    * Requirements:
  41 | *   |    * - Addition cannot overflow.
  42 |     |    */
  43 |     |   function add(
  44 |     |     uint256 a,
  45 |     |     uint256 b,
  46 |     |     string memory errorMessage
  47 |     |   ) internal pure returns (uint256) {
  48 |     |     uint256 c = a + b;
  49 |     |     require(c >= a, errorMessage);
  50 |     | 
  51 |     |     return c;
  52 |     |   }
  53 |     |

  56 |     |    *
  57 |     |    * Counterpart to Solidity's `-` operator.

  59 |     |    * Requirements:
  60 |     |    * - Subtraction cannot underflow.

  91 |     |    * - Multiplication cannot overflow.

  93 |     |   function mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
  94 |     |     // Gas optimization: this is cheaper than requiring 'a' not being zero, but the
  95 |     |     // benefit is lost if 'b' is also tested.
  96 |     |     // See: https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts/pull/522

  98 |     |       return 0;

 102 |     |     require(c / a == b, "SafeMath: multiplication overflow");
 103 |     |

 118 |     |     require(
 119 |     |       comp.getPriorVotes(msg.sender, sub256(block.number, 1)) >
 120 |     |         proposalThreshold ||
 121 |     |         isWhitelisted(msg.sender),
 122 |     |       "GovernorBravo::propose: proposer votes below proposal threshold"
 123 |     |     );
 124 |     |     require(
 125 |     |       targets.length == values.length &&
 126 |     |         targets.length == signatures.length &&
 127 |     |         targets.length == calldatas.length,
 128 |     |       "GovernorBravo::propose: proposal function information arity mismatch"
 129 |     |     );
 130 |     |     require(
 131 |     |       targets.length != 0,
 132 |     |       "GovernorBravo::propose: must provide actions"
 133 |     |     );
 134 |     |     require(
 135 |     |       targets.length <= proposalMaxOperations,
 136 |     |       "GovernorBravo::propose: too many actions"
 137 |     |     );
 138 |     | 
 139 |     |     uint latestProposalId = latestProposalIds[msg.sender];
 140 |     |     if (latestProposalId != 0) {
 141 |     |       ProposalState proposersLatestProposalState = state(latestProposalId);
 142 |     |       require(
 143 |     |         proposersLatestProposalState != ProposalState.Active,
 144 |     |         "GovernorBravo::propose: one live proposal per proposer, found an already active proposal"
 145 |     |       );
 146 |     |       require(
 147 |     |         proposersLatestProposalState != ProposalState.Pending,
 148 |     |         "GovernorBravo::propose: one live proposal per proposer, found an already pending proposal"
 149 |     |       );
 150 |     |     }
 151 |     | 
 152 |     |     uint startBlock = add256(block.number, votingDelay);
 153 |     |     uint endBlock = add256(startBlock, votingPeriod);
 154 |     | 
 155 |     |     proposalCount++;
 156 |     |     Proposal memory newProposal = Proposal({
 157 |     |       id: proposalCount,
 158 |     |       proposer: msg.sender,
 159 |     |       eta: 0,
 160 |     |       targets: targets,
 161 |     |       values: values,
 162 |     |       signatures: signatures,
 163 |     |       calldatas: calldatas,
 164 |     |       startBlock: startBlock,
 165 |     |       endBlock: endBlock,
 166 |     |       forVotes: 0,
 167 |     |       againstVotes: 0,
 168 |     |       abstainVotes: 0,
 169 |     |       canceled: false,
 170 |     |       executed: false
 171 |     |     });
 172 |     | 
 173 |     |     proposals[newProposal.id] = newProposal;
 174 |     |     latestProposalIds[newProposal.proposer] = newProposal.id;
 175 |     | 
 176 |     |     emit ProposalCreated(
 177 |     |       newProposal.id,
 178 |     |       msg.sender,
 179 |     |       targets,
 180 |     |       values,
 181 |     |       signatures,
 182 |     |       calldatas,
 183 |     |       startBlock,
 184 |     |       endBlock,
 185 |     |       description
 186 |     |     );
 187 |     |     return newProposal.id;
 188 |     |   }
 189 |     | 
 190 |     |   /**
 191 |     |    * @notice Queues a proposal of state succeeded
 192 |     |    * @param proposalId The id of the proposal to queue
 193 |     |    */
 194 |     |   function queue(uint proposalId) external {
 195 |     |     require(
 196 |     |       state(proposalId) == ProposalState.Succeeded,
 197 |     |       "GovernorBravo::queue: proposal can only be queued if it is succeeded"
 198 |     |     );
 199 |     |     Proposal storage proposal = proposals[proposalId];
 200 |     |     uint eta = add256(block.timestamp, timelock.delay());
 201 |     |     for (uint i = 0; i < proposal.targets.length; i++) {
 202 |     |       queueOrRevertInternal(
 203 |     |         proposal.targets[i],
 204 |     |         proposal.values[i],
 205 |     |         proposal.signatures[i],
 206 |     |         proposal.calldatas[i],
 207 |     |         eta
 208 |     |       );
 209 |     |     }
 210 |     |     proposal.eta = eta;
 211 |     |     emit ProposalQueued(proposalId, eta);
 212 |     |   }

 214 |     |   function queueOrRevertInternal(
 215 |     |     address target,
 216 |     |     uint value,
 217 |     |     string memory signature,
 218 |     |     bytes memory data,
 219 |     |     uint eta
 220 |     |   ) internal {
 221 |     |     require(
 222 |     |       !timelock.queuedTransactions(
 223 |     |         keccak256(abi.encode(target, value, signature, data, eta))
 224 |     |       ),
 225 |     |       "GovernorBravo::queueOrRevertInternal: identical proposal action already queued at eta"
 226 |     |     );
 227 |     |     timelock.queueTransaction(target, value, signature, data, eta);
 228 |     |   }

 230 |     |   /**
 231 |     |    * @notice Executes a queued proposal if eta has passed
 232 |     |    * @param proposalId The id of the proposal to execute
 233 |     |    */
 234 |     |   function execute(uint proposalId) external {
 235 |     |     require(
 236 |     |       state(proposalId) == ProposalState.Queued,
 237 |     |       "GovernorBravo::execute: proposal can only be executed if it is queued"
 238 |     |     );
 239 |     |     Proposal storage proposal = proposals[proposalId];
 240 |     |     proposal.executed = true;
 241 |     |     for (uint i = 0; i < proposal.targets.length; i++) {
 242 |     |       timelock.executeTransaction(
 243 |     |         proposal.targets[i],
 244 |     |         proposal.values[i],
 245 |     |         proposal.signatures[i],
 246 |     |         proposal.calldatas[i],
 247 |     |         proposal.eta
 248 |     |       );
 249 |     |     }
 250 |     |     emit ProposalExecuted(proposalId);
 251 |     |   }

 253 |     |   /**
 254 |     |    * @notice Cancels a proposal only if sender is the proposer, or proposer delegates dropped below proposal threshold
 255 |     |    * @param proposalId The id of the proposal to cancel
 256 |     |    */
 257 |     |   function cancel(uint proposalId) external {
 258 |     |     require(
 259 |     |       state(proposalId) != ProposalState.Executed,
 260 |     |       "GovernorBravo::cancel: cannot cancel executed proposal"
 261 |     |     );
 262 |     | 
 263 |     |     Proposal storage proposal = proposals[proposalId];
 264 |     | 
 265 |     |     // Proposer can cancel
 266 |     |     if (msg.sender != proposal.proposer) {
 267 |     |       // Whitelisted proposers can't be canceled for falling below proposal threshold
 268 |     |       if (isWhitelisted(proposal.proposer)) {
 269 |     |         require(
 270 |     |           (comp.getPriorVotes(proposal.proposer, sub256(block.number, 1)) <
 271 |     |             proposalThreshold) && msg.sender == whitelistGuardian,
 272 |     |           "GovernorBravo::cancel: whitelisted proposer"
 273 |     |         );
 274 |     |       } else {
 275 |     |         require(
 276 |     |           (comp.getPriorVotes(proposal.proposer, sub256(block.number, 1)) <
 277 |     |             proposalThreshold),
 278 |     |           "GovernorBravo::cancel: proposer above threshold"
 279 |     |         );
 280 |     |       }
 281 |     |     }
 282 |     | 
 283 |     |     proposal.canceled = true;
 284 |     |     for (uint i = 0; i < proposal.targets.length; i++) {
 285 |     |       timelock.cancelTransaction(
 286 |     |         proposal.targets[i],
 287 |     |         proposal.values[i],
 288 |     |         proposal.signatures[i],
 289 |     |         proposal.calldatas[i],
 290 |     |         proposal.eta
 291 |     |       );
 292 |     |     }
 293 |     | 
 294 |     |     emit ProposalCanceled(proposalId);
 295 |     |   }

 302 |     |   function getActions(

 318 |     |   /**
 319 |     |    * @notice Gets the receipt for a voter on a given proposal
 320 |     |    * @param proposalId the id of proposal
 321 |     |    * @param voter The address of the voter
 322 |     |    * @return The voting receipt
 323 |     |    */
 324 |     |   function getReceipt(
 325 |     |     uint proposalId,
 326 |     |     address voter

 331 |     |   /**
 332 |     |    * @notice Gets the state of a proposal
 333 |     |    * @param proposalId The id of the proposal
 334 |     |    * @return Proposal state
 335 |     |    */
 336 |     |   function state(uint proposalId) public view returns (ProposalState) {
 337 |     |     require(
 338 |     |       proposalCount >= proposalId && proposalId > initialProposalId,
 339 |     |       "GovernorBravo::state: invalid proposal id"
 340 |     |     );
 341 |     |     Proposal storage proposal = proposals[proposalId];
 342 |     |     if (proposal.canceled) {
 343 |     |       return ProposalState.Canceled;
 344 |     |     } else if (block.number <= proposal.startBlock) {
 345 |     |       return ProposalState.Pending;
 346 |     |     } else if (block.number <= proposal.endBlock) {
 347 |     |       return ProposalState.Active;
 348 |     |     } else if (
 349 |     |       proposal.forVotes <= proposal.againstVotes ||
 350 |     |       proposal.forVotes < quorumVotes
 351 |     |     ) {
 352 |     |       return ProposalState.Defeated;
 353 |     |     } else if (proposal.eta == 0) {
 354 |     |       return ProposalState.Succeeded;
 355 |     |     } else if (proposal.executed) {
 356 |     |       return ProposalState.Executed;
 357 |     |     } else if (
 358 |     |       block.timestamp >= add256(proposal.eta, timelock.GRACE_PERIOD())
 359 |     |     ) {
 360 |     |       return ProposalState.Expired;
 361 |     |     } else {
 362 |     |       return ProposalState.Queued;
 363 |     |     }
 364 |     |   }

 366 |     |   /**
 367 |     |    * @notice Cast a vote for a proposal
 368 |     |    * @param proposalId The id of the proposal to vote on
 369 |     |    * @param support The support value for the vote. 0=against, 1=for, 2=abstain
 370 |     |    */

 374 |     |       proposalId,

 378 |     |     );
 379 |     |   }

 401 |     |   /**
 402 |     |    * @notice Cast a vote for a proposal by signature
 403 |     |    * @dev External function that accepts EIP-712 signatures for voting on proposals.
 404 |     |    */
 405 |     |   function castVoteBySig(
 406 |     |     uint proposalId,
 407 |     |     uint8 support,
 408 |     |     uint8 v,
 409 |     |     bytes32 r,
 410 |     |     bytes32 s
 411 |     |   ) external {
 412 |     |     bytes32 domainSeparator = keccak256(
 413 |     |       abi.encode(
 414 |     |         DOMAIN_TYPEHASH,
 415 |     |         keccak256(bytes(name)),
 416 |     |         getChainIdInternal(),
 417 |     |         address(this)
 418 |     |       )
 419 |     |     );
 420 |     |     bytes32 structHash = keccak256(
 421 |     |       abi.encode(BALLOT_TYPEHASH, proposalId, support)
 422 |     |     );
 423 |     |     bytes32 digest = keccak256(
 424 |     |       abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", domainSeparator, structHash)
 425 |     |     );
 426 |     |     address signatory = ecrecover(digest, v, r, s);
 427 |     |     require(
 428 |     |       signatory != address(0),
 429 |     |       "GovernorBravo::castVoteBySig: invalid signature"
 430 |     |     );
 431 |     |     emit VoteCast(
 432 |     |       signatory,
 433 |     |       proposalId,
 434 |     |       support,
 435 |     |       castVoteInternal(signatory, proposalId, support),
 436 |     |       ""
 437 |     |     );
 438 |     |   }
 439 |     | 
 440 |     |   /**
 441 |     |    * @notice Internal function that caries out voting logic
 442 |     |    * @param voter The voter that is casting their vote
 443 |     |    * @param proposalId The id of the proposal to vote on
 444 |     |    * @param support The support value for the vote. 0=against, 1=for, 2=abstain
 445 |     |    * @return The number of votes cast
 446 |     |    */
 447 |     |   function castVoteInternal(
 448 |     |     address voter,
 449 |     |     uint proposalId,
 450 |     |     uint8 support
 451 |     |   ) internal returns (uint96) {
 452 |     |     require(
 453 |     |       state(proposalId) == ProposalState.Active,
 454 |     |       "GovernorBravo::castVoteInternal: voting is closed"
 455 |     |     );
 456 |     |     require(support <= 2, "GovernorBravo::castVoteInternal: invalid vote type");
 457 |     |     Proposal storage proposal = proposals[proposalId];
 458 |     |     Receipt storage receipt = proposal.receipts[voter];
 459 |     |     require(
 460 |     |       receipt.hasVoted == false,
 461 |     |       "GovernorBravo::castVoteInternal: voter already voted"
 462 |     |     );
 463 |     |     uint96 votes = comp.getPriorVotes(voter, proposal.startBlock);
 464 |     | 
 465 |     |     if (support == 0) {
 466 |     |       proposal.againstVotes = add256(proposal.againstVotes, votes);
 467 |     |     } else if (support == 1) {
 468 |     |       proposal.forVotes = add256(proposal.forVotes, votes);
 469 |     |     } else if (support == 2) {
 470 |     |       proposal.abstainVotes = add256(proposal.abstainVotes, votes);
 471 |     |     }
 472 |     | 
 473 |     |     receipt.hasVoted = true;
 474 |     |     receipt.support = support;
 475 |     |     receipt.votes = votes;
 476 |     | 
 477 |     |     return votes;
 478 |     |   }

 484 |     |    */
 485 |     |   function isWhitelisted(address account) public view returns (bool) {
 486 |     |     return (whitelistAccountExpirations[account] > now);

 577 |     |    * @notice Initiate the GovernorBravo contract
 578 |     |    * @dev Admin only. Sets initial proposal id which initiates the contract, ensuring a continuous proposal id count
 579 |     |    * @param governorAlpha The address for the Governor to continue the proposal id count from
 580 |     |    */
 581 |     |   function _initiate(address governorAlpha) external {
 582 |     |     require(msg.sender == admin, "GovernorBravo::_initiate: admin only");
 583 |     |     require(
 584 |     |       initialProposalId == 0,
 585 |     |       "GovernorBravo::_initiate: can only initiate once"

 592 |     |   /**
 593 |     |    * @notice Begins transfer of admin rights. The newPendingAdmin must call `_acceptAdmin` to finalize the transfer.
 594 |     |    * @dev Admin function to begin change of admin. The newPendingAdmin must call `_acceptAdmin` to finalize the transfer.
 595 |     |    * @param newPendingAdmin New pending admin.
 596 |     |    */
 597 |     |   function _setPendingAdmin(address newPendingAdmin) external {
 598 |     |     // Check caller = admin
 599 |     |     require(msg.sender == admin, "GovernorBravo:_setPendingAdmin: admin only");
 600 |     | 
 601 |     |     // Save current value, if any, for inclusion in log
 602 |     |     address oldPendingAdmin = pendingAdmin;
 603 |     | 
 604 |     |     // Store pendingAdmin with value newPendingAdmin
 605 |     |     pendingAdmin = newPendingAdmin;
 606 |     | 
 607 |     |     // Emit NewPendingAdmin(oldPendingAdmin, newPendingAdmin)
 608 |     |     emit NewPendingAdmin(oldPendingAdmin, newPendingAdmin);
 609 |     |   }
 610 |     | 
 611 |     |   /**
 612 |     |    * @notice Accepts transfer of admin rights. msg.sender must be pendingAdmin
 613 |     |    * @dev Admin function for pending admin to accept role and update admin
 614 |     |    */
 615 |     |   function _acceptAdmin() external {
 616 |     |     // Check caller is pendingAdmin and pendingAdmin ≠ address(0)
 617 |     |     require(
 618 |     |       msg.sender == pendingAdmin && msg.sender != address(0),
 619 |     |       "GovernorBravo:_acceptAdmin: pending admin only"
 620 |     |     );
 621 |     | 
 622 |     |     // Save current values for inclusion in log
 623 |     |     address oldAdmin = admin;
 624 |     |     address oldPendingAdmin = pendingAdmin;
 625 |     | 
 626 |     |     // Store admin with value pendingAdmin
 627 |     |     admin = pendingAdmin;
 628 |     | 
 629 |     |     // Clear the pending value
 630 |     |     pendingAdmin = address(0);
 631 |     | 
 632 |     |     emit NewAdmin(oldAdmin, admin);
 633 |     |     emit NewPendingAdmin(oldPendingAdmin, pendingAdmin);
 634 |     |   }

 636 |     |   function add256(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint) {
 637 |     |     uint c = a + b;
 638 |     |     require(c >= a, "addition overflow");
 639 |     |     return c;
 640 |     |   }
 641 |     | 
 642 |     |   function sub256(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint) {
 643 |     |     require(b <= a, "subtraction underflow");
 644 |     |     return a - b;
 645 |     |   }
 646 |     | 
 647 |     |   function getChainIdInternal() internal pure returns (uint) {
 648 |     |     uint chainId;
 649 |     |     assembly {
 650 |     |       chainId := chainid()
 651 |     |     }
 652 |     |     return chainId;
 653 |     |   }

  13 |     | /**
  14 |     |  * @dev Wrappers over Solidity's arithmetic operations with added overflow
  15 |     |  * checks.
  16 |     |  *
  17 |     |  * Arithmetic operations in Solidity wrap on overflow. This can easily result
  18 |     |  * in bugs, because programmers usually assume that an overflow raises an
  19 |     |  * error, which is the standard behavior in high level programming languages.
  20 |     |  * `SafeMath` restores this intuition by reverting the transaction when an
  21 |     |  * operation overflows.
  22 |     |  *
  23 |     |  * Using this library instead of the unchecked operations eliminates an entire
  24 |     |  * class of bugs, so it's recommended to use it always.
  25 |     |  */
  26 |     | library SafeMath {
  27 |     |   /**
  28 |     |    * @dev Returns the addition of two unsigned integers, reverting on
  29 |     |    * overflow.
  30 |     |    *
  31 |     |    * Counterpart to Solidity's `+` operator.
  32 |     |    *
  33 |     |    * Requirements:
  34 |     |    * - Addition cannot overflow.
  35 |     |    */
  36 |     |   function add(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
  37 |     |     uint256 c = a + b;
  38 |     |     require(c >= a, "SafeMath: addition overflow");
  39 |     | 
  40 |     |     return c;
  41 |     |   }
  42 |     | 
  43 |     |   /**
  44 |     |    * @dev Returns the subtraction of two unsigned integers, reverting on
  45 |     |    * overflow (when the result is negative).
  46 |     |    *
  47 |     |    * Counterpart to Solidity's `-` operator.
  48 |     |    *
  49 |     |    * Requirements:
  50 |     |    * - Subtraction cannot overflow.
  51 |     |    */
  52 |     |   function sub(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
  53 |     |     return sub(a, b, "SafeMath: subtraction overflow");
  54 |     |   }
  55 |     | 
  56 |     |   /**
  57 |     |    * @dev Returns the subtraction of two unsigned integers, reverting with custom message on
  58 |     |    * overflow (when the result is negative).
  59 |     |    *
  60 |     |    * Counterpart to Solidity's `-` operator.
  61 |     |    *
  62 |     |    * Requirements:
  63 |     |    * - Subtraction cannot overflow.
  64 |     |    *
  65 |     |    * NOTE: This is a feature of the next version of OpenZeppelin Contracts.
  66 |     |    * @dev Get it via `npm install @openzeppelin/contracts@next`.
  67 |     |    */
  68 |     |   function sub(
  69 |     |     uint256 a,
  70 |     |     uint256 b,
  71 |     |     string memory errorMessage
  72 |     |   ) internal pure returns (uint256) {
  73 |     |     require(b <= a, errorMessage);
  74 |     |     uint256 c = a - b;
  75 |     | 
  76 |     |     return c;
  77 |     |   }
  78 |     | 
  79 |     |   /**
  80 |     |    * @dev Returns the multiplication of two unsigned integers, reverting on
  81 |     |    * overflow.
  82 |     |    *
  83 |     |    * Counterpart to Solidity's `*` operator.
  84 |     |    *
  85 |     |    * Requirements:
  86 |     |    * - Multiplication cannot overflow.
  87 |     |    */
  88 |     |   function mul(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
  89 |     |     // Gas optimization: this is cheaper than requiring 'a' not being zero, but the
  90 |     |     // benefit is lost if 'b' is also tested.
  91 |     |     // See: https://github.com/OpenZeppelin/openzeppelin-contracts/pull/522
  92 |     |     if (a == 0) {
  93 |     |       return 0;
  94 |     |     }
  95 |     | 
  96 |     |     uint256 c = a * b;
  97 |     |     require(c / a == b, "SafeMath: multiplication overflow");
  98 |     | 
  99 |     |     return c;
 100 |     |   }
 101 |     | 
 102 |     |   /**
 103 |     |    * @dev Returns the integer division of two unsigned integers. Reverts on
 104 |     |    * division by zero. The result is rounded towards zero.
 105 |     |    *
 106 |     |    * Counterpart to Solidity's `/` operator. Note: this function uses a
 107 |     |    * `revert` opcode (which leaves remaining gas untouched) while Solidity
 108 |     |    * uses an invalid opcode to revert (consuming all remaining gas).
 109 |     |    *
 110 |     |    * Requirements:
 111 |     |    * - The divisor cannot be zero.
 112 |     |    */
 113 |     |   function div(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
 114 |     |     return div(a, b, "SafeMath: division by zero");
 115 |     |   }
 116 |     | 
 117 |     |   /**
 118 |     |    * @dev Returns the integer division of two unsigned integers. Reverts with custom message on
 119 |     |    * division by zero. The result is rounded towards zero.
 120 |     |    *
 121 |     |    * Counterpart to Solidity's `/` operator. Note: this function uses a
 122 |     |    * `revert` opcode (which leaves remaining gas untouched) while Solidity
 123 |     |    * uses an invalid opcode to revert (consuming all remaining gas).
 124 |     |    *
 125 |     |    * Requirements:
 126 |     |    * - The divisor cannot be zero.
 127 |     |    * NOTE: This is a feature of the next version of OpenZeppelin Contracts.
 128 |     |    * @dev Get it via `npm install @openzeppelin/contracts@next`.
 129 |     |    */
 130 |     |   function div(
 131 |     |     uint256 a,
 132 |     |     uint256 b,
 133 |     |     string memory errorMessage
 134 |     |   ) internal pure returns (uint256) {
 135 |     |     // Solidity only automatically asserts when dividing by 0
 136 |     |     require(b > 0, errorMessage);
 137 |     |     uint256 c = a / b;
 138 |     |     // assert(a == b * c + a % b); // There is no case in which this doesn't hold
 139 |     | 
 140 |     |     return c;
 141 |     |   }
 142 |     | 
 143 |     |   /**
 144 |     |    * @dev Returns the remainder of dividing two unsigned integers. (unsigned integer modulo),
 145 |     |    * Reverts when dividing by zero.
 146 |     |    *
 147 |     |    * Counterpart to Solidity's `%` operator. This function uses a `revert`
 148 |     |    * opcode (which leaves remaining gas untouched) while Solidity uses an
 149 |     |    * invalid opcode to revert (consuming all remaining gas).
 150 |     |    *
 151 |     |    * Requirements:
 152 |     |    * - The divisor cannot be zero.
 153 |     |    */
 154 |     |   function mod(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal pure returns (uint256) {
 155 |     |     return mod(a, b, "SafeMath: modulo by zero");
 156 |     |   }
 157 |     | 
 158 |     |   /**
 159 |     |    * @dev Returns the remainder of dividing two unsigned integers. (unsigned integer modulo),
 160 |     |    * Reverts with custom message when dividing by zero.
 161 |     |    *
 162 |     |    * Counterpart to Solidity's `%` operator. This function uses a `revert`
 163 |     |    * opcode (which leaves remaining gas untouched) while Solidity uses an
 164 |     |    * invalid opcode to revert (consuming all remaining gas).
 165 |     |    *
 166 |     |    * Requirements:
 167 |     |    * - The divisor cannot be zero.
 168 |     |    *
 169 |     |    * NOTE: This is a feature of the next version of OpenZeppelin Contracts.
 170 |     |    * @dev Get it via `npm install @openzeppelin/contracts@next`.
 171 |     |    */
 172 |     |   function mod(
 173 |     |     uint256 a,
 174 |     |     uint256 b,
 175 |     |     string memory errorMessage
 176 |     |   ) internal pure returns (uint256) {
 177 |     |     require(b != 0, errorMessage);
 178 |     |     return a % b;
 179 |     |   }

 282 |     |   function queueTransaction(
 283 |     |     address target,
 284 |     |     uint value,
 285 |     |     string memory signature,
 286 |     |     bytes memory data,
 287 |     |     uint eta
 288 |     |   ) public returns (bytes32) {
 289 |     |     require(

 291 |     |       "Timelock::queueTransaction: Call must come from admin."
 292 |     |     );

 294 |     |       eta >= getBlockTimestamp().add(delay),
 295 |     |       "Timelock::queueTransaction: Estimated execution block must satisfy delay."
 296 |     |     );

 305 |     |   function cancelTransaction(
 306 |     |     address target,
 307 |     |     uint value,
 308 |     |     string memory signature,
 309 |     |     bytes memory data,
 310 |     |     uint eta
 311 |     |   ) public {
 312 |     |     require(
 313 |     |       msg.sender == admin,
 314 |     |       "Timelock::cancelTransaction: Call must come from admin."
 315 |     |     );
 316 |     | 
 317 |     |     bytes32 txHash = keccak256(abi.encode(target, value, signature, data, eta));
 318 |     |     queuedTransactions[txHash] = false;
 319 |     | 
 320 |     |     emit CancelTransaction(txHash, target, value, signature, data, eta);

 323 |     |   function executeTransaction(
 324 |     |     address target,
 325 |     |     uint value,
 326 |     |     string memory signature,
 327 |     |     bytes memory data,
 328 |     |     uint eta
 329 |     |   ) public payable returns (bytes memory) {
 330 |     |     require(
 331 |     |       msg.sender == admin,
 332 |     |       "Timelock::executeTransaction: Call must come from admin."
 333 |     |     );
 334 |     | 
 335 |     |     bytes32 txHash = keccak256(abi.encode(target, value, signature, data, eta));
 336 |     |     require(
 337 |     |       queuedTransactions[txHash],
 338 |     |       "Timelock::executeTransaction: Transaction hasn't been queued."
 339 |     |     );
 340 |     |     require(
 341 |     |       getBlockTimestamp() >= eta,
 342 |     |       "Timelock::executeTransaction: Transaction hasn't surpassed time lock."
 343 |     |     );
 344 |     |     require(
 345 |     |       getBlockTimestamp() <= eta.add(GRACE_PERIOD),
 346 |     |       "Timelock::executeTransaction: Transaction is stale."
 347 |     |     );
 348 |     | 
 349 |     |     queuedTransactions[txHash] = false;
 350 |     | 
 351 |     |     bytes memory callData;
 352 |     | 
 353 |     |     if (bytes(signature).length == 0) {
 354 |     |       callData = data;
 355 |     |     } else {
 356 |     |       callData = abi.encodePacked(bytes4(keccak256(bytes(signature))), data);
 357 |     |     }
 358 |     | 
 359 |     |     // solium-disable-next-line security/no-call-value
 360 |     |     (bool success, bytes memory returnData) = target.call.value(value)(
 361 |     |       callData
 362 |     |     );
 363 |     |     require(
 364 |     |       success,
 365 |     |       "Timelock::executeTransaction: Transaction execution reverted."
 366 |     |     );
 367 |     | 
 368 |     |     emit ExecuteTransaction(txHash, target, value, signature, data, eta);
 369 |     | 
 370 |     |     return returnData;
 371 |     |   }
 372 |     | 
 373 |     |   function getBlockTimestamp() internal view returns (uint) {
 374 |     |     // solium-disable-next-line security/no-block-members
 375 |     |     return block.timestamp;
 376 |     |   }

  4 |     |  * @title Careful Math

  9 |     | contract CarefulMath {
 10 |     |   /**
 11 |     |    * @dev Possible error codes that we can return
 12 |     |    */
 13 |     |   enum MathError {
 14 |     |     NO_ERROR,
 15 |     |     DIVISION_BY_ZERO,
 16 |     |     INTEGER_OVERFLOW,

 20 |     |   /**
 21 |     |    * @dev Multiplies two numbers, returns an error on overflow.
 22 |     |    */
 23 |     |   function mulUInt(uint a, uint b) internal pure returns (MathError, uint) {
 24 |     |     if (a == 0) {
 25 |     |       return (MathError.NO_ERROR, 0);
 26 |     |     }
 27 |     | 
 28 |     |     uint c = a * b;
 29 |     | 
 30 |     |     if (c / a != b) {
 31 |     |       return (MathError.INTEGER_OVERFLOW, 0);
 32 |     |     } else {
 33 |     |       return (MathError.NO_ERROR, c);
 34 |     |     }
 35 |     |   }
 36 |     | 
 37 |     |   /**
 38 |     |    * @dev Integer division of two numbers, truncating the quotient.
 39 |     |    */
 40 |     |   function divUInt(uint a, uint b) internal pure returns (MathError, uint) {
 41 |     |     if (b == 0) {
 42 |     |       return (MathError.DIVISION_BY_ZERO, 0);
 43 |     |     }
 44 |     | 
 45 |     |     return (MathError.NO_ERROR, a / b);
 46 |     |   }
 47 |     | 
 48 |     |   /**
 49 |     |    * @dev Subtracts two numbers, returns an error on overflow (i.e. if subtrahend is greater than minuend).
 50 |     |    */
 51 |     |   function subUInt(uint a, uint b) internal pure returns (MathError, uint) {
 52 |     |     if (b <= a) {
 53 |     |       return (MathError.NO_ERROR, a - b);
 54 |     |     } else {
 55 |     |       return (MathError.INTEGER_UNDERFLOW, 0);
 56 |     |     }
 57 |     |   }
 58 |     | 
 59 |     |   /**
 60 |     |    * @dev Adds two numbers, returns an error on overflow.
 61 |     |    */
 62 |     |   function addUInt(uint a, uint b) internal pure returns (MathError, uint) {
 63 |     |     uint c = a + b;
 64 |     | 
 65 |     |     if (c >= a) {
 66 |     |       return (MathError.NO_ERROR, c);
 67 |     |     } else {
 68 |     |       return (MathError.INTEGER_OVERFLOW, 0);
 69 |     |     }
 70 |     |   }
 71 |     | 
 72 |     |   /**
 73 |     |    * @dev add a and b and then subtract c
 74 |     |    */
 75 |     |   function addThenSubUInt(
 76 |     |     uint a,
 77 |     |     uint b,
 78 |     |     uint c
 79 |     |   ) internal pure returns (MathError, uint) {
 80 |     |     (MathError err0, uint sum) = addUInt(a, b);
 81 |     | 
 82 |     |     if (err0 != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 83 |     |       return (err0, 0);
 84 |     |     }
 85 |     | 
 86 |     |     return subUInt(sum, c);
 87 |     |   }
 88 |     | }

/home/user/2023-01-ondo/contracts/lending/compound/tokens/Exponential.sol
   1 |     | pragma solidity ^0.5.8;
   2 |     | 
   3 |     | import "./CarefulMath.sol";
   4 |     | 
   5 |     | /**
   6 |     |  * @title Exponential module for storing fixed-decision decimals
   7 |     |  * @author Compound
   8 |     |  * @notice Exp is a struct which stores decimals with a fixed precision of 18 decimal places.
   9 |     |  *         Thus, if we wanted to store the 5.1, mantissa would store 5.1e18. That is:
  10 |     |  *         `Exp({mantissa: 5100000000000000000})`.
  11 |     |  */
  12 |     | contract Exponential is CarefulMath {
  13 |     |   uint constant expScale = 1e18;
  14 |     |   uint constant halfExpScale = expScale / 2;
  15 |     |   uint constant mantissaOne = expScale;
  16 |     | 
  17 |     |   struct Exp {
  18 |     |     uint mantissa;
  19 |     |   }
  20 |     | 
  21 |     |   /**
  22 |     |    * @dev Creates an exponential from numerator and denominator values.
  23 |     |    *      Note: Returns an error if (`num` * 10e18) > MAX_INT,
  24 |     |    *            or if `denom` is zero.
  25 |     |    */
  26 |     |   function getExp(
  27 |     |     uint num,
  28 |     |     uint denom
  29 |     |   ) internal pure returns (MathError, Exp memory) {
  30 |     |     (MathError err0, uint scaledNumerator) = mulUInt(num, expScale);
  31 |     |     if (err0 != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  32 |     |       return (err0, Exp({mantissa: 0}));
  33 |     |     }
  34 |     | 
  35 |     |     (MathError err1, uint rational) = divUInt(scaledNumerator, denom);
  36 |     |     if (err1 != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  37 |     |       return (err1, Exp({mantissa: 0}));
  38 |     |     }
  39 |     | 
  40 |     |     return (MathError.NO_ERROR, Exp({mantissa: rational}));
  41 |     |   }
  42 |     | 
  43 |     |   /**
  44 |     |    * @dev Adds two exponentials, returning a new exponential.
  45 |     |    */
  46 |     |   function addExp(
  47 |     |     Exp memory a,
  48 |     |     Exp memory b
  49 |     |   ) internal pure returns (MathError, Exp memory) {
  50 |     |     (MathError error, uint result) = addUInt(a.mantissa, b.mantissa);
  51 |     | 
  52 |     |     return (error, Exp({mantissa: result}));
  53 |     |   }
  54 |     | 
  55 |     |   /**
  56 |     |    * @dev Subtracts two exponentials, returning a new exponential.
  57 |     |    */
  58 |     |   function subExp(
  59 |     |     Exp memory a,
  60 |     |     Exp memory b
  61 |     |   ) internal pure returns (MathError, Exp memory) {
  62 |     |     (MathError error, uint result) = subUInt(a.mantissa, b.mantissa);
  63 |     | 
  64 |     |     return (error, Exp({mantissa: result}));
  65 |     |   }
  66 |     | 
  67 |     |   /**
  68 |     |    * @dev Multiply an Exp by a scalar, returning a new Exp.
  69 |     |    */
  70 |     |   function mulScalar(
  71 |     |     Exp memory a,
  72 |     |     uint scalar
  73 |     |   ) internal pure returns (MathError, Exp memory) {
  74 |     |     (MathError err0, uint scaledMantissa) = mulUInt(a.mantissa, scalar);
  75 |     |     if (err0 != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  76 |     |       return (err0, Exp({mantissa: 0}));
  77 |     |     }
  78 |     | 
  79 |     |     return (MathError.NO_ERROR, Exp({mantissa: scaledMantissa}));
  80 |     |   }
  81 |     | 
  82 |     |   /**
  83 |     |    * @dev Multiply an Exp by a scalar, then truncate to return an unsigned integer.
  84 |     |    */
  85 |     |   function mulScalarTruncate(
  86 |     |     Exp memory a,
  87 |     |     uint scalar
  88 |     |   ) internal pure returns (MathError, uint) {
  89 |     |     (MathError err, Exp memory product) = mulScalar(a, scalar);
  90 |     |     if (err != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  91 |     |       return (err, 0);
  92 |     |     }
  93 |     | 
  94 |     |     return (MathError.NO_ERROR, truncate(product));
  95 |     |   }
  96 |     | 
  97 |     |   /**
  98 |     |    * @dev Multiply an Exp by a scalar, truncate, then add an to an unsigned integer, returning an unsigned integer.
  99 |     |    */
 100 |     |   function mulScalarTruncateAddUInt(
 101 |     |     Exp memory a,
 102 |     |     uint scalar,
 103 |     |     uint addend
 104 |     |   ) internal pure returns (MathError, uint) {
 105 |     |     (MathError err, Exp memory product) = mulScalar(a, scalar);
 106 |     |     if (err != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 107 |     |       return (err, 0);
 108 |     |     }
 109 |     | 
 110 |     |     return addUInt(truncate(product), addend);
 111 |     |   }
 112 |     | 
 113 |     |   /**
 114 |     |    * @dev Divide an Exp by a scalar, returning a new Exp.
 115 |     |    */
 116 |     |   function divScalar(
 117 |     |     Exp memory a,
 118 |     |     uint scalar
 119 |     |   ) internal pure returns (MathError, Exp memory) {
 120 |     |     (MathError err0, uint descaledMantissa) = divUInt(a.mantissa, scalar);
 121 |     |     if (err0 != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 122 |     |       return (err0, Exp({mantissa: 0}));
 123 |     |     }
 124 |     | 
 125 |     |     return (MathError.NO_ERROR, Exp({mantissa: descaledMantissa}));
 126 |     |   }
 127 |     | 
 128 |     |   /**
 129 |     |    * @dev Divide a scalar by an Exp, returning a new Exp.
 130 |     |    */
 131 |     |   function divScalarByExp(
 132 |     |     uint scalar,
 133 |     |     Exp memory divisor
 134 |     |   ) internal pure returns (MathError, Exp memory) {
 135 |     |     /*
 136 |     |           We are doing this as:
 137 |     |           getExp(mulUInt(expScale, scalar), divisor.mantissa)
 138 |     | 
 139 |     |           How it works:
 140 |     |           Exp = a / b;
 141 |     |           Scalar = s;
 142 |     |           `s / (a / b)` = `b * s / a` and since for an Exp `a = mantissa, b = expScale`
 143 |     |         */
 144 |     |     (MathError err0, uint numerator) = mulUInt(expScale, scalar);
 145 |     |     if (err0 != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 146 |     |       return (err0, Exp({mantissa: 0}));
 147 |     |     }
 148 |     |     return getExp(numerator, divisor.mantissa);
 149 |     |   }
 150 |     | 
 151 |     |   /**
 152 |     |    * @dev Divide a scalar by an Exp, then truncate to return an unsigned integer.
 153 |     |    */
 154 |     |   function divScalarByExpTruncate(
 155 |     |     uint scalar,
 156 |     |     Exp memory divisor
 157 |     |   ) internal pure returns (MathError, uint) {
 158 |     |     (MathError err, Exp memory fraction) = divScalarByExp(scalar, divisor);
 159 |     |     if (err != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 160 |     |       return (err, 0);
 161 |     |     }
 162 |     | 
 163 |     |     return (MathError.NO_ERROR, truncate(fraction));
 164 |     |   }
 165 |     | 
 166 |     |   /**
 167 |     |    * @dev Multiplies two exponentials, returning a new exponential.
 168 |     |    */
 169 |     |   function mulExp(
 170 |     |     Exp memory a,
 171 |     |     Exp memory b
 172 |     |   ) internal pure returns (MathError, Exp memory) {
 173 |     |     (MathError err0, uint doubleScaledProduct) = mulUInt(
 174 |     |       a.mantissa,
 175 |     |       b.mantissa
 176 |     |     );
 177 |     |     if (err0 != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 178 |     |       return (err0, Exp({mantissa: 0}));
 179 |     |     }
 180 |     | 
 181 |     |     // We add half the scale before dividing so that we get rounding instead of truncation.
 182 |     |     //  See "Listing 6" and text above it at https://accu.org/index.php/journals/1717
 183 |     |     // Without this change, a result like 6.6...e-19 will be truncated to 0 instead of being rounded to 1e-18.
 184 |     |     (MathError err1, uint doubleScaledProductWithHalfScale) = addUInt(
 185 |     |       halfExpScale,
 186 |     |       doubleScaledProduct
 187 |     |     );
 188 |     |     if (err1 != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 189 |     |       return (err1, Exp({mantissa: 0}));
 190 |     |     }
 191 |     | 
 192 |     |     (MathError err2, uint product) = divUInt(
 193 |     |       doubleScaledProductWithHalfScale,
 194 |     |       expScale
 195 |     |     );
 196 |     |     // The only error `div` can return is MathError.DIVISION_BY_ZERO but we control `expScale` and it is not zero.
 197 |     |     assert(err2 == MathError.NO_ERROR);
 198 |     | 
 199 |     |     return (MathError.NO_ERROR, Exp({mantissa: product}));
 200 |     |   }
 201 |     | 
 202 |     |   /**
 203 |     |    * @dev Multiplies two exponentials given their mantissas, returning a new exponential.
 204 |     |    */
 205 |     |   function mulExp(
 206 |     |     uint a,
 207 |     |     uint b
 208 |     |   ) internal pure returns (MathError, Exp memory) {
 209 |     |     return mulExp(Exp({mantissa: a}), Exp({mantissa: b}));
 210 |     |   }
 211 |     | 
 212 |     |   /**
 213 |     |    * @dev Multiplies three exponentials, returning a new exponential.
 214 |     |    */
 215 |     |   function mulExp3(
 216 |     |     Exp memory a,
 217 |     |     Exp memory b,
 218 |     |     Exp memory c
 219 |     |   ) internal pure returns (MathError, Exp memory) {
 220 |     |     (MathError err, Exp memory ab) = mulExp(a, b);
 221 |     |     if (err != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 222 |     |       return (err, ab);
 223 |     |     }
 224 |     |     return mulExp(ab, c);
 225 |     |   }
 226 |     | 
 227 |     |   /**
 228 |     |    * @dev Divides two exponentials, returning a new exponential.
 229 |     |    *     (a/scale) / (b/scale) = (a/scale) * (scale/b) = a/b,
 230 |     |    *  which we can scale as an Exp by calling getExp(a.mantissa, b.mantissa)
 231 |     |    */
 232 |     |   function divExp(
 233 |     |     Exp memory a,
 234 |     |     Exp memory b
 235 |     |   ) internal pure returns (MathError, Exp memory) {
 236 |     |     return getExp(a.mantissa, b.mantissa);
 237 |     |   }
 238 |     | 
 239 |     |   /**
 240 |     |    * @dev Truncates the given exp to a whole number value.
 241 |     |    *      For example, truncate(Exp{mantissa: 15 * expScale}) = 15
 242 |     |    */
 243 |     |   function truncate(Exp memory exp) internal pure returns (uint) {
 244 |     |     // Note: We are not using careful math here as we're performing a division that cannot fail
 245 |     |     return exp.mantissa / expScale;
 246 |     |   }
 247 |     | 
 248 |     |   /**
 249 |     |    * @dev Checks if first Exp is less than second Exp.
 250 |     |    */
 251 |     |   function lessThanExp(
 252 |     |     Exp memory left,
 253 |     |     Exp memory right
 254 |     |   ) internal pure returns (bool) {
 255 |     |     return left.mantissa < right.mantissa; //TODO: Add some simple tests and this in another PR yo.
 256 |     |   }
 257 |     | 
 258 |     |   /**
 259 |     |    * @dev Checks if left Exp <= right Exp.
 260 |     |    */
 261 |     |   function lessThanOrEqualExp(
 262 |     |     Exp memory left,
 263 |     |     Exp memory right
 264 |     |   ) internal pure returns (bool) {
 265 |     |     return left.mantissa <= right.mantissa;
 266 |     |   }
 267 |     | 
 268 |     |   /**
 269 |     |    * @dev returns true if Exp is exactly zero
 270 |     |    */
 271 |     |   function isZeroExp(Exp memory value) internal pure returns (bool) {
 272 |     |     return value.mantissa == 0;
 273 |     |   }
 274 |     | }

  577 |     | // File: contracts/CErc20Delegator.sol
  578 |     | 
  579 |     | pragma solidity ^0.5.12;
  580 |     | 
  581 |     | /**
  582 |     |  * @title Compound's CErc20Delegator Contract
  583 |     |  * @notice CTokens which wrap an EIP-20 underlying and delegate to an implementation
  584 |     |  * @author Compound
  585 |     |  */
  586 |     | contract CErc20Delegator is
  587 |     |   CTokenInterface,
  588 |     |   CErc20Interface,
  589 |     |   CDelegatorInterface
  590 |     | {
  591 |     |   /**
  592 |     |    * @notice Construct a new money market
  593 |     |    * @param underlying_ The address of the underlying asset
  594 |     |    * @param comptroller_ The address of the Comptroller
  595 |     |    * @param interestRateModel_ The address of the interest rate model
  596 |     |    * @param initialExchangeRateMantissa_ The initial exchange rate, scaled by 1e18
  597 |     |    * @param name_ ERC-20 name of this token
  598 |     |    * @param symbol_ ERC-20 symbol of this token
  599 |     |    * @param decimals_ ERC-20 decimal precision of this token
  600 |     |    * @param admin_ Address of the administrator of this token
  601 |     |    * @param implementation_ The address of the implementation the contract delegates to
  602 |     |    * @param becomeImplementationData The encoded args for becomeImplmenetation
  603 |     |    */
  604 |     |   constructor(
  605 |     |     address underlying_,
  606 |     |     ComptrollerInterface comptroller_,
  607 |     |     InterestRateModel interestRateModel_,
  608 |     |     uint256 initialExchangeRateMantissa_,
  609 |     |     string memory name_,
  610 |     |     string memory symbol_,
  611 |     |     uint8 decimals_,
  612 |     |     address payable admin_,
  613 |     |     address implementation_,
  614 |     |     bytes memory becomeImplementationData
  615 |     |   ) public {
  616 |     |     // Creator of the contract is admin during initialization
  617 |     |     admin = msg.sender;
  618 |     | 
  619 |     |     // First delegate gets to initialize the delegator (i.e. storage contract)
  620 |     |     delegateTo(
  621 |     |       implementation_,
  622 |     |       abi.encodeWithSignature(
  623 |     |         "initialize(address,address,address,uint256,string,string,uint8)",
  624 |     |         underlying_,
  625 |     |         comptroller_,
  626 |     |         interestRateModel_,
  627 |     |         initialExchangeRateMantissa_,
  628 |     |         name_,
  629 |     |         symbol_,
  630 |     |         decimals_
  631 |     |       )
  632 |     |     );
  633 |     | 
  634 |     |     // New implementations always get set via the settor (post-initialize)
  635 |     |     _setImplementation(implementation_, false, becomeImplementationData);
  636 |     | 
  637 |     |     // Set the proper admin now that initialization is done
  638 |     |     admin = admin_;
  639 |     |   }
  640 |     | 
  641 |     |   /**
  642 |     |    * @notice Called by the admin to update the implementation of the delegator
  643 |     |    * @param implementation_ The address of the new implementation for delegation
  644 |     |    * @param allowResign Flag to indicate whether to call _resignImplementation on the old implementation
  645 |     |    * @param becomeImplementationData The encoded bytes data to be passed to _becomeImplementation
  646 |     |    */
  647 |     |   function _setImplementation(
  648 |     |     address implementation_,
  649 |     |     bool allowResign,
  650 |     |     bytes memory becomeImplementationData
  651 |     |   ) public {
  652 |     |     require(
  653 |     |       msg.sender == admin,
  654 |     |       "CErc20Delegator::_setImplementation: Caller must be admin"
  655 |     |     );
  656 |     | 
  657 |     |     if (allowResign) {
  658 |     |       delegateToImplementation(
  659 |     |         abi.encodeWithSignature("_resignImplementation()")
  660 |     |       );
  661 |     |     }
  662 |     | 
  663 |     |     address oldImplementation = implementation;
  664 |     |     implementation = implementation_;
  665 |     | 
  666 |     |     delegateToImplementation(
  667 |     |       abi.encodeWithSignature(
  668 |     |         "_becomeImplementation(bytes)",
  669 |     |         becomeImplementationData
  670 |     |       )
  671 |     |     );
  672 |     | 
  673 |     |     emit NewImplementation(oldImplementation, implementation);
  674 |     |   }
  675 |     | 
  676 |     |   /**
  677 |     |    * @notice Sender supplies assets into the market and receives cTokens in exchange
  678 |     |    * @dev Accrues interest whether or not the operation succeeds, unless reverted
  679 |     |    * @param mintAmount The amount of the underlying asset to supply
  680 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
  681 |     |    */
  682 |     |   function mint(uint256 mintAmount) external returns (uint256) {
  683 |     |     bytes memory data = delegateToImplementation(
  684 |     |       abi.encodeWithSignature("mint(uint256)", mintAmount)
  685 |     |     );
  686 |     |     return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
  687 |     |   }
  688 |     | 
  689 |     |   /**
  690 |     |    * @notice Sender redeems cTokens in exchange for the underlying asset
  691 |     |    * @dev Accrues interest whether or not the operation succeeds, unless reverted
  692 |     |    * @param redeemTokens The number of cTokens to redeem into underlying
  693 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
  694 |     |    */
  695 |     |   function redeem(uint256 redeemTokens) external returns (uint256) {
  696 |     |     bytes memory data = delegateToImplementation(
  697 |     |       abi.encodeWithSignature("redeem(uint256)", redeemTokens)
  698 |     |     );
  699 |     |     return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
  700 |     |   }
  701 |     | 
  702 |     |   /**
  703 |     |    * @notice Sender redeems cTokens in exchange for a specified amount of underlying asset
  704 |     |    * @dev Accrues interest whether or not the operation succeeds, unless reverted
  705 |     |    * @param redeemAmount The amount of underlying to redeem
  706 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
  707 |     |    */
  708 |     |   function redeemUnderlying(uint256 redeemAmount) external returns (uint256) {
  709 |     |     bytes memory data = delegateToImplementation(
  710 |     |       abi.encodeWithSignature("redeemUnderlying(uint256)", redeemAmount)
  711 |     |     );
  712 |     |     return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
  713 |     |   }
  714 |     | 
  715 |     |   /**
  716 |     |    * @notice Sender borrows assets from the protocol to their own address
  717 |     |    * @param borrowAmount The amount of the underlying asset to borrow
  718 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
  719 |     |    */
  720 |     |   function borrow(uint256 borrowAmount) external returns (uint256) {
  721 |     |     bytes memory data = delegateToImplementation(
  722 |     |       abi.encodeWithSignature("borrow(uint256)", borrowAmount)
  723 |     |     );
  724 |     |     return abi.decode(data, (uint256));
  725 |     |   }
  726 |     | 
  727 |     |   /**

 1120 |     |   /**
 1121 |     |    * @notice Internal method to delegate execution to another contract
 1122 |     |    * @dev It returns to the external caller whatever the implementation returns or forwards reverts
 1123 |     |    * @param callee The contract to delegatecall
 1124 |     |    * @param data The raw data to delegatecall
 1125 |     |    * @return The returned bytes from the delegatecall
 1126 |     |    */
 1127 |     |   function delegateTo(
 1128 |     |     address callee,
 1129 |     |     bytes memory data
 1130 |     |   ) internal returns (bytes memory) {
 1131 |     |     (bool success, bytes memory returnData) = callee.delegatecall(data);
 1132 |     |     assembly {
 1133 |     |       if eq(success, 0) {
 1134 |     |         revert(add(returnData, 0x20), returndatasize)
 1135 |     |       }
 1136 |     |     }
 1137 |     |     return returnData;

 1152 |     |   /**
 1153 |     |    * @notice Delegates execution to an implementation contract
 1154 |     |    * @dev It returns to the external caller whatever the implementation returns or forwards reverts
 1155 |     |    *  There are an additional 2 prefix uints from the wrapper returndata, which we ignore since we make an extra hop.
 1156 |     |    * @param data The raw data to delegatecall
 1157 |     |    * @return The returned bytes from the delegatecall
 1158 |     |    */
 1159 |     |   function delegateToViewImplementation(
 1160 |     |     bytes memory data
 1161 |     |   ) public view returns (bytes memory) {
 1162 |     |     (bool success, bytes memory returnData) = address(this).staticcall(
 1163 |     |       abi.encodeWithSignature("delegateToImplementation(bytes)", data)
 1164 |     |     );
 1165 |     |     assembly {
 1166 |     |       if eq(success, 0) {
 1167 |     |         revert(add(returnData, 0x20), returndatasize)
 1168 |     |       }
 1169 |     |     }
 1170 |     |     return abi.decode(returnData, (bytes));
 1171 |     |   }
 1172 |     | 
 1173 |     |   /**
 1174 |     |    * @notice Delegates execution to an implementation contract
 1175 |     |    * @dev It returns to the external caller whatever the implementation returns or forwards reverts
 1176 |     |    */
 1177 |     |   function() external payable {
 1178 |     |     require(
 1179 |     |       msg.value == 0,
 1180 |     |       "CErc20Delegator:fallback: cannot send value to fallback"
 1181 |     |     );
 1182 |     | 
 1183 |     |     // delegate all other functions to current implementation
 1184 |     |     (bool success, ) = implementation.delegatecall(msg.data);
 1185 |     | 
 1186 |     |     assembly {
 1187 |     |       let free_mem_ptr := mload(0x40)
 1188 |     |       returndatacopy(free_mem_ptr, 0, returndatasize)
 1189 |     | 
 1190 |     |       switch success
 1191 |     |       case 0 {
 1192 |     |         revert(free_mem_ptr, returndatasize)
 1193 |     |       }
 1194 |     |       default {
 1195 |     |         return(free_mem_ptr, returndatasize)
 1196 |     |       }
 1197 |     |     }

   52 |     |   /**
   53 |     |    * @notice Administrator for this contract
   54 |     |    */
   55 |     |   address payable public admin;
   56 |     |

   60 |     |   address payable public pendingAdmin;

   70 |     |   InterestRateModel public interestRateModel;

  117 |     |   /**
  118 |     |    * @notice Container for borrow balance information
  119 |     |    * @member principal Total balance (with accrued interest), after applying the most recent balance-changing action
  120 |     |    * @member interestIndex Global borrowIndex as of the most recent balance-changing action
  121 |     |    */
  122 |     |   struct BorrowSnapshot {
  123 |     |     uint principal;
  124 |     |     uint interestIndex;
  125 |     |   }
  126 |     | 
  127 |     |   /**
  128 |     |    * @notice Mapping of account addresses to outstanding borrow balances
  129 |     |    */
  130 |     |   mapping(address => BorrowSnapshot) accountBorrows;
