  230 |     |   /**
  231 |     |    * @notice Construct a new money market
  232 |     |    * @param comptroller_ The address of the Comptroller
  233 |     |    * @param interestRateModel_ The address of the interest rate model
  234 |     |    * @param initialExchangeRateMantissa_ The initial exchange rate, scaled by 1e18
  235 |     |    * @param name_ EIP-20 name of this token
  236 |     |    * @param symbol_ EIP-20 symbol of this token
  237 |     |    * @param decimals_ EIP-20 decimal precision of this token
  238 |     |    */
  239 |     |   constructor(
  240 |     |     ComptrollerInterface comptroller_,
  241 |     |     InterestRateModel interestRateModel_,
  242 |     |     uint initialExchangeRateMantissa_,
  243 |     |     string memory name_,
  244 |     |     string memory symbol_,
  245 |     |     uint decimals_
  246 |     |   ) internal {
  247 |     |     // Set admin to msg.sender
  248 |     |     admin = msg.sender;
  249 |     | 
  250 |     |     // Set initial exchange rate
  251 |     |     initialExchangeRateMantissa = initialExchangeRateMantissa_;
  252 |     |     require(
  253 |     |       initialExchangeRateMantissa > 0,
  254 |     |       "Initial exchange rate must be greater than zero."
  255 |     |     );
  256 |     | 
  257 |     |     // Set the comptroller
  258 |     |     uint err = _setComptroller(comptroller_);
  259 |     |     require(err == uint(Error.NO_ERROR), "Setting comptroller failed");
  260 |     | 
  261 |     |     // Initialize block number and borrow index (block number mocks depend on comptroller being set)
  262 |     |     accrualBlockNumber = getBlockNumber();
  263 |     |     borrowIndex = mantissaOne;
  264 |     | 
  265 |     |     // Set the interest rate model (depends on block number / borrow index)
  266 |     |     err = _setInterestRateModelFresh(interestRateModel_);
  267 |     |     require(err == uint(Error.NO_ERROR), "Setting interest rate model failed");
  268 |     | 
  269 |     |     name = name_;
  270 |     |     symbol = symbol_;
  271 |     |     decimals = decimals_;
  272 |     |   }
  273 |     | 
  274 |     |   /**
  275 |     |    * @notice Transfer `tokens` tokens from `src` to `dst` by `spender`
  276 |     |    * @dev Called by both `transfer` and `transferFrom` internally
  277 |     |    * @param spender The address of the account performing the transfer
  278 |     |    * @param src The address of the source account
  279 |     |    * @param dst The address of the destination account
  280 |     |    * @param tokens The number of tokens to transfer
  281 |     |    * @return Whether or not the transfer succeeded
  282 |     |    */
  283 |     |   function transferTokens(
  284 |     |     address spender,
  285 |     |     address src,
  286 |     |     address dst,
  287 |     |     uint tokens
  288 |     |   ) internal returns (uint) {
  289 |     |     /* Fail if transfer not allowed */
  290 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.transferAllowed(address(this), src, dst, tokens);
  291 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
  292 |     |       return
  293 |     |         failOpaque(
  294 |     |           Error.COMPTROLLER_REJECTION,
  295 |     |           FailureInfo.TRANSFER_COMPTROLLER_REJECTION,
  296 |     |           allowed
  297 |     |         );
  298 |     |     }
  299 |     | 
  300 |     |     /* Do not allow self-transfers */
  301 |     |     if (src == dst) {
  302 |     |       return fail(Error.BAD_INPUT, FailureInfo.TRANSFER_NOT_ALLOWED);
  303 |     |     }
  304 |     | 
  305 |     |     /* Get the allowance, infinite for the account owner */
  306 |     |     uint startingAllowance = 0;
  307 |     |     if (spender == src) {
  308 |     |       startingAllowance = uint(-1);
  309 |     |     } else {
  310 |     |       startingAllowance = transferAllowances[src][spender];
  311 |     |     }
  312 |     | 
  313 |     |     /* Do the calculations, checking for {under,over}flow */
  314 |     |     MathError mathErr;
  315 |     |     uint allowanceNew;
  316 |     |     uint srcTokensNew;
  317 |     |     uint dstTokensNew;
  318 |     | 
  319 |     |     (mathErr, allowanceNew) = subUInt(startingAllowance, tokens);
  320 |     |     if (mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  321 |     |       return fail(Error.MATH_ERROR, FailureInfo.TRANSFER_NOT_ALLOWED);
  322 |     |     }
  323 |     | 
  324 |     |     (mathErr, srcTokensNew) = subUInt(accountTokens[src], tokens);
  325 |     |     if (mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  326 |     |       return fail(Error.MATH_ERROR, FailureInfo.TRANSFER_NOT_ENOUGH);
  327 |     |     }
  328 |     | 
  329 |     |     (mathErr, dstTokensNew) = addUInt(accountTokens[dst], tokens);
  330 |     |     if (mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  331 |     |       return fail(Error.MATH_ERROR, FailureInfo.TRANSFER_TOO_MUCH);
  332 |     |     }
  333 |     | 
  334 |     |     /////////////////////////
  335 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  336 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  337 |     | 
  338 |     |     accountTokens[src] = srcTokensNew;
  339 |     |     accountTokens[dst] = dstTokensNew;
  340 |     | 
  341 |     |     /* Eat some of the allowance (if necessary) */
  342 |     |     if (startingAllowance != uint(-1)) {
  343 |     |       transferAllowances[src][spender] = allowanceNew;
  344 |     |     }
  345 |     | 
  346 |     |     /* We emit a Transfer event */
  347 |     |     emit Transfer(src, dst, tokens);
  348 |     | 
  349 |     |     /* We call the defense hook (which checks for under-collateralization) */
  350 |     |     comptroller.transferVerify(address(this), src, dst, tokens);
  351 |     | 
  352 |     |     return uint(Error.NO_ERROR);
  353 |     |   }
  354 |     | 
  355 |     |   /**
  356 |     |    * @notice Transfer `amount` tokens from `msg.sender` to `dst`
  357 |     |    * @param dst The address of the destination account
  358 |     |    * @param amount The number of tokens to transfer
  359 |     |    * @return Whether or not the transfer succeeded
  360 |     |    */
  361 |     |   function transfer(
  362 |     |     address dst,
  363 |     |     uint256 amount
  364 |     |   ) external nonReentrant returns (bool) {
  365 |     |     return
  366 |     |       transferTokens(msg.sender, msg.sender, dst, amount) ==
  367 |     |       uint(Error.NO_ERROR);
  368 |     |   }
  369 |     | 
  370 |     |   /**
  371 |     |    * @notice Transfer `amount` tokens from `src` to `dst`
  372 |     |    * @param src The address of the source account
  373 |     |    * @param dst The address of the destination account
  374 |     |    * @param amount The number of tokens to transfer
  375 |     |    * @return Whether or not the transfer succeeded
  376 |     |    */
  377 |     |   function transferFrom(
  378 |     |     address src,
  379 |     |     address dst,
  380 |     |     uint256 amount
  381 |     |   ) external nonReentrant returns (bool) {
  382 |     |     return transferTokens(msg.sender, src, dst, amount) == uint(Error.NO_ERROR);
  383 |     |   }
  384 |     | 
  385 |     |   /**
  386 |     |    * @notice Approve `spender` to transfer up to `amount` from `src`
  387 |     |    * @dev This will overwrite the approval amount for `spender`
  388 |     |    *  and is subject to issues noted [here](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-20#approve)
  389 |     |    * @param spender The address of the account which may transfer tokens
  390 |     |    * @param amount The number of tokens that are approved (-1 means infinite)
  391 |     |    * @return Whether or not the approval succeeded
  392 |     |    */
  393 |     |   function approve(address spender, uint256 amount) external returns (bool) {
  394 |     |     address src = msg.sender;
  395 |     |     transferAllowances[src][spender] = amount;
  396 |     |     emit Approval(src, spender, amount);
  397 |     |     return true;
  398 |     |   }
  399 |     | 
  400 |     |   /**
  401 |     |    * @notice Get the current allowance from `owner` for `spender`
  402 |     |    * @param owner The address of the account which owns the tokens to be spent
  403 |     |    * @param spender The address of the account which may transfer tokens
  404 |     |    * @return The number of tokens allowed to be spent (-1 means infinite)
  405 |     |    */
  406 |     |   function allowance(
  407 |     |     address owner,
  408 |     |     address spender
  409 |     |   ) external view returns (uint256) {
  410 |     |     return transferAllowances[owner][spender];
  411 |     |   }
  412 |     | 
  413 |     |   /**
  414 |     |    * @notice Get the token balance of the `owner`
  415 |     |    * @param owner The address of the account to query
  416 |     |    * @return The number of tokens owned by `owner`
  417 |     |    */
  418 |     |   function balanceOf(address owner) external view returns (uint256) {
  419 |     |     return accountTokens[owner];
  420 |     |   }
  421 |     | 
  422 |     |   /**
  423 |     |    * @notice Get the underlying balance of the `owner`
  424 |     |    * @dev This also accrues interest in a transaction
  425 |     |    * @param owner The address of the account to query
  426 |     |    * @return The amount of underlying owned by `owner`
  427 |     |    */
  428 |     |   function balanceOfUnderlying(address owner) external returns (uint) {
  429 |     |     Exp memory exchangeRate = Exp({mantissa: exchangeRateCurrent()});
  430 |     |     (MathError mErr, uint balance) = mulScalarTruncate(
  431 |     |       exchangeRate,
  432 |     |       accountTokens[owner]
  433 |     |     );
  434 |     |     require(mErr == MathError.NO_ERROR);
  435 |     |     return balance;
  436 |     |   }
  437 |     | 
  438 |     |   /**
  439 |     |    * @notice Get a snapshot of the account's balances, and the cached exchange rate
  440 |     |    * @dev This is used by comptroller to more efficiently perform liquidity checks.
  441 |     |    * @param account Address of the account to snapshot
  442 |     |    * @return (possible error, token balance, borrow balance, exchange rate mantissa)
  443 |     |    */
  444 |     |   function getAccountSnapshot(
  445 |     |     address account
  446 |     |   ) external view returns (uint, uint, uint, uint) {
  447 |     |     uint cTokenBalance = accountTokens[account];
  448 |     |     uint borrowBalance;
  449 |     |     uint exchangeRateMantissa;
  450 |     | 
  451 |     |     MathError mErr;
  452 |     | 
  453 |     |     (mErr, borrowBalance) = borrowBalanceStoredInternal(account);
  454 |     |     if (mErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  455 |     |       return (uint(Error.MATH_ERROR), 0, 0, 0);
  456 |     |     }
  457 |     | 
  458 |     |     (mErr, exchangeRateMantissa) = exchangeRateStoredInternal();
  459 |     |     if (mErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  460 |     |       return (uint(Error.MATH_ERROR), 0, 0, 0);
  461 |     |     }
  462 |     | 
  463 |     |     return (
  464 |     |       uint(Error.NO_ERROR),
  465 |     |       cTokenBalance,
  466 |     |       borrowBalance,
  467 |     |       exchangeRateMantissa
  468 |     |     );
  469 |     |   }
  470 |     | 
  471 |     |   /**
  472 |     |    * @dev Function to simply retrieve block number
  473 |     |    *  This exists mainly for inheriting test contracts to stub this result.
  474 |     |    */
  475 |     |   function getBlockNumber() internal view returns (uint) {
  476 |     |     return block.number;
  477 |     |   }
  478 |     | 
  479 |     |   /**
  480 |     |    * @notice Returns the current per-block borrow interest rate for this cToken
  481 |     |    * @return The borrow interest rate per block, scaled by 1e18
  482 |     |    */
  483 |     |   function borrowRatePerBlock() external view returns (uint) {
  484 |     |     (uint opaqueErr, uint borrowRateMantissa) = interestRateModel.getBorrowRate(
  485 |     |       getCashPrior(),
  486 |     |       totalBorrows,
  487 |     |       totalReserves
  488 |     |     );
  489 |     |     require(
  490 |     |       opaqueErr == 0,
  491 |     |       "borrowRatePerBlock: interestRateModel.borrowRate failed"
  492 |     |     ); // semi-opaque
  493 |     |     return borrowRateMantissa;
  494 |     |   }
  495 |     | 
  496 |     |   /**
  497 |     |    * @notice Returns the current per-block supply interest rate for this cToken
  498 |     |    * @return The supply interest rate per block, scaled by 1e18
  499 |     |    */
  500 |     |   function supplyRatePerBlock() external view returns (uint) {
  501 |     |     /* We calculate the supply rate:
  502 |     |      *  underlying = totalSupply × exchangeRate
  503 |     |      *  borrowsPer = totalBorrows ÷ underlying
  504 |     |      *  supplyRate = borrowRate × (1-reserveFactor) × borrowsPer
  505 |     |      */
  506 |     |     uint exchangeRateMantissa = exchangeRateStored();
  507 |     | 
  508 |     |     (uint e0, uint borrowRateMantissa) = interestRateModel.getBorrowRate(
  509 |     |       getCashPrior(),
  510 |     |       totalBorrows,
  511 |     |       totalReserves
  512 |     |     );
  513 |     |     require(e0 == 0, "supplyRatePerBlock: calculating borrowRate failed"); // semi-opaque
  514 |     | 
  515 |     |     (MathError e1, Exp memory underlying) = mulScalar(
  516 |     |       Exp({mantissa: exchangeRateMantissa}),
  517 |     |       totalSupply
  518 |     |     );
  519 |     |     require(
  520 |     |       e1 == MathError.NO_ERROR,
  521 |     |       "supplyRatePerBlock: calculating underlying failed"
  522 |     |     );
  523 |     | 
  524 |     |     (MathError e2, Exp memory borrowsPer) = divScalarByExp(
  525 |     |       totalBorrows,
  526 |     |       underlying
  527 |     |     );
  528 |     |     require(
  529 |     |       e2 == MathError.NO_ERROR,
  530 |     |       "supplyRatePerBlock: calculating borrowsPer failed"
  531 |     |     );
  532 |     | 
  533 |     |     (MathError e3, Exp memory oneMinusReserveFactor) = subExp(
  534 |     |       Exp({mantissa: mantissaOne}),
  535 |     |       Exp({mantissa: reserveFactorMantissa})
  536 |     |     );
  537 |     |     require(
  538 |     |       e3 == MathError.NO_ERROR,
  539 |     |       "supplyRatePerBlock: calculating oneMinusReserveFactor failed"
  540 |     |     );
  541 |     | 
  542 |     |     (MathError e4, Exp memory supplyRate) = mulExp3(
  543 |     |       Exp({mantissa: borrowRateMantissa}),
  544 |     |       oneMinusReserveFactor,
  545 |     |       borrowsPer
  546 |     |     );
  547 |     |     require(
  548 |     |       e4 == MathError.NO_ERROR,
  549 |     |       "supplyRatePerBlock: calculating supplyRate failed"
  550 |     |     );
  551 |     | 
  552 |     |     return supplyRate.mantissa;
  553 |     |   }
  554 |     | 
  555 |     |   /**
  556 |     |    * @notice Returns the current total borrows plus accrued interest
  557 |     |    * @return The total borrows with interest
  558 |     |    */
  559 |     |   function totalBorrowsCurrent() external nonReentrant returns (uint) {
  560 |     |     require(accrueInterest() == uint(Error.NO_ERROR), "accrue interest failed");
  561 |     |     return totalBorrows;
  562 |     |   }
  563 |     | 
  564 |     |   /**
  565 |     |    * @notice Accrue interest to updated borrowIndex and then calculate account's borrow balance using the updated borrowIndex
  566 |     |    * @param account The address whose balance should be calculated after updating borrowIndex
  567 |     |    * @return The calculated balance
  568 |     |    */
  569 |     |   function borrowBalanceCurrent(
  570 |     |     address account
  571 |     |   ) external nonReentrant returns (uint) {
  572 |     |     require(accrueInterest() == uint(Error.NO_ERROR), "accrue interest failed");
  573 |     |     return borrowBalanceStored(account);
  574 |     |   }
  575 |     | 
  576 |     |   /**
  577 |     |    * @notice Return the borrow balance of account based on stored data
  578 |     |    * @param account The address whose balance should be calculated
  579 |     |    * @return The calculated balance
  580 |     |    */
  581 |     |   function borrowBalanceStored(address account) public view returns (uint) {
  582 |     |     (MathError err, uint result) = borrowBalanceStoredInternal(account);
  583 |     |     require(
  584 |     |       err == MathError.NO_ERROR,
  585 |     |       "borrowBalanceStored: borrowBalanceStoredInternal failed"
  586 |     |     );
  587 |     |     return result;
  588 |     |   }
  589 |     | 
  590 |     |   /**
  591 |     |    * @notice Return the borrow balance of account based on stored data
  592 |     |    * @param account The address whose balance should be calculated
  593 |     |    * @return (error code, the calculated balance or 0 if error code is non-zero)
  594 |     |    */
  595 |     |   function borrowBalanceStoredInternal(
  596 |     |     address account
  597 |     |   ) internal view returns (MathError, uint) {
  598 |     |     /* Note: we do not assert that the market is up to date */
  599 |     |     MathError mathErr;
  600 |     |     uint principalTimesIndex;
  601 |     |     uint result;
  602 |     | 
  603 |     |     /* Get borrowBalance and borrowIndex */
  604 |     |     BorrowSnapshot storage borrowSnapshot = accountBorrows[account];
  605 |     | 
  606 |     |     /* If borrowBalance = 0 then borrowIndex is likely also 0.
  607 |     |      * Rather than failing the calculation with a division by 0, we immediately return 0 in this case.
  608 |     |      */
  609 |     |     if (borrowSnapshot.principal == 0) {
  610 |     |       return (MathError.NO_ERROR, 0);
  611 |     |     }
  612 |     | 
  613 |     |     /* Calculate new borrow balance using the interest index:
  614 |     |      *  recentBorrowBalance = borrower.borrowBalance * market.borrowIndex / borrower.borrowIndex
  615 |     |      */
  616 |     |     (mathErr, principalTimesIndex) = mulUInt(
  617 |     |       borrowSnapshot.principal,
  618 |     |       borrowIndex
  619 |     |     );
  620 |     |     if (mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  621 |     |       return (mathErr, 0);
  622 |     |     }
  623 |     | 
  624 |     |     (mathErr, result) = divUInt(
  625 |     |       principalTimesIndex,
  626 |     |       borrowSnapshot.interestIndex
  627 |     |     );
  628 |     |     if (mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  629 |     |       return (mathErr, 0);
  630 |     |     }
  631 |     | 
  632 |     |     return (MathError.NO_ERROR, result);
  633 |     |   }
  634 |     | 
  635 |     |   /**
  636 |     |    * @notice Accrue interest then return the up-to-date exchange rate
  637 |     |    * @return Calculated exchange rate scaled by 1e18
  638 |     |    */
  639 |     |   function exchangeRateCurrent() public nonReentrant returns (uint) {
  640 |     |     require(accrueInterest() == uint(Error.NO_ERROR), "accrue interest failed");
  641 |     |     return exchangeRateStored();
  642 |     |   }
  643 |     | 
  644 |     |   /**
  645 |     |    * @notice Calculates the exchange rate from the underlying to the CToken
  646 |     |    * @dev This function does not accrue interest before calculating the exchange rate
  647 |     |    * @return Calculated exchange rate scaled by 1e18
  648 |     |    */
  649 |     |   function exchangeRateStored() public view returns (uint) {
  650 |     |     (MathError err, uint result) = exchangeRateStoredInternal();
  651 |     |     require(
  652 |     |       err == MathError.NO_ERROR,
  653 |     |       "exchangeRateStored: exchangeRateStoredInternal failed"
  654 |     |     );
  655 |     |     return result;
  656 |     |   }
  657 |     | 
  658 |     |   /**
  659 |     |    * @notice Calculates the exchange rate from the underlying to the CToken
  660 |     |    * @dev This function does not accrue interest before calculating the exchange rate
  661 |     |    * @return (error code, calculated exchange rate scaled by 1e18)
  662 |     |    */
  663 |     |   function exchangeRateStoredInternal()
  664 |     |     internal
  665 |     |     view
  666 |     |     returns (MathError, uint)
  667 |     |   {
  668 |     |     if (totalSupply == 0) {
  669 |     |       /*
  670 |     |        * If there are no tokens minted:
  671 |     |        *  exchangeRate = initialExchangeRate
  672 |     |        */
  673 |     |       return (MathError.NO_ERROR, initialExchangeRateMantissa);
  674 |     |     } else {
  675 |     |       /*
  676 |     |        * Otherwise:
  677 |     |        *  exchangeRate = (totalCash + totalBorrows - totalReserves) / totalSupply
  678 |     |        */
  679 |     |       uint totalCash = getCashPrior();
  680 |     |       uint cashPlusBorrowsMinusReserves;
  681 |     |       Exp memory exchangeRate;
  682 |     |       MathError mathErr;
  683 |     | 
  684 |     |       (mathErr, cashPlusBorrowsMinusReserves) = addThenSubUInt(
  685 |     |         totalCash,
  686 |     |         totalBorrows,
  687 |     |         totalReserves
  688 |     |       );
  689 |     |       if (mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  690 |     |         return (mathErr, 0);
  691 |     |       }
  692 |     | 
  693 |     |       (mathErr, exchangeRate) = getExp(
  694 |     |         cashPlusBorrowsMinusReserves,
  695 |     |         totalSupply
  696 |     |       );
  697 |     |       if (mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  698 |     |         return (mathErr, 0);
  699 |     |       }
  700 |     | 
  701 |     |       return (MathError.NO_ERROR, exchangeRate.mantissa);
  702 |     |     }
  703 |     |   }
  704 |     | 
  705 |     |   /**
  706 |     |    * @notice Get cash balance of this cToken in the underlying asset
  707 |     |    * @return The quantity of underlying asset owned by this contract
  708 |     |    */
  709 |     |   function getCash() external view returns (uint) {
  710 |     |     return getCashPrior();
  711 |     |   }
  712 |     | 
  713 |     |   struct AccrueInterestLocalVars {
  714 |     |     MathError mathErr;
  715 |     |     uint opaqueErr;
  716 |     |     uint borrowRateMantissa;
  717 |     |     uint currentBlockNumber;
  718 |     |     uint blockDelta;
  719 |     |     Exp simpleInterestFactor;
  720 |     |     uint interestAccumulated;
  721 |     |     uint totalBorrowsNew;
  722 |     |     uint totalReservesNew;
  723 |     |     uint borrowIndexNew;
  724 |     |   }
  725 |     | 
  726 |     |   /**
  727 |     |    * @notice Applies accrued interest to total borrows and reserves.
  728 |     |    * @dev This calculates interest accrued from the last checkpointed block
  729 |     |    *      up to the current block and writes new checkpoint to storage.
  730 |     |    */
  731 |     |   function accrueInterest() public returns (uint) {
  732 |     |     AccrueInterestLocalVars memory vars;
  733 |     | 
  734 |     |     /* Calculate the current borrow interest rate */
  735 |     |     (vars.opaqueErr, vars.borrowRateMantissa) = interestRateModel.getBorrowRate(
  736 |     |       getCashPrior(),
  737 |     |       totalBorrows,
  738 |     |       totalReserves
  739 |     |     );
  740 |     |     require(
  741 |     |       vars.borrowRateMantissa <= borrowRateMaxMantissa,
  742 |     |       "borrow rate is absurdly high"
  743 |     |     );
  744 |     |     if (vars.opaqueErr != 0) {
  745 |     |       return
  746 |     |         failOpaque(
  747 |     |           Error.INTEREST_RATE_MODEL_ERROR,
  748 |     |           FailureInfo.ACCRUE_INTEREST_BORROW_RATE_CALCULATION_FAILED,
  749 |     |           vars.opaqueErr
  750 |     |         );
  751 |     |     }
  752 |     | 
  753 |     |     /* Remember the initial block number */
  754 |     |     vars.currentBlockNumber = getBlockNumber();
  755 |     | 
  756 |     |     /* Calculate the number of blocks elapsed since the last accrual */
  757 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.blockDelta) = subUInt(
  758 |     |       vars.currentBlockNumber,
  759 |     |       accrualBlockNumber
  760 |     |     );
  761 |     |     assert(vars.mathErr == MathError.NO_ERROR); // Block delta should always succeed and if it doesn't, blow up.
  762 |     | 
  763 |     |     /*
  764 |     |      * Calculate the interest accumulated into borrows and reserves and the new index:
  765 |     |      *  simpleInterestFactor = borrowRate * blockDelta
  766 |     |      *  interestAccumulated = simpleInterestFactor * totalBorrows
  767 |     |      *  totalBorrowsNew = interestAccumulated + totalBorrows
  768 |     |      *  totalReservesNew = interestAccumulated * reserveFactor + totalReserves
  769 |     |      *  borrowIndexNew = simpleInterestFactor * borrowIndex + borrowIndex
  770 |     |      */
  771 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.simpleInterestFactor) = mulScalar(
  772 |     |       Exp({mantissa: vars.borrowRateMantissa}),
  773 |     |       vars.blockDelta
  774 |     |     );
  775 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  776 |     |       return
  777 |     |         failOpaque(
  778 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
  779 |     |           FailureInfo.ACCRUE_INTEREST_SIMPLE_INTEREST_FACTOR_CALCULATION_FAILED,
  780 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
  781 |     |         );
  782 |     |     }
  783 |     | 
  784 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.interestAccumulated) = mulScalarTruncate(
  785 |     |       vars.simpleInterestFactor,
  786 |     |       totalBorrows
  787 |     |     );
  788 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  789 |     |       return
  790 |     |         failOpaque(
  791 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
  792 |     |           FailureInfo.ACCRUE_INTEREST_ACCUMULATED_INTEREST_CALCULATION_FAILED,
  793 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
  794 |     |         );
  795 |     |     }
  796 |     | 
  797 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.totalBorrowsNew) = addUInt(
  798 |     |       vars.interestAccumulated,
  799 |     |       totalBorrows
  800 |     |     );
  801 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  802 |     |       return
  803 |     |         failOpaque(
  804 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
  805 |     |           FailureInfo.ACCRUE_INTEREST_NEW_TOTAL_BORROWS_CALCULATION_FAILED,
  806 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
  807 |     |         );
  808 |     |     }
  809 |     | 
  810 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.totalReservesNew) = mulScalarTruncateAddUInt(
  811 |     |       Exp({mantissa: reserveFactorMantissa}),
  812 |     |       vars.interestAccumulated,
  813 |     |       totalReserves
  814 |     |     );
  815 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  816 |     |       return
  817 |     |         failOpaque(
  818 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
  819 |     |           FailureInfo.ACCRUE_INTEREST_NEW_TOTAL_RESERVES_CALCULATION_FAILED,
  820 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
  821 |     |         );
  822 |     |     }
  823 |     | 
  824 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.borrowIndexNew) = mulScalarTruncateAddUInt(
  825 |     |       vars.simpleInterestFactor,
  826 |     |       borrowIndex,
  827 |     |       borrowIndex
  828 |     |     );
  829 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  830 |     |       return
  831 |     |         failOpaque(
  832 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
  833 |     |           FailureInfo.ACCRUE_INTEREST_NEW_BORROW_INDEX_CALCULATION_FAILED,
  834 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
  835 |     |         );
  836 |     |     }
  837 |     | 
  838 |     |     /////////////////////////
  839 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  840 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  841 |     | 
  842 |     |     /* We write the previously calculated values into storage */
  843 |     |     accrualBlockNumber = vars.currentBlockNumber;
  844 |     |     borrowIndex = vars.borrowIndexNew;
  845 |     |     totalBorrows = vars.totalBorrowsNew;
  846 |     |     totalReserves = vars.totalReservesNew;
  847 |     | 
  848 |     |     /* We emit an AccrueInterest event */
  849 |     |     emit AccrueInterest(
  850 |     |       vars.interestAccumulated,
  851 |     |       vars.borrowIndexNew,
  852 |     |       totalBorrows
  853 |     |     );
  854 |     | 
  855 |     |     return uint(Error.NO_ERROR);
  856 |     |   }
  857 |     | 
  858 |     |   /**
  859 |     |    * @notice Sender supplies assets into the market and receives cTokens in exchange
  860 |     |    * @dev Accrues interest whether or not the operation succeeds, unless reverted
  861 |     |    * @param mintAmount The amount of the underlying asset to supply
  862 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
  863 |     |    */
  864 |     |   function mintInternal(uint mintAmount) internal nonReentrant returns (uint) {
  865 |     |     uint error = accrueInterest();
  866 |     |     if (error != uint(Error.NO_ERROR)) {
  867 |     |       // accrueInterest emits logs on errors, but we still want to log the fact that an attempted borrow failed
  868 |     |       return fail(Error(error), FailureInfo.MINT_ACCRUE_INTEREST_FAILED);
  869 |     |     }
  870 |     |     // mintFresh emits the actual Mint event if successful and logs on errors, so we don't need to
  871 |     |     return mintFresh(msg.sender, mintAmount);
  872 |     |   }
  873 |     | 
  874 |     |   struct MintLocalVars {
  875 |     |     Error err;
  876 |     |     MathError mathErr;
  877 |     |     uint exchangeRateMantissa;
  878 |     |     uint mintTokens;
  879 |     |     uint totalSupplyNew;
  880 |     |     uint accountTokensNew;
  881 |     |   }
  882 |     | 
  883 |     |   /**
  884 |     |    * @notice User supplies assets into the market and receives cTokens in exchange
  885 |     |    * @dev Assumes interest has already been accrued up to the current block
  886 |     |    * @param minter The address of the account which is supplying the assets
  887 |     |    * @param mintAmount The amount of the underlying asset to supply
  888 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
  889 |     |    */
  890 |     |   function mintFresh(address minter, uint mintAmount) internal returns (uint) {
  891 |     |     /* Fail if mint not allowed */
  892 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.mintAllowed(address(this), minter, mintAmount);
  893 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
  894 |     |       return
  895 |     |         failOpaque(
  896 |     |           Error.COMPTROLLER_REJECTION,
  897 |     |           FailureInfo.MINT_COMPTROLLER_REJECTION,
  898 |     |           allowed
  899 |     |         );
  900 |     |     }
  901 |     | 
  902 |     |     /* Verify market's block number equals current block number */
  903 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
  904 |     |       return fail(Error.MARKET_NOT_FRESH, FailureInfo.MINT_FRESHNESS_CHECK);
  905 |     |     }
  906 |     | 
  907 |     |     MintLocalVars memory vars;
  908 |     | 
  909 |     |     /* Fail if checkTransferIn fails */
  910 |     |     vars.err = checkTransferIn(minter, mintAmount);
  911 |     |     if (vars.err != Error.NO_ERROR) {
  912 |     |       return fail(vars.err, FailureInfo.MINT_TRANSFER_IN_NOT_POSSIBLE);
  913 |     |     }
  914 |     | 
  915 |     |     /*
  916 |     |      * We get the current exchange rate and calculate the number of cTokens to be minted:
  917 |     |      *  mintTokens = mintAmount / exchangeRate
  918 |     |      */
  919 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.exchangeRateMantissa) = exchangeRateStoredInternal();
  920 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  921 |     |       return
  922 |     |         failOpaque(
  923 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
  924 |     |           FailureInfo.MINT_EXCHANGE_RATE_READ_FAILED,
  925 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
  926 |     |         );
  927 |     |     }
  928 |     | 
  929 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.mintTokens) = divScalarByExpTruncate(
  930 |     |       mintAmount,
  931 |     |       Exp({mantissa: vars.exchangeRateMantissa})
  932 |     |     );
  933 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  934 |     |       return
  935 |     |         failOpaque(
  936 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
  937 |     |           FailureInfo.MINT_EXCHANGE_CALCULATION_FAILED,
  938 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
  939 |     |         );
  940 |     |     }
  941 |     | 
  942 |     |     /*
  943 |     |      * We calculate the new total supply of cTokens and minter token balance, checking for overflow:
  944 |     |      *  totalSupplyNew = totalSupply + mintTokens
  945 |     |      *  accountTokensNew = accountTokens[minter] + mintTokens
  946 |     |      */
  947 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.totalSupplyNew) = addUInt(totalSupply, vars.mintTokens);
  948 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  949 |     |       return
  950 |     |         failOpaque(
  951 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
  952 |     |           FailureInfo.MINT_NEW_TOTAL_SUPPLY_CALCULATION_FAILED,
  953 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
  954 |     |         );
  955 |     |     }
  956 |     | 
  957 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.accountTokensNew) = addUInt(
  958 |     |       accountTokens[minter],
  959 |     |       vars.mintTokens
  960 |     |     );
  961 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
  962 |     |       return
  963 |     |         failOpaque(
  964 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
  965 |     |           FailureInfo.MINT_NEW_ACCOUNT_BALANCE_CALCULATION_FAILED,
  966 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
  967 |     |         );
  968 |     |     }
  969 |     | 
  970 |     |     /////////////////////////
  971 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  972 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  973 |     | 
  974 |     |     /*
  975 |     |      * We call doTransferIn for the minter and the mintAmount
  976 |     |      *  Note: The cToken must handle variations between ERC-20 and ETH underlying.
  977 |     |      *  On success, the cToken holds an additional mintAmount of cash.
  978 |     |      *  If doTransferIn fails despite the fact we checked pre-conditions,
  979 |     |      *   we revert because we can't be sure if side effects occurred.
  980 |     |      */
  981 |     |     vars.err = doTransferIn(minter, mintAmount);
  982 |     |     if (vars.err != Error.NO_ERROR) {
  983 |     |       return fail(vars.err, FailureInfo.MINT_TRANSFER_IN_FAILED);
  984 |     |     }
  985 |     | 
  986 |     |     /* We write previously calculated values into storage */
  987 |     |     totalSupply = vars.totalSupplyNew;
  988 |     |     accountTokens[minter] = vars.accountTokensNew;
  989 |     | 
  990 |     |     /* We emit a Mint event, and a Transfer event */
  991 |     |     emit Mint(minter, mintAmount, vars.mintTokens);
  992 |     |     emit Transfer(address(this), minter, vars.mintTokens);
  993 |     | 
  994 |     |     /* We call the defense hook */
  995 |     |     comptroller.mintVerify(address(this), minter, mintAmount, vars.mintTokens);
  996 |     | 
  997 |     |     return uint(Error.NO_ERROR);
  998 |     |   }
  999 |     | 
 1000 |     |   /**
 1001 |     |    * @notice Sender redeems cTokens in exchange for the underlying asset
 1002 |     |    * @dev Accrues interest whether or not the operation succeeds, unless reverted
 1003 |     |    * @param redeemTokens The number of cTokens to redeem into underlying
 1004 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
 1005 |     |    */
 1006 |     |   function redeemInternal(
 1007 |     |     uint redeemTokens
 1008 |     |   ) internal nonReentrant returns (uint) {
 1009 |     |     uint error = accrueInterest();
 1010 |     |     if (error != uint(Error.NO_ERROR)) {
 1011 |     |       // accrueInterest emits logs on errors, but we still want to log the fact that an attempted redeem failed
 1012 |     |       return fail(Error(error), FailureInfo.REDEEM_ACCRUE_INTEREST_FAILED);
 1013 |     |     }
 1014 |     |     // redeemFresh emits redeem-specific logs on errors, so we don't need to
 1015 |     |     return redeemFresh(msg.sender, redeemTokens, 0);
 1016 |     |   }
 1017 |     | 
 1018 |     |   /**
 1019 |     |    * @notice Sender redeems cTokens in exchange for a specified amount of underlying asset
 1020 |     |    * @dev Accrues interest whether or not the operation succeeds, unless reverted
 1021 |     |    * @param redeemAmount The amount of underlying to redeem
 1022 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
 1023 |     |    */
 1024 |     |   function redeemUnderlyingInternal(
 1025 |     |     uint redeemAmount
 1026 |     |   ) internal nonReentrant returns (uint) {
 1027 |     |     uint error = accrueInterest();
 1028 |     |     if (error != uint(Error.NO_ERROR)) {
 1029 |     |       // accrueInterest emits logs on errors, but we still want to log the fact that an attempted redeem failed
 1030 |     |       return fail(Error(error), FailureInfo.REDEEM_ACCRUE_INTEREST_FAILED);
 1031 |     |     }
 1032 |     |     // redeemFresh emits redeem-specific logs on errors, so we don't need to
 1033 |     |     return redeemFresh(msg.sender, 0, redeemAmount);
 1034 |     |   }
 1035 |     | 
 1036 |     |   struct RedeemLocalVars {
 1037 |     |     Error err;
 1038 |     |     MathError mathErr;
 1039 |     |     uint exchangeRateMantissa;
 1040 |     |     uint redeemTokens;
 1041 |     |     uint redeemAmount;
 1042 |     |     uint totalSupplyNew;
 1043 |     |     uint accountTokensNew;
 1044 |     |   }
 1045 |     | 
 1046 |     |   /**
 1047 |     |    * @notice User redeems cTokens in exchange for the underlying asset
 1048 |     |    * @dev Assumes interest has already been accrued up to the current block
 1049 |     |    * @param redeemer The address of the account which is redeeming the tokens
 1050 |     |    * @param redeemTokensIn The number of cTokens to redeem into underlying (only one of redeemTokensIn or redeemAmountIn may be zero)
 1051 |     |    * @param redeemAmountIn The number of cTokens to redeem into underlying (only one of redeemTokensIn or redeemAmountIn may be zero)
 1052 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
 1053 |     |    */
 1054 |     |   function redeemFresh(
 1055 |     |     address payable redeemer,
 1056 |     |     uint redeemTokensIn,
 1057 |     |     uint redeemAmountIn
 1058 |     |   ) internal returns (uint) {
 1059 |     |     require(
 1060 |     |       redeemTokensIn == 0 || redeemAmountIn == 0,
 1061 |     |       "one of redeemTokensIn or redeemAmountIn must be zero"
 1062 |     |     );
 1063 |     | 
 1064 |     |     RedeemLocalVars memory vars;
 1065 |     | 
 1066 |     |     /* exchangeRate = invoke Exchange Rate Stored() */
 1067 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.exchangeRateMantissa) = exchangeRateStoredInternal();
 1068 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 1069 |     |       return
 1070 |     |         failOpaque(
 1071 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
 1072 |     |           FailureInfo.REDEEM_EXCHANGE_RATE_READ_FAILED,
 1073 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
 1074 |     |         );
 1075 |     |     }
 1076 |     | 
 1077 |     |     /* If redeemTokensIn > 0: */
 1078 |     |     if (redeemTokensIn > 0) {
 1079 |     |       /*
 1080 |     |        * We calculate the exchange rate and the amount of underlying to be redeemed:
 1081 |     |        *  redeemTokens = redeemTokensIn
 1082 |     |        *  redeemAmount = redeemTokensIn x exchangeRateCurrent
 1083 |     |        */
 1084 |     |       vars.redeemTokens = redeemTokensIn;
 1085 |     | 
 1086 |     |       (vars.mathErr, vars.redeemAmount) = mulScalarTruncate(
 1087 |     |         Exp({mantissa: vars.exchangeRateMantissa}),
 1088 |     |         redeemTokensIn
 1089 |     |       );
 1090 |     |       if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 1091 |     |         return
 1092 |     |           failOpaque(
 1093 |     |             Error.MATH_ERROR,
 1094 |     |             FailureInfo.REDEEM_EXCHANGE_TOKENS_CALCULATION_FAILED,
 1095 |     |             uint(vars.mathErr)
 1096 |     |           );
 1097 |     |       }
 1098 |     |     } else {
 1099 |     |       /*
 1100 |     |        * We get the current exchange rate and calculate the amount to be redeemed:
 1101 |     |        *  redeemTokens = redeemAmountIn / exchangeRate
 1102 |     |        *  redeemAmount = redeemAmountIn
 1103 |     |        */
 1104 |     | 
 1105 |     |       (vars.mathErr, vars.redeemTokens) = divScalarByExpTruncate(
 1106 |     |         redeemAmountIn,
 1107 |     |         Exp({mantissa: vars.exchangeRateMantissa})
 1108 |     |       );
 1109 |     |       if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 1110 |     |         return
 1111 |     |           failOpaque(
 1112 |     |             Error.MATH_ERROR,
 1113 |     |             FailureInfo.REDEEM_EXCHANGE_AMOUNT_CALCULATION_FAILED,
 1114 |     |             uint(vars.mathErr)
 1115 |     |           );
 1116 |     |       }
 1117 |     | 
 1118 |     |       vars.redeemAmount = redeemAmountIn;
 1119 |     |     }
 1120 |     | 
 1121 |     |     /* Fail if redeem not allowed */
 1122 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.redeemAllowed(
 1123 |     |       address(this),
 1124 |     |       redeemer,
 1125 |     |       vars.redeemTokens
 1126 |     |     );
 1127 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
 1128 |     |       return
 1129 |     |         failOpaque(
 1130 |     |           Error.COMPTROLLER_REJECTION,
 1131 |     |           FailureInfo.REDEEM_COMPTROLLER_REJECTION,
 1132 |     |           allowed
 1133 |     |         );
 1134 |     |     }
 1135 |     | 
 1136 |     |     /* Verify market's block number equals current block number */
 1137 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
 1138 |     |       return fail(Error.MARKET_NOT_FRESH, FailureInfo.REDEEM_FRESHNESS_CHECK);
 1139 |     |     }
 1140 |     | 
 1141 |     |     /*
 1142 |     |      * We calculate the new total supply and redeemer balance, checking for underflow:
 1143 |     |      *  totalSupplyNew = totalSupply - redeemTokens
 1144 |     |      *  accountTokensNew = accountTokens[redeemer] - redeemTokens
 1145 |     |      */
 1146 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.totalSupplyNew) = subUInt(
 1147 |     |       totalSupply,
 1148 |     |       vars.redeemTokens
 1149 |     |     );
 1150 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 1151 |     |       return
 1152 |     |         failOpaque(
 1153 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
 1154 |     |           FailureInfo.REDEEM_NEW_TOTAL_SUPPLY_CALCULATION_FAILED,
 1155 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
 1156 |     |         );
 1157 |     |     }
 1158 |     | 
 1159 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.accountTokensNew) = subUInt(
 1160 |     |       accountTokens[redeemer],
 1161 |     |       vars.redeemTokens
 1162 |     |     );
 1163 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 1164 |     |       return
 1165 |     |         failOpaque(
 1166 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
 1167 |     |           FailureInfo.REDEEM_NEW_ACCOUNT_BALANCE_CALCULATION_FAILED,
 1168 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
 1169 |     |         );
 1170 |     |     }
 1171 |     | 
 1172 |     |     /* Fail gracefully if protocol has insufficient cash */
 1173 |     |     if (getCashPrior() < vars.redeemAmount) {
 1174 |     |       return
 1175 |     |         fail(
 1176 |     |           Error.TOKEN_INSUFFICIENT_CASH,
 1177 |     |           FailureInfo.REDEEM_TRANSFER_OUT_NOT_POSSIBLE
 1178 |     |         );
 1179 |     |     }
 1180 |     | 
 1181 |     |     /////////////////////////
 1182 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
 1183 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
 1184 |     | 
 1185 |     |     /*
 1186 |     |      * We invoke doTransferOut for the redeemer and the redeemAmount.
 1187 |     |      *  Note: The cToken must handle variations between ERC-20 and ETH underlying.
 1188 |     |      *  On success, the cToken has redeemAmount less of cash.
 1189 |     |      *  If doTransferOut fails despite the fact we checked pre-conditions,
 1190 |     |      *   we revert because we can't be sure if side effects occurred.
 1191 |     |      */
 1192 |     |     vars.err = doTransferOut(redeemer, vars.redeemAmount);
 1193 |     |     require(vars.err == Error.NO_ERROR, "redeem transfer out failed");
 1194 |     | 
 1195 |     |     /* We write previously calculated values into storage */
 1196 |     |     totalSupply = vars.totalSupplyNew;
 1197 |     |     accountTokens[redeemer] = vars.accountTokensNew;
 1198 |     | 
 1199 |     |     /* We emit a Transfer event, and a Redeem event */
 1200 |     |     emit Transfer(redeemer, address(this), vars.redeemTokens);
 1201 |     |     emit Redeem(redeemer, vars.redeemAmount, vars.redeemTokens);
 1202 |     | 
 1203 |     |     /* We call the defense hook */
 1204 |     |     comptroller.redeemVerify(
 1205 |     |       address(this),
 1206 |     |       redeemer,
 1207 |     |       vars.redeemAmount,
 1208 |     |       vars.redeemTokens
 1209 |     |     );
 1210 |     | 
 1211 |     |     return uint(Error.NO_ERROR);
 1212 |     |   }
 1213 |     | 
 1214 |     |   /**
 1215 |     |    * @notice Sender borrows assets from the protocol to their own address
 1216 |     |    * @param borrowAmount The amount of the underlying asset to borrow
 1217 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
 1218 |     |    */
 1219 |     |   function borrowInternal(
 1220 |     |     uint borrowAmount
 1221 |     |   ) internal nonReentrant returns (uint) {
 1222 |     |     uint error = accrueInterest();
 1223 |     |     if (error != uint(Error.NO_ERROR)) {
 1224 |     |       // accrueInterest emits logs on errors, but we still want to log the fact that an attempted borrow failed
 1225 |     |       return fail(Error(error), FailureInfo.BORROW_ACCRUE_INTEREST_FAILED);
 1226 |     |     }
 1227 |     |     // borrowFresh emits borrow-specific logs on errors, so we don't need to
 1228 |     |     return borrowFresh(msg.sender, borrowAmount);
 1229 |     |   }
 1230 |     | 
 1231 |     |   struct BorrowLocalVars {
 1232 |     |     Error err;
 1233 |     |     MathError mathErr;
 1234 |     |     uint accountBorrows;
 1235 |     |     uint accountBorrowsNew;
 1236 |     |     uint totalBorrowsNew;
 1237 |     |   }
 1238 |     | 
 1239 |     |   /**
 1240 |     |    * @notice Users borrow assets from the protocol to their own address
 1241 |     |    * @param borrowAmount The amount of the underlying asset to borrow
 1242 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
 1243 |     |    */
 1244 |     |   function borrowFresh(
 1245 |     |     address payable borrower,
 1246 |     |     uint borrowAmount
 1247 |     |   ) internal returns (uint) {
 1248 |     |     /* Fail if borrow not allowed */
 1249 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.borrowAllowed(
 1250 |     |       address(this),
 1251 |     |       borrower,
 1252 |     |       borrowAmount
 1253 |     |     );
 1254 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
 1255 |     |       return
 1256 |     |         failOpaque(
 1257 |     |           Error.COMPTROLLER_REJECTION,
 1258 |     |           FailureInfo.BORROW_COMPTROLLER_REJECTION,
 1259 |     |           allowed
 1260 |     |         );
 1261 |     |     }
 1262 |     | 
 1263 |     |     /* Verify market's block number equals current block number */
 1264 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
 1265 |     |       return fail(Error.MARKET_NOT_FRESH, FailureInfo.BORROW_FRESHNESS_CHECK);
 1266 |     |     }
 1267 |     | 
 1268 |     |     /* Fail gracefully if protocol has insufficient underlying cash */
 1269 |     |     if (getCashPrior() < borrowAmount) {
 1270 |     |       return
 1271 |     |         fail(
 1272 |     |           Error.TOKEN_INSUFFICIENT_CASH,
 1273 |     |           FailureInfo.BORROW_CASH_NOT_AVAILABLE
 1274 |     |         );
 1275 |     |     }
 1276 |     | 
 1277 |     |     BorrowLocalVars memory vars;
 1278 |     | 
 1279 |     |     /*
 1280 |     |      * We calculate the new borrower and total borrow balances, failing on overflow:
 1281 |     |      *  accountBorrowsNew = accountBorrows + borrowAmount
 1282 |     |      *  totalBorrowsNew = totalBorrows + borrowAmount
 1283 |     |      */
 1284 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.accountBorrows) = borrowBalanceStoredInternal(borrower);
 1285 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 1286 |     |       return
 1287 |     |         failOpaque(
 1288 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
 1289 |     |           FailureInfo.BORROW_ACCUMULATED_BALANCE_CALCULATION_FAILED,
 1290 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
 1291 |     |         );
 1292 |     |     }
 1293 |     | 
 1294 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.accountBorrowsNew) = addUInt(
 1295 |     |       vars.accountBorrows,
 1296 |     |       borrowAmount
 1297 |     |     );
 1298 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 1299 |     |       return
 1300 |     |         failOpaque(
 1301 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
 1302 |     |           FailureInfo.BORROW_NEW_ACCOUNT_BORROW_BALANCE_CALCULATION_FAILED,
 1303 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
 1304 |     |         );
 1305 |     |     }
 1306 |     | 
 1307 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.totalBorrowsNew) = addUInt(totalBorrows, borrowAmount);
 1308 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 1309 |     |       return
 1310 |     |         failOpaque(
 1311 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
 1312 |     |           FailureInfo.BORROW_NEW_TOTAL_BALANCE_CALCULATION_FAILED,
 1313 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
 1314 |     |         );
 1315 |     |     }
 1316 |     | 
 1317 |     |     /////////////////////////
 1318 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
 1319 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
 1320 |     | 
 1321 |     |     /*
 1322 |     |      * We invoke doTransferOut for the borrower and the borrowAmount.
 1323 |     |      *  Note: The cToken must handle variations between ERC-20 and ETH underlying.
 1324 |     |      *  On success, the cToken borrowAmount less of cash.
 1325 |     |      *  If doTransferOut fails despite the fact we checked pre-conditions,
 1326 |     |      *   we revert because we can't be sure if side effects occurred.
 1327 |     |      */
 1328 |     |     vars.err = doTransferOut(borrower, borrowAmount);
 1329 |     |     require(vars.err == Error.NO_ERROR, "borrow transfer out failed");
 1330 |     | 
 1331 |     |     /* We write the previously calculated values into storage */
 1332 |     |     accountBorrows[borrower].principal = vars.accountBorrowsNew;
 1333 |     |     accountBorrows[borrower].interestIndex = borrowIndex;
 1334 |     |     totalBorrows = vars.totalBorrowsNew;
 1335 |     | 
 1336 |     |     /* We emit a Borrow event */
 1337 |     |     emit Borrow(
 1338 |     |       borrower,
 1339 |     |       borrowAmount,
 1340 |     |       vars.accountBorrowsNew,
 1341 |     |       vars.totalBorrowsNew
 1342 |     |     );
 1343 |     | 
 1344 |     |     /* We call the defense hook */
 1345 |     |     comptroller.borrowVerify(address(this), borrower, borrowAmount);
 1346 |     | 
 1347 |     |     return uint(Error.NO_ERROR);
 1348 |     |   }
 1349 |     | 
 1350 |     |   /**
 1351 |     |    * @notice Sender repays their own borrow
 1352 |     |    * @param repayAmount The amount to repay
 1353 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
 1354 |     |    */
 1355 |     |   function repayBorrowInternal(
 1356 |     |     uint repayAmount
 1357 |     |   ) internal nonReentrant returns (uint) {
 1358 |     |     uint error = accrueInterest();
 1359 |     |     if (error != uint(Error.NO_ERROR)) {
 1360 |     |       // accrueInterest emits logs on errors, but we still want to log the fact that an attempted borrow failed
 1361 |     |       return
 1362 |     |         fail(Error(error), FailureInfo.REPAY_BORROW_ACCRUE_INTEREST_FAILED);
 1363 |     |     }
 1364 |     |     // repayBorrowFresh emits repay-borrow-specific logs on errors, so we don't need to
 1365 |     |     return repayBorrowFresh(msg.sender, msg.sender, repayAmount);
 1366 |     |   }
 1367 |     | 
 1368 |     |   /**
 1369 |     |    * @notice Sender repays a borrow belonging to borrower
 1370 |     |    * @param borrower the account with the debt being payed off
 1371 |     |    * @param repayAmount The amount to repay
 1372 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
 1373 |     |    */
 1374 |     |   function repayBorrowBehalfInternal(
 1375 |     |     address borrower,
 1376 |     |     uint repayAmount
 1377 |     |   ) internal nonReentrant returns (uint) {
 1378 |     |     uint error = accrueInterest();
 1379 |     |     if (error != uint(Error.NO_ERROR)) {
 1380 |     |       // accrueInterest emits logs on errors, but we still want to log the fact that an attempted borrow failed
 1381 |     |       return
 1382 |     |         fail(Error(error), FailureInfo.REPAY_BEHALF_ACCRUE_INTEREST_FAILED);
 1383 |     |     }
 1384 |     |     // repayBorrowFresh emits repay-borrow-specific logs on errors, so we don't need to
 1385 |     |     return repayBorrowFresh(msg.sender, borrower, repayAmount);
 1386 |     |   }
 1387 |     | 
 1388 |     |   struct RepayBorrowLocalVars {
 1389 |     |     Error err;
 1390 |     |     MathError mathErr;
 1391 |     |     uint repayAmount;
 1392 |     |     uint borrowerIndex;
 1393 |     |     uint accountBorrows;
 1394 |     |     uint accountBorrowsNew;
 1395 |     |     uint totalBorrowsNew;
 1396 |     |   }
 1397 |     | 
 1398 |     |   /**
 1399 |     |    * @notice Borrows are repaid by another user (possibly the borrower).
 1400 |     |    * @param payer the account paying off the borrow
 1401 |     |    * @param borrower the account with the debt being payed off
 1402 |     |    * @param repayAmount the amount of undelrying tokens being returned
 1403 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
 1404 |     |    */
 1405 |     |   function repayBorrowFresh(
 1406 |     |     address payer,
 1407 |     |     address borrower,
 1408 |     |     uint repayAmount
 1409 |     |   ) internal returns (uint) {
 1410 |     |     /* Fail if repayBorrow not allowed */
 1411 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.repayBorrowAllowed(
 1412 |     |       address(this),
 1413 |     |       payer,
 1414 |     |       borrower,
 1415 |     |       repayAmount
 1416 |     |     );
 1417 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
 1418 |     |       return
 1419 |     |         failOpaque(
 1420 |     |           Error.COMPTROLLER_REJECTION,
 1421 |     |           FailureInfo.REPAY_BORROW_COMPTROLLER_REJECTION,
 1422 |     |           allowed
 1423 |     |         );
 1424 |     |     }
 1425 |     | 
 1426 |     |     /* Verify market's block number equals current block number */
 1427 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
 1428 |     |       return
 1429 |     |         fail(Error.MARKET_NOT_FRESH, FailureInfo.REPAY_BORROW_FRESHNESS_CHECK);
 1430 |     |     }
 1431 |     | 
 1432 |     |     RepayBorrowLocalVars memory vars;
 1433 |     | 
 1434 |     |     /* We remember the original borrowerIndex for verification purposes */
 1435 |     |     vars.borrowerIndex = accountBorrows[borrower].interestIndex;
 1436 |     | 
 1437 |     |     /* We fetch the amount the borrower owes, with accumulated interest */
 1438 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.accountBorrows) = borrowBalanceStoredInternal(borrower);
 1439 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 1440 |     |       return
 1441 |     |         failOpaque(
 1442 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
 1443 |     |           FailureInfo.REPAY_BORROW_ACCUMULATED_BALANCE_CALCULATION_FAILED,
 1444 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
 1445 |     |         );
 1446 |     |     }
 1447 |     | 
 1448 |     |     /* If repayAmount == -1, repayAmount = accountBorrows */
 1449 |     |     if (repayAmount == uint(-1)) {
 1450 |     |       vars.repayAmount = vars.accountBorrows;
 1451 |     |     } else {
 1452 |     |       vars.repayAmount = repayAmount;
 1453 |     |     }
 1454 |     | 
 1455 |     |     /* Fail if checkTransferIn fails */
 1456 |     |     vars.err = checkTransferIn(payer, vars.repayAmount);
 1457 |     |     if (vars.err != Error.NO_ERROR) {
 1458 |     |       return fail(vars.err, FailureInfo.REPAY_BORROW_TRANSFER_IN_NOT_POSSIBLE);
 1459 |     |     }
 1460 |     | 
 1461 |     |     /*
 1462 |     |      * We calculate the new borrower and total borrow balances, failing on underflow:
 1463 |     |      *  accountBorrowsNew = accountBorrows - repayAmount
 1464 |     |      *  totalBorrowsNew = totalBorrows - repayAmount
 1465 |     |      */
 1466 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.accountBorrowsNew) = subUInt(
 1467 |     |       vars.accountBorrows,
 1468 |     |       vars.repayAmount
 1469 |     |     );
 1470 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 1471 |     |       return
 1472 |     |         failOpaque(
 1473 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
 1474 |     |           FailureInfo
 1475 |     |             .REPAY_BORROW_NEW_ACCOUNT_BORROW_BALANCE_CALCULATION_FAILED,
 1476 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
 1477 |     |         );
 1478 |     |     }
 1479 |     | 
 1480 |     |     (vars.mathErr, vars.totalBorrowsNew) = subUInt(
 1481 |     |       totalBorrows,
 1482 |     |       vars.repayAmount
 1483 |     |     );
 1484 |     |     if (vars.mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 1485 |     |       return
 1486 |     |         failOpaque(
 1487 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
 1488 |     |           FailureInfo.REPAY_BORROW_NEW_TOTAL_BALANCE_CALCULATION_FAILED,
 1489 |     |           uint(vars.mathErr)
 1490 |     |         );
 1491 |     |     }
 1492 |     | 
 1493 |     |     /////////////////////////
 1494 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
 1495 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
 1496 |     | 
 1497 |     |     /*
 1498 |     |      * We call doTransferIn for the payer and the repayAmount
 1499 |     |      *  Note: The cToken must handle variations between ERC-20 and ETH underlying.
 1500 |     |      *  On success, the cToken holds an additional repayAmount of cash.
 1501 |     |      *  If doTransferIn fails despite the fact we checked pre-conditions,
 1502 |     |      *   we revert because we can't be sure if side effects occurred.
 1503 |     |      */
 1504 |     |     vars.err = doTransferIn(payer, vars.repayAmount);
 1505 |     |     require(vars.err == Error.NO_ERROR, "repay borrow transfer in failed");
 1506 |     | 
 1507 |     |     /* We write the previously calculated values into storage */
 1508 |     |     accountBorrows[borrower].principal = vars.accountBorrowsNew;
 1509 |     |     accountBorrows[borrower].interestIndex = borrowIndex;
 1510 |     |     totalBorrows = vars.totalBorrowsNew;
 1511 |     | 
 1512 |     |     /* We emit a RepayBorrow event */
 1513 |     |     emit RepayBorrow(
 1514 |     |       payer,
 1515 |     |       borrower,
 1516 |     |       vars.repayAmount,
 1517 |     |       vars.accountBorrowsNew,
 1518 |     |       vars.totalBorrowsNew
 1519 |     |     );
 1520 |     | 
 1521 |     |     /* We call the defense hook */
 1522 |     |     comptroller.repayBorrowVerify(
 1523 |     |       address(this),
 1524 |     |       payer,
 1525 |     |       borrower,
 1526 |     |       vars.repayAmount,
 1527 |     |       vars.borrowerIndex
 1528 |     |     );
 1529 |     | 
 1530 |     |     return uint(Error.NO_ERROR);
 1531 |     |   }
 1532 |     | 
 1533 |     |   /**
 1534 |     |    * @notice The sender liquidates the borrowers collateral.
 1535 |     |    *  The collateral seized is transferred to the liquidator.
 1536 |     |    * @param borrower The borrower of this cToken to be liquidated
 1537 |     |    * @param cTokenCollateral The market in which to seize collateral from the borrower
 1538 |     |    * @param repayAmount The amount of the underlying borrowed asset to repay
 1539 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
 1540 |     |    */
 1541 |     |   function liquidateBorrowInternal(
 1542 |     |     address borrower,
 1543 |     |     uint repayAmount,
 1544 |     |     CToken cTokenCollateral
 1545 |     |   ) internal nonReentrant returns (uint) {
 1546 |     |     uint error = accrueInterest();
 1547 |     |     if (error != uint(Error.NO_ERROR)) {
 1548 |     |       // accrueInterest emits logs on errors, but we still want to log the fact that an attempted liquidation failed
 1549 |     |       return
 1550 |     |         fail(Error(error), FailureInfo.LIQUIDATE_ACCRUE_BORROW_INTEREST_FAILED);
 1551 |     |     }
 1552 |     | 
 1553 |     |     error = cTokenCollateral.accrueInterest();
 1554 |     |     if (error != uint(Error.NO_ERROR)) {
 1555 |     |       // accrueInterest emits logs on errors, but we still want to log the fact that an attempted liquidation failed
 1556 |     |       return
 1557 |     |         fail(
 1558 |     |           Error(error),
 1559 |     |           FailureInfo.LIQUIDATE_ACCRUE_COLLATERAL_INTEREST_FAILED
 1560 |     |         );
 1561 |     |     }
 1562 |     | 
 1563 |     |     // liquidateBorrowFresh emits borrow-specific logs on errors, so we don't need to
 1564 |     |     return
 1565 |     |       liquidateBorrowFresh(msg.sender, borrower, repayAmount, cTokenCollateral);
 1566 |     |   }
 1567 |     | 
 1568 |     |   /**
 1569 |     |    * @notice The liquidator liquidates the borrowers collateral.
 1570 |     |    *  The collateral seized is transferred to the liquidator.
 1571 |     |    * @param borrower The borrower of this cToken to be liquidated
 1572 |     |    * @param liquidator The address repaying the borrow and seizing collateral
 1573 |     |    * @param cTokenCollateral The market in which to seize collateral from the borrower
 1574 |     |    * @param repayAmount The amount of the underlying borrowed asset to repay
 1575 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
 1576 |     |    */
 1577 |     |   function liquidateBorrowFresh(
 1578 |     |     address liquidator,
 1579 |     |     address borrower,
 1580 |     |     uint repayAmount,
 1581 |     |     CToken cTokenCollateral
 1582 |     |   ) internal returns (uint) {
 1583 |     |     /* Fail if liquidate not allowed */
 1584 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.liquidateBorrowAllowed(
 1585 |     |       address(this),
 1586 |     |       address(cTokenCollateral),
 1587 |     |       liquidator,
 1588 |     |       borrower,
 1589 |     |       repayAmount
 1590 |     |     );
 1591 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
 1592 |     |       return
 1593 |     |         failOpaque(
 1594 |     |           Error.COMPTROLLER_REJECTION,
 1595 |     |           FailureInfo.LIQUIDATE_COMPTROLLER_REJECTION,
 1596 |     |           allowed
 1597 |     |         );
 1598 |     |     }
 1599 |     | 
 1600 |     |     /* Verify market's block number equals current block number */
 1601 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
 1602 |     |       return
 1603 |     |         fail(Error.MARKET_NOT_FRESH, FailureInfo.LIQUIDATE_FRESHNESS_CHECK);
 1604 |     |     }
 1605 |     | 
 1606 |     |     /* Verify cTokenCollateral market's block number equals current block number */
 1607 |     |     if (cTokenCollateral.accrualBlockNumber() != getBlockNumber()) {
 1608 |     |       return
 1609 |     |         fail(
 1610 |     |           Error.MARKET_NOT_FRESH,
 1611 |     |           FailureInfo.LIQUIDATE_COLLATERAL_FRESHNESS_CHECK
 1612 |     |         );
 1613 |     |     }
 1614 |     | 
 1615 |     |     /* Fail if borrower = liquidator */
 1616 |     |     if (borrower == liquidator) {
 1617 |     |       return
 1618 |     |         fail(
 1619 |     |           Error.INVALID_ACCOUNT_PAIR,
 1620 |     |           FailureInfo.LIQUIDATE_LIQUIDATOR_IS_BORROWER
 1621 |     |         );
 1622 |     |     }
 1623 |     | 
 1624 |     |     /* Fail if repayAmount = 0 */
 1625 |     |     if (repayAmount == 0) {
 1626 |     |       return
 1627 |     |         fail(
 1628 |     |           Error.INVALID_CLOSE_AMOUNT_REQUESTED,
 1629 |     |           FailureInfo.LIQUIDATE_CLOSE_AMOUNT_IS_ZERO
 1630 |     |         );
 1631 |     |     }
 1632 |     | 
 1633 |     |     /* Fail if repayAmount = -1 */
 1634 |     |     if (repayAmount == uint(-1)) {
 1635 |     |       return
 1636 |     |         fail(
 1637 |     |           Error.INVALID_CLOSE_AMOUNT_REQUESTED,
 1638 |     |           FailureInfo.LIQUIDATE_CLOSE_AMOUNT_IS_UINT_MAX
 1639 |     |         );
 1640 |     |     }
 1641 |     | 
 1642 |     |     /* We calculate the number of collateral tokens that will be seized */
 1643 |     |     (uint amountSeizeError, uint seizeTokens) = comptroller
 1644 |     |       .liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens(
 1645 |     |         address(this),
 1646 |     |         address(cTokenCollateral),
 1647 |     |         repayAmount
 1648 |     |       );
 1649 |     |     if (amountSeizeError != 0) {
 1650 |     |       return
 1651 |     |         failOpaque(
 1652 |     |           Error.COMPTROLLER_CALCULATION_ERROR,
 1653 |     |           FailureInfo.LIQUIDATE_COMPTROLLER_CALCULATE_AMOUNT_SEIZE_FAILED,
 1654 |     |           amountSeizeError
 1655 |     |         );
 1656 |     |     }
 1657 |     | 
 1658 |     |     /* Fail if seizeTokens > borrower collateral token balance */
 1659 |     |     if (seizeTokens > cTokenCollateral.balanceOf(borrower)) {
 1660 |     |       return
 1661 |     |         fail(
 1662 |     |           Error.TOKEN_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE,
 1663 |     |           FailureInfo.LIQUIDATE_SEIZE_TOO_MUCH
 1664 |     |         );
 1665 |     |     }
 1666 |     | 
 1667 |     |     /* Fail if repayBorrow fails */
 1668 |     |     uint repayBorrowError = repayBorrowFresh(liquidator, borrower, repayAmount);
 1669 |     |     if (repayBorrowError != uint(Error.NO_ERROR)) {
 1670 |     |       return
 1671 |     |         fail(
 1672 |     |           Error(repayBorrowError),
 1673 |     |           FailureInfo.LIQUIDATE_REPAY_BORROW_FRESH_FAILED
 1674 |     |         );
 1675 |     |     }
 1676 |     | 
 1677 |     |     /* Revert if seize tokens fails (since we cannot be sure of side effects) */
 1678 |     |     uint seizeError = cTokenCollateral.seize(liquidator, borrower, seizeTokens);
 1679 |     |     require(seizeError == uint(Error.NO_ERROR), "token seizure failed");
 1680 |     | 
 1681 |     |     /* We emit a LiquidateBorrow event */
 1682 |     |     emit LiquidateBorrow(
 1683 |     |       liquidator,
 1684 |     |       borrower,
 1685 |     |       repayAmount,
 1686 |     |       address(cTokenCollateral),
 1687 |     |       seizeTokens
 1688 |     |     );
 1689 |     | 
 1690 |     |     /* We call the defense hook */
 1691 |     |     comptroller.liquidateBorrowVerify(
 1692 |     |       address(this),
 1693 |     |       address(cTokenCollateral),
 1694 |     |       liquidator,
 1695 |     |       borrower,
 1696 |     |       repayAmount,
 1697 |     |       seizeTokens
 1698 |     |     );
 1699 |     | 
 1700 |     |     return uint(Error.NO_ERROR);
 1701 |     |   }
 1702 |     | 
 1703 |     |   /**
 1704 |     |    * @notice Transfers collateral tokens (this market) to the liquidator.
 1705 |     |    * @dev Will fail unless called by another cToken during the process of liquidation.
 1706 |     |    *  Its absolutely critical to use msg.sender as the borrowed cToken and not a parameter.
 1707 |     |    * @param liquidator The account receiving seized collateral
 1708 |     |    * @param borrower The account having collateral seized
 1709 |     |    * @param seizeTokens The number of cTokens to seize
 1710 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
 1711 |     |    */
 1712 |     |   function seize(
 1713 |     |     address liquidator,
 1714 |     |     address borrower,
 1715 |     |     uint seizeTokens
 1716 |     |   ) external nonReentrant returns (uint) {
 1717 |     |     /* Fail if seize not allowed */
 1718 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.seizeAllowed(
 1719 |     |       address(this),
 1720 |     |       msg.sender,
 1721 |     |       liquidator,
 1722 |     |       borrower,
 1723 |     |       seizeTokens
 1724 |     |     );
 1725 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
 1726 |     |       return
 1727 |     |         failOpaque(
 1728 |     |           Error.COMPTROLLER_REJECTION,
 1729 |     |           FailureInfo.LIQUIDATE_SEIZE_COMPTROLLER_REJECTION,
 1730 |     |           allowed
 1731 |     |         );
 1732 |     |     }
 1733 |     | 
 1734 |     |     /* Fail if borrower = liquidator */
 1735 |     |     if (borrower == liquidator) {
 1736 |     |       return
 1737 |     |         fail(
 1738 |     |           Error.INVALID_ACCOUNT_PAIR,
 1739 |     |           FailureInfo.LIQUIDATE_SEIZE_LIQUIDATOR_IS_BORROWER
 1740 |     |         );
 1741 |     |     }
 1742 |     | 
 1743 |     |     MathError mathErr;
 1744 |     |     uint borrowerTokensNew;
 1745 |     |     uint liquidatorTokensNew;
 1746 |     | 
 1747 |     |     /*
 1748 |     |      * We calculate the new borrower and liquidator token balances, failing on underflow/overflow:
 1749 |     |      *  borrowerTokensNew = accountTokens[borrower] - seizeTokens
 1750 |     |      *  liquidatorTokensNew = accountTokens[liquidator] + seizeTokens
 1751 |     |      */
 1752 |     |     (mathErr, borrowerTokensNew) = subUInt(
 1753 |     |       accountTokens[borrower],
 1754 |     |       seizeTokens
 1755 |     |     );
 1756 |     |     if (mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 1757 |     |       return
 1758 |     |         failOpaque(
 1759 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
 1760 |     |           FailureInfo.LIQUIDATE_SEIZE_BALANCE_DECREMENT_FAILED,
 1761 |     |           uint(mathErr)
 1762 |     |         );
 1763 |     |     }
 1764 |     | 
 1765 |     |     (mathErr, liquidatorTokensNew) = addUInt(
 1766 |     |       accountTokens[liquidator],
 1767 |     |       seizeTokens
 1768 |     |     );
 1769 |     |     if (mathErr != MathError.NO_ERROR) {
 1770 |     |       return
 1771 |     |         failOpaque(
 1772 |     |           Error.MATH_ERROR,
 1773 |     |           FailureInfo.LIQUIDATE_SEIZE_BALANCE_INCREMENT_FAILED,
 1774 |     |           uint(mathErr)
 1775 |     |         );
 1776 |     |     }
 1777 |     | 
 1778 |     |     /////////////////////////
 1779 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
 1780 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
 1781 |     | 
 1782 |     |     /* We write the previously calculated values into storage */
 1783 |     |     accountTokens[borrower] = borrowerTokensNew;
 1784 |     |     accountTokens[liquidator] = liquidatorTokensNew;
 1785 |     | 
 1786 |     |     /* Emit a Transfer event */
 1787 |     |     emit Transfer(borrower, liquidator, seizeTokens);
 1788 |     | 
 1789 |     |     /* We call the defense hook */
 1790 |     |     comptroller.seizeVerify(
 1791 |     |       address(this),
 1792 |     |       msg.sender,
 1793 |     |       liquidator,
 1794 |     |       borrower,
 1795 |     |       seizeTokens
 1796 |     |     );
 1797 |     | 
 1798 |     |     return uint(Error.NO_ERROR);
 1799 |     |   }

 1962 |     |   /**
 1963 |     |    * @notice Reduces reserves by transferring to admin
 1964 |     |    * @dev Requires fresh interest accrual
 1965 |     |    * @param reduceAmount Amount of reduction to reserves
 1966 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
 1967 |     |    */
 1968 |     |   function _reduceReservesFresh(uint reduceAmount) internal returns (uint) {
 1969 |     |     Error err;
 1970 |     |     // totalReserves - reduceAmount
 1971 |     |     uint totalReservesNew;
 1972 |     | 
 1973 |     |     // Check caller is admin
 1974 |     |     if (msg.sender != admin) {
 1975 |     |       return fail(Error.UNAUTHORIZED, FailureInfo.REDUCE_RESERVES_ADMIN_CHECK);
 1976 |     |     }
 1977 |     | 
 1978 |     |     // We fail gracefully unless market's block number equals current block number
 1979 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
 1980 |     |       // TODO: static_assert + no error code?
 1981 |     |       return
 1982 |     |         fail(Error.MARKET_NOT_FRESH, FailureInfo.REDUCE_RESERVES_FRESH_CHECK);
 1983 |     |     }
 1984 |     | 
 1985 |     |     // Fail gracefully if protocol has insufficient underlying cash
 1986 |     |     if (getCashPrior() < reduceAmount) {
 1987 |     |       return
 1988 |     |         fail(
 1989 |     |           Error.TOKEN_INSUFFICIENT_CASH,
 1990 |     |           FailureInfo.REDUCE_RESERVES_CASH_NOT_AVAILABLE
 1991 |     |         );
 1992 |     |     }
 1993 |     | 
 1994 |     |     // Check reduceAmount ≤ reserves[n] (totalReserves)
 1995 |     |     // TODO: I'm following the spec literally here but I think we should we just use SafeMath instead and fail on an error (which would be underflow)
 1996 |     |     if (reduceAmount > totalReserves) {
 1997 |     |       return fail(Error.BAD_INPUT, FailureInfo.REDUCE_RESERVES_VALIDATION);
 1998 |     |     }
 1999 |     | 
 2000 |     |     /////////////////////////
 2001 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
 2002 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
 2003 |     | 
 2004 |     |     totalReservesNew = totalReserves - reduceAmount;
 2005 |     |     // We checked reduceAmount <= totalReserves above, so this should never revert.
 2006 |     |     require(
 2007 |     |       totalReservesNew <= totalReserves,
 2008 |     |       "reduce reserves unexpected underflow"
 2009 |     |     );
 2010 |     | 
 2011 |     |     // Store reserves[n+1] = reserves[n] - reduceAmount
 2012 |     |     totalReserves = totalReservesNew;
 2013 |     | 
 2014 |     |     // invoke doTransferOut(reduceAmount, admin)
 2015 |     |     err = doTransferOut(admin, reduceAmount);
 2016 |     |     // we revert on the failure of this command
 2017 |     |     require(err == Error.NO_ERROR, "reduce reserves transfer out failed");
 2018 |     | 
 2019 |     |     emit ReservesReduced(admin, reduceAmount, totalReservesNew);
 2020 |     | 
 2021 |     |     return uint(Error.NO_ERROR);
 2022 |     |   }

  679 |     |     string memory symbol_,
  680 |     |     uint8 decimals_,
  681 |     |     address payable admin_,
  682 |     |     address implementation_,
  683 |     |     address kycRegistry_,
  684 |     |     uint256 kycRequirementGroup_,
  685 |     |     bytes memory becomeImplementationData
  686 |     |   ) public {
  687 |     |     // Creator of the contract is admin during initialization
  688 |     |     admin = msg.sender;
  689 |     | 
  690 |     |     // First delegate gets to initialize the delegator (i.e. storage contract)
  691 |     |     delegateTo(
  692 |     |       implementation_,
  693 |     |       abi.encodeWithSignature(
  694 |     |         "initialize(address,address,address,uint256,string,string,uint8,address,uint256)",
  695 |     |         underlying_,
  696 |     |         comptroller_,
  697 |     |         interestRateModel_,
  698 |     |         initialExchangeRateMantissa_,
  699 |     |         name_,
  700 |     |         symbol_,
  701 |     |         decimals_,
  702 |     |         kycRegistry_,
  703 |     |         kycRequirementGroup_
  704 |     |       )
  705 |     |     );
  706 |     | 
  707 |     |     // New implementations always get set via the settor (post-initialize)
  708 |     |     _setImplementation(implementation_, false, becomeImplementationData);
  709 |     | 
  710 |     |     // Set the proper admin now that initialization is done
  711 |     |     admin = admin_;
  712 |     |   }
  713 |     | 
  714 |     |   /**
  715 |     |    * @notice Called by the admin to update the implementation of the delegator
  716 |     |    * @param implementation_ The address of the new implementation for delegation
  717 |     |    * @param allowResign Flag to indicate whether to call _resignImplementation on the old implementation
  718 |     |    * @param becomeImplementationData The encoded bytes data to be passed to _becomeImplementation
  719 |     |    */
  720 |     |   function _setImplementation(
  721 |     |     address implementation_,
  722 |     |     bool allowResign,
  723 |     |     bytes memory becomeImplementationData
  724 |     |   ) public {
  725 |     |     require(
  726 |     |       msg.sender == admin,
  727 |     |       "CErc20Delegator::_setImplementation: Caller must be admin"
  728 |     |     );
  729 |     | 
  730 |     |     if (allowResign) {
  731 |     |       delegateToImplementation(
  732 |     |         abi.encodeWithSignature("_resignImplementation()")
  733 |     |       );
  734 |     |     }
  735 |     | 
  736 |     |     address oldImplementation = implementation;
  737 |     |     implementation = implementation_;
  738 |     | 
  739 |     |     delegateToImplementation(
  740 |     |       abi.encodeWithSignature(
  741 |     |         "_becomeImplementation(bytes)",
  742 |     |         becomeImplementationData
  743 |     |       )
  744 |     |     );
  745 |     | 
  746 |     |     emit NewImplementation(oldImplementation, implementation);
  747 |     |   }
  748 |     | 
  749 |     |   /**
  750 |     |    * @notice Sender supplies assets into the market and receives cTokens in exchange
  751 |     |    * @dev Accrues interest whether or not the operation succeeds, unless reverted
  752 |     |    * @param mintAmount The amount of the underlying asset to supply
  753 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)

  9 |     |  * @dev Provides counters that can only be incremented, decremented or reset. This can be used e.g. to track the number
 10 |     |  * of elements in a mapping, issuing ERC721 ids, or counting request ids.

 17 |     |     // the library's function. As of Solidity v0.5.2, this cannot be enforced, though there is a proposal to add

 19 |     |     uint256 _value; // default: 0
 20 |     |   }
