/home/user/2023-01-ondo/contracts/lending/ondo/ondo-token/LinearTimelock.sol
   1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0
   2 |     | pragma solidity >=0.8.3;
   3 |     | 
   4 |     | import "contracts/lending/ondo/ondo-token/IOndo.sol";
   5 |     | 
   6 |     | abstract contract LinearTimelock {
   7 |     |   struct InvestorParam {
   8 |     |     IOndo.InvestorType investorType;
   9 |     |     uint96 initialBalance;
  10 |     |   }
  11 |     | 
  12 |     |   /// @notice the timestamp at which releasing is allowed
  13 |     |   uint256 public cliffTimestamp;
  14 |     |   /// @notice the linear vesting period for the first tranche
  15 |     |   uint256 public immutable tranche1VestingPeriod;
  16 |     |   /// @notice the linear vesting period for the second tranche
  17 |     |   uint256 public immutable tranche2VestingPeriod;
  18 |     |   /// @notice the linear vesting period for the Seed/Series A Tranche
  19 |     |   uint256 public immutable seedVestingPeriod;
  20 |     |   /// @dev mapping of balances for each investor
  21 |     |   mapping(address => InvestorParam) internal investorBalances;
  22 |     |   /// @notice role that allows updating of tranche balances - granted to Merkle airdrop contract
  23 |     |   bytes32 public constant TIMELOCK_UPDATE_ROLE =
  24 |     |     keccak256("TIMELOCK_UPDATE_ROLE");
  25 |     | 
  26 |     |   constructor(
  27 |     |     uint256 _cliffTimestamp,
  28 |     |     uint256 _tranche1VestingPeriod,
  29 |     |     uint256 _tranche2VestingPeriod,
  30 |     |     uint256 _seedVestingPeriod
  31 |     |   ) {
  32 |     |     cliffTimestamp = _cliffTimestamp;
  33 |     |     tranche1VestingPeriod = _tranche1VestingPeriod;
  34 |     |     tranche2VestingPeriod = _tranche2VestingPeriod;
  35 |     |     seedVestingPeriod = _seedVestingPeriod;
  36 |     |   }
  37 |     | 
  38 |     |   function passedCliff() public view returns (bool) {
  39 |     |     return block.timestamp > cliffTimestamp;
  40 |     |   }
  41 |     | 
  42 |     |   /// @dev the seedVestingPeriod is the longest vesting period
  43 |     |   function passedAllVestingPeriods() public view returns (bool) {
  44 |     |     return block.timestamp > cliffTimestamp + seedVestingPeriod;
  45 |     |   }
  46 |     | 
  47 |     |   /**
  48 |     |     @notice View function to get the user's initial balance and current amount of freed balance
  49 |     |    */
  50 |     |   function getVestedBalance(
  51 |     |     address account
  52 |     |   ) external view returns (uint256, uint256) {
  53 |     |     if (investorBalances[account].initialBalance == 0) {
  54 |     |       return (0, 0);
  55 |     |     }
  56 |     |     InvestorParam memory investorParam = investorBalances[account];
  57 |     |     uint96 amountAvailable;
  58 |     |     if (passedAllVestingPeriods()) {
  59 |     |       amountAvailable = investorParam.initialBalance;
  60 |     |     } else if (passedCliff()) {
  61 |     |       (uint256 vestingPeriod, uint256 elapsed) = _getTrancheInfo(
  62 |     |         investorParam.investorType
  63 |     |       );
  64 |     |       amountAvailable = _proportionAvailable(
  65 |     |         elapsed,
  66 |     |         vestingPeriod,
  67 |     |         investorParam
  68 |     |       );
  69 |     |     } else {
  70 |     |       amountAvailable = 0;
  71 |     |     }
  72 |     |     return (investorParam.initialBalance, amountAvailable);
  73 |     |   }
  74 |     | 
  75 |     |   function _getTrancheInfo(
  76 |     |     IOndo.InvestorType investorType
  77 |     |   ) internal view returns (uint256 vestingPeriod, uint256 elapsed) {
  78 |     |     elapsed = block.timestamp - cliffTimestamp;
  79 |     |     if (investorType == IOndo.InvestorType.CoinlistTranche1) {
  80 |     |       elapsed = elapsed > tranche1VestingPeriod
  81 |     |         ? tranche1VestingPeriod
  82 |     |         : elapsed;
  83 |     |       vestingPeriod = tranche1VestingPeriod;
  84 |     |     } else if (investorType == IOndo.InvestorType.CoinlistTranche2) {
  85 |     |       elapsed = elapsed > tranche2VestingPeriod
  86 |     |         ? tranche2VestingPeriod
  87 |     |         : elapsed;
  88 |     |       vestingPeriod = tranche2VestingPeriod;
  89 |     |     } else if (investorType == IOndo.InvestorType.SeedTranche) {
  90 |     |       elapsed = elapsed > seedVestingPeriod ? seedVestingPeriod : elapsed;
  91 |     |       vestingPeriod = seedVestingPeriod;
  92 |     |     }
  93 |     |   }
  94 |     | 
  95 |     |   function _proportionAvailable(
  96 |     |     uint256 elapsed,
  97 |     |     uint256 vestingPeriod,
  98 |     |     InvestorParam memory investorParam
  99 |     |   ) internal pure returns (uint96) {
 100 |     |     if (investorParam.investorType == IOndo.InvestorType.SeedTranche) {
 101 |     |       // Seed/Series A Tranche Balance = proportionAvail*2/3 + x/3, where x = Balance.
 102 |     |       // This allows 1/3 of the series A balance to be unlocked at cliff.
 103 |     |       uint96 vestedAmount = safe96(
 104 |     |         (((investorParam.initialBalance * elapsed) / vestingPeriod) * 2) / 3,
 105 |     |         "Ondo::_proportionAvailable: amount exceeds 96 bits"
 106 |     |       );
 107 |     |       return
 108 |     |         add96(
 109 |     |           vestedAmount,
 110 |     |           investorParam.initialBalance / 3,
 111 |     |           "Ondo::_proportionAvailable: overflow"
 112 |     |         );
 113 |     |     } else {
 114 |     |       return
 115 |     |         safe96(
 116 |     |           (investorParam.initialBalance * elapsed) / vestingPeriod,
 117 |     |           "Ondo::_proportionAvailable: amount exceeds 96 bits"
 118 |     |         );
 119 |     |     }
 120 |     |   }
 121 |     | 
 122 |     |   function safe32(
 123 |     |     uint256 n,
 124 |     |     string memory errorMessage
 125 |     |   ) internal pure returns (uint32) {
 126 |     |     require(n < 2 ** 32, errorMessage);
 127 |     |     return uint32(n);
 128 |     |   }
 129 |     | 
 130 |     |   function safe96(
 131 |     |     uint256 n,
 132 |     |     string memory errorMessage
 133 |     |   ) internal pure returns (uint96) {
 134 |     |     require(n < 2 ** 96, errorMessage);
 135 |     |     return uint96(n);
 136 |     |   }
 137 |     | 
 138 |     |   function add96(
 139 |     |     uint96 a,
 140 |     |     uint96 b,
 141 |     |     string memory errorMessage
 142 |     |   ) internal pure returns (uint96) {
 143 |     |     uint96 c = a + b;
 144 |     |     require(c >= a, errorMessage);
 145 |     |     return c;
 146 |     |   }
 147 |     | 
 148 |     |   function sub96(
 149 |     |     uint96 a,
 150 |     |     uint96 b,
 151 |     |     string memory errorMessage
 152 |     |   ) internal pure returns (uint96) {
 153 |     |     require(b <= a, errorMessage);
 154 |     |     return a - b;
 155 |     |   }
 156 |     | }

 179 | *   |   function getCashPrior() internal view virtual override returns (uint) {
 180 | *   |     EIP20Interface token = EIP20Interface(underlying);
 181 | *   |     return token.balanceOf(address(this));
 182 |     |   }

 184 |     |   /**
 185 |     |    * @dev Similar to EIP20 transfer, except it handles a False result from `transferFrom` and reverts in that case.
 186 |     |    *      This will revert due to insufficient balance or insufficient allowance.
 187 |     |    *      This function returns the actual amount received,
 188 |     |    *      which may be less than `amount` if there is a fee attached to the transfer.
 189 |     |    *
 190 |     |    *      Note: This wrapper safely handles non-standard ERC-20 tokens that do not return a value.
 191 |     |    *            See here: https://medium.com/coinmonks/missing-return-value-bug-at-least-130-tokens-affected-d67bf08521ca
 192 |     |    */
 193 |     |   function doTransferIn(
 194 |     |     address from,
 195 |     |     uint amount
 196 |     |   ) internal virtual override returns (uint) {
 197 |     |     // Read from storage once
 198 |     |     address underlying_ = underlying;
 199 |     |     EIP20NonStandardInterface token = EIP20NonStandardInterface(underlying_);
 200 |     |     uint balanceBefore = EIP20Interface(underlying_).balanceOf(address(this));
 201 |     |     token.transferFrom(from, address(this), amount);
 202 |     | 
 203 |     |     bool success;
 204 |     |     assembly {
 205 |     |       switch returndatasize()
 206 |     |       case 0 {
 207 |     |         // This is a non-standard ERC-20
 208 |     |         success := not(0) // set success to true
 209 |     |       }
 210 |     |       case 32 {
 211 |     |         // This is a compliant ERC-20
 212 |     |         returndatacopy(0, 0, 32)
 213 |     |         success := mload(0) // Set `success = returndata` of override external call
 214 |     |       }
 215 |     |       default {
 216 |     |         // This is an excessively non-compliant ERC-20, revert.
 217 |     |         revert(0, 0)
 218 |     |       }
 219 |     |     }
 220 |     |     require(success, "TOKEN_TRANSFER_IN_FAILED");
 221 |     | 
 222 |     |     // Calculate the amount that was *actually* transferred
 223 |     |     uint balanceAfter = EIP20Interface(underlying_).balanceOf(address(this));
 224 |     |     return balanceAfter - balanceBefore; // underflow already checked above, just subtract
 225 |     |   }
 226 |     | 
 227 |     |   /**
 228 |     |    * @dev Similar to EIP20 transfer, except it handles a False success from `transfer` and returns an explanatory
 229 |     |    *      error code rather than reverting. If caller has not called checked protocol's balance, this may revert due to
 230 |     |    *      insufficient cash held in this contract. If caller has checked protocol's balance prior to this call, and verified
 231 |     |    *      it is >= amount, this should not revert in normal conditions.
 232 |     |    *
 233 |     |    *      Note: This wrapper safely handles non-standard ERC-20 tokens that do not return a value.
 234 |     |    *            See here: https://medium.com/coinmonks/missing-return-value-bug-at-least-130-tokens-affected-d67bf08521ca
 235 |     |    */
 236 |     |   function doTransferOut(
 237 |     |     address payable to,
 238 |     |     uint amount
 239 |     |   ) internal virtual override {
 240 |     |     EIP20NonStandardInterface token = EIP20NonStandardInterface(underlying);
 241 |     |     token.transfer(to, amount);
 242 |     | 
 243 |     |     bool success;
 244 |     |     assembly {
 245 |     |       switch returndatasize()
 246 |     |       case 0 {
 247 |     |         // This is a non-standard ERC-20
 248 |     |         success := not(0) // set success to true
 249 |     |       }
 250 |     |       case 32 {
 251 |     |         // This is a compliant ERC-20
 252 |     |         returndatacopy(0, 0, 32)
 253 |     |         success := mload(0) // Set `success = returndata` of override external call
 254 |     |       }
 255 |     |       default {
 256 |     |         // This is an excessively non-compliant ERC-20, revert.
 257 |     |         revert(0, 0)
 258 |     |       }
 259 |     |     }
 260 |     |     require(success, "TOKEN_TRANSFER_OUT_FAILED");
 261 |     |   }

   84 |     |    * @param spender The address of the account performing the transfer
   85 |     |    * @param src The address of the source account
   86 |     |    * @param dst The address of the destination account
   87 |     |    * @param tokens The number of tokens to transfer
   88 |     |    * @return 0 if the transfer succeeded, else revert
   89 |     |    */
   90 |     |   function transferTokens(
   91 |     |     address spender,
   92 |     |     address src,
   93 |     |     address dst,
   94 |     |     uint tokens
   95 |     |   ) internal returns (uint) {
   96 |     |     /* Revert if KYC not valid */
   97 |     |     require(_getKYCStatus(spender), "Spender not KYC'd");
   98 |     |     require(_getKYCStatus(src), "Source not KYC'd");
   99 |     |     require(_getKYCStatus(dst), "Destination not KYC'd");
  100 |     | 
  101 |     |     /* Fail if transfer not allowed */
  102 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.transferAllowed(address(this), src, dst, tokens);
  103 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
  104 |     |       revert TransferComptrollerRejection(allowed);
  105 |     |     }
  106 |     | 
  107 |     |     /* Do not allow self-transfers */
  108 |     |     if (src == dst) {
  109 |     |       revert TransferNotAllowed();
  110 |     |     }
  111 |     | 
  112 |     |     /* Get the allowance, infinite for the account owner */
  113 |     |     uint startingAllowance = 0;
  114 |     |     if (spender == src) {
  115 |     |       startingAllowance = type(uint).max;
  116 |     |     } else {
  117 |     |       startingAllowance = transferAllowances[src][spender];
  118 |     |     }
  119 |     | 
  120 |     |     /* Do the calculations, checking for {under,over}flow */
  121 |     |     uint allowanceNew = startingAllowance - tokens;
  122 |     |     uint srcTokensNew = accountTokens[src] - tokens;
  123 |     |     uint dstTokensNew = accountTokens[dst] + tokens;
  124 |     | 
  125 |     |     /////////////////////////
  126 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  127 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  128 |     | 
  129 |     |     accountTokens[src] = srcTokensNew;
  130 |     |     accountTokens[dst] = dstTokensNew;
  131 |     | 
  132 |     |     /* Eat some of the allowance (if necessary) */
  133 |     |     if (startingAllowance != type(uint).max) {
  134 |     |       transferAllowances[src][spender] = allowanceNew;
  135 |     |     }
  136 |     | 
  137 |     |     /* We emit a Transfer event */
  138 |     |     emit Transfer(src, dst, tokens);
  139 |     | 
  140 |     |     // unused function
  141 |     |     // comptroller.transferVerify(address(this), src, dst, tokens);

  143 |     |     return NO_ERROR;

  314 |     |   function borrowBalanceStoredInternal(

  316 |     |   ) internal view returns (uint) {

  331 |     |     return principalTimesIndex / borrowSnapshot.interestIndex;

  348 |     |   function exchangeRateStored() public view override returns (uint) {

  352 |     |   /**
  353 |     |    * @notice Calculates the exchange rate from the underlying to the cToken
  354 |     |    * @dev This function does not accrue interest before calculating the exchange rate
  355 |     |    * @return calculated exchange rate scaled by 1e18
  356 |     |    */
  357 |     |   function exchangeRateStoredInternal() internal view virtual returns (uint) {
  358 |     |     uint _totalSupply = totalSupply;
  359 |     |     if (_totalSupply == 0) {
  360 |     |       /*
  361 |     |        * If there are no tokens minted:
  362 |     |        *  exchangeRate = initialExchangeRate
  363 |     |        */
  364 |     |       return initialExchangeRateMantissa;
  365 |     |     } else {
  366 |     |       /*
  367 |     |        * Otherwise:
  368 |     |        *  exchangeRate = (totalCash + totalBorrows - totalReserves) / totalSupply
  369 |     |        */
  370 |     |       uint totalCash = getCashPrior();
  371 |     |       uint cashPlusBorrowsMinusReserves = totalCash +
  372 |     |         totalBorrows -
  373 |     |         totalReserves;
  374 |     |       uint exchangeRate = (cashPlusBorrowsMinusReserves * expScale) /
  375 |     |         _totalSupply;
  376 |     | 
  377 |     |       return exchangeRate;
  378 |     |     }
  379 |     |   }

  381 |     |   /**

  389 |     |   /**
  390 |     |    * @notice Applies accrued interest to total borrows and reserves
  391 |     |    * @dev This calculates interest accrued from the last checkpointed block
  392 |     |    *   up to the current block and writes new checkpoint to storage.
  393 |     |    */
  394 | *   |   function accrueInterest() public virtual override returns (uint) {
  395 |     |     /* Remember the initial block number */
  396 |     |     uint currentBlockNumber = getBlockNumber();
  397 | *   |     uint accrualBlockNumberPrior = accrualBlockNumber;
  398 |     | 
  399 |     |     /* Short-circuit accumulating 0 interest */
  400 | *   |     if (accrualBlockNumberPrior == currentBlockNumber) {
  401 |     |       return NO_ERROR;
  402 |     |     }
  403 |     | 
  404 |     |     /* Read the previous values out of storage */
  405 | *   |     uint cashPrior = getCashPrior();
  406 |     |     uint borrowsPrior = totalBorrows;
  407 |     |     uint reservesPrior = totalReserves;
  408 |     |     uint borrowIndexPrior = borrowIndex;
  409 |     | 
  410 |     |     /* Calculate the current borrow interest rate */
  411 |     |     uint borrowRateMantissa = interestRateModel.getBorrowRate(
  412 |     |       cashPrior,
  413 |     |       borrowsPrior,
  414 |     |       reservesPrior
  415 |     |     );
  416 |     |     require(
  417 |     |       borrowRateMantissa <= borrowRateMaxMantissa,
  418 |     |       "borrow rate is absurdly high"
  419 |     |     );
  420 |     | 
  421 |     |     /* Calculate the number of blocks elapsed since the last accrual */
  422 |     |     uint blockDelta = currentBlockNumber - accrualBlockNumberPrior;
  423 |     | 
  424 |     |     /*
  425 |     |      * Calculate the interest accumulated into borrows and reserves and the new index:
  426 |     |      *  simpleInterestFactor = borrowRate * blockDelta
  427 |     |      *  interestAccumulated = simpleInterestFactor * totalBorrows
  428 |     |      *  totalBorrowsNew = interestAccumulated + totalBorrows
  429 |     |      *  totalReservesNew = interestAccumulated * reserveFactor + totalReserves
  430 |     |      *  borrowIndexNew = simpleInterestFactor * borrowIndex + borrowIndex
  431 |     |      */
  432 |     | 
  433 |     |     Exp memory simpleInterestFactor = mul_(
  434 |     |       Exp({mantissa: borrowRateMantissa}),
  435 |     |       blockDelta
  436 |     |     );
  437 |     |     uint interestAccumulated = mul_ScalarTruncate(
  438 |     |       simpleInterestFactor,
  439 |     |       borrowsPrior
  440 |     |     );
  441 |     |     uint totalBorrowsNew = interestAccumulated + borrowsPrior;
  442 |     |     uint totalReservesNew = mul_ScalarTruncateAddUInt(
  443 |     |       Exp({mantissa: reserveFactorMantissa}),
  444 |     |       interestAccumulated,
  445 |     |       reservesPrior
  446 |     |     );
  447 |     |     uint borrowIndexNew = mul_ScalarTruncateAddUInt(
  448 |     |       simpleInterestFactor,
  449 |     |       borrowIndexPrior,
  450 |     |       borrowIndexPrior
  451 |     |     );
  452 |     | 
  453 |     |     /////////////////////////
  454 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  455 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  456 |     | 
  457 |     |     /* We write the previously calculated values into storage */
  458 |     |     accrualBlockNumber = currentBlockNumber;
  459 |     |     borrowIndex = borrowIndexNew;
  460 |     |     totalBorrows = totalBorrowsNew;
  461 |     |     totalReserves = totalReservesNew;
  462 |     | 
  463 |     |     /* We emit an AccrueInterest event */
  464 |     |     emit AccrueInterest(
  465 |     |       cashPrior,
  466 |     |       interestAccumulated,
  467 |     |       borrowIndexNew,
  468 |     |       totalBorrowsNew
  469 |     |     );
  470 |     | 
  471 |     |     return NO_ERROR;
  472 |     |   }

  485 |     |   /**
  486 |     |    * @notice User supplies assets into the market and receives cTokens in exchange
  487 |     |    * @dev Assumes interest has already been accrued up to the current block

  489 |     |    * @param mintAmount The amount of the underlying asset to supply

  491 |     |   function mintFresh(address minter, uint mintAmount) internal {
  492 |     |     /* Revert if minter not KYC'd */

  495 |     |     /* Fail if mint not allowed */

  497 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
  498 |     |       revert MintComptrollerRejection(allowed);

  500 |     | 
  501 |     |     /* Verify market's block number equals current block number */
  502 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
  503 |     |       revert MintFreshnessCheck();
  504 |     |     }
  505 |     | 
  506 |     |     Exp memory exchangeRate = Exp({mantissa: exchangeRateStoredInternal()});
  507 |     | 
  508 |     |     /////////////////////////
  509 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  510 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  511 |     | 
  512 |     |     /*
  513 |     |      *  We call `doTransferIn` for the minter and the mintAmount.
  514 |     |      *  Note: The cToken must handle variations between ERC-20 and ETH underlying.
  515 |     |      *  `doTransferIn` reverts if anything goes wrong, since we can't be sure if
  516 |     |      *  side-effects occurred. The function returns the amount actually transferred,

  524 |     |      *  mintTokens = actualMintAmount / exchangeRate

  527 |     |     uint mintTokens = div_(actualMintAmount, exchangeRate);
  528 |     | 
  529 |     |     /*
  530 |     |      * We calculate the new total supply of cTokens and minter token balance, checking for overflow:
  531 |     |      *  totalSupplyNew = totalSupply + mintTokens
  532 |     |      *  accountTokensNew = accountTokens[minter] + mintTokens
  533 |     |      * And write them into storage

  535 |     |     totalSupply = totalSupply + mintTokens;
  536 |     |     accountTokens[minter] = accountTokens[minter] + mintTokens;
  537 |     | 
  538 |     |     /* We emit a Mint event, and a Transfer event */
  539 |     |     emit Mint(minter, actualMintAmount, mintTokens);
  540 |     |     emit Transfer(address(this), minter, mintTokens);

  569 |     |   /**
  570 |     |    * @notice User redeems cTokens in exchange for the underlying asset
  571 |     |    * @dev Assumes interest has already been accrued up to the current block
  572 |     |    * @param redeemer The address of the account which is redeeming the tokens
  573 |     |    * @param redeemTokensIn The number of cTokens to redeem into underlying (only one of redeemTokensIn or redeemAmountIn may be non-zero)
  574 |     |    * @param redeemAmountIn The number of underlying tokens to receive from redeeming cTokens (only one of redeemTokensIn or redeemAmountIn may be non-zero)
  575 |     |    */
  576 |     |   function redeemFresh(
  577 |     |     address payable redeemer,
  578 |     |     uint redeemTokensIn,
  579 |     |     uint redeemAmountIn
  580 |     |   ) internal {
  581 |     |     /* Revert if redeemer not KYC'd */
  582 |     |     require(_getKYCStatus(redeemer), "Redeemer not KYC'd");
  583 |     | 
  584 |     |     require(
  585 |     |       redeemTokensIn == 0 || redeemAmountIn == 0,
  586 |     |       "one of redeemTokensIn or redeemAmountIn must be zero"
  587 |     |     );
  588 |     | 
  589 |     |     /* exchangeRate = invoke Exchange Rate Stored() */
  590 |     |     Exp memory exchangeRate = Exp({mantissa: exchangeRateStoredInternal()});
  591 |     | 
  592 |     |     uint redeemTokens;
  593 |     |     uint redeemAmount;
  594 |     |     /* If redeemTokensIn > 0: */
  595 |     |     if (redeemTokensIn > 0) {
  596 |     |       /*
  597 |     |        * We calculate the exchange rate and the amount of underlying to be redeemed:
  598 |     |        *  redeemTokens = redeemTokensIn
  599 |     |        *  redeemAmount = redeemTokensIn x exchangeRateCurrent
  600 |     |        */
  601 |     |       redeemTokens = redeemTokensIn;
  602 |     |       redeemAmount = mul_ScalarTruncate(exchangeRate, redeemTokensIn);
  603 |     |     } else {
  604 |     |       /*
  605 |     |        * We get the current exchange rate and calculate the amount to be redeemed:
  606 |     |        *  redeemTokens = redeemAmountIn / exchangeRate
  607 |     |        *  redeemAmount = redeemAmountIn
  608 |     |        */
  609 |     |       redeemTokens = div_(redeemAmountIn, exchangeRate);
  610 |     |       redeemAmount = redeemAmountIn;
  611 |     |     }
  612 |     | 
  613 |     |     /* Fail if redeem not allowed */
  614 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.redeemAllowed(
  615 |     |       address(this),
  616 |     |       redeemer,
  617 |     |       redeemTokens
  618 |     |     );
  619 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
  620 |     |       revert RedeemComptrollerRejection(allowed);
  621 |     |     }
  622 |     | 
  623 |     |     /* Verify market's block number equals current block number */
  624 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
  625 |     |       revert RedeemFreshnessCheck();
  626 |     |     }
  627 |     | 
  628 |     |     /* Fail gracefully if protocol has insufficient cash */
  629 |     |     if (getCashPrior() < redeemAmount) {
  630 |     |       revert RedeemTransferOutNotPossible();
  631 |     |     }
  632 |     | 
  633 |     |     /////////////////////////
  634 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  635 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  636 |     | 
  637 |     |     /*
  638 |     |      * We write the previously calculated values into storage.
  639 |     |      *  Note: Avoid token reentrancy attacks by writing reduced supply before external transfer.
  640 |     |      */
  641 |     |     totalSupply = totalSupply - redeemTokens;
  642 |     |     accountTokens[redeemer] = accountTokens[redeemer] - redeemTokens;
  643 |     | 
  644 |     |     /*
  645 |     |      * We invoke doTransferOut for the redeemer and the redeemAmount.
  646 |     |      *  Note: The cToken must handle variations between ERC-20 and ETH underlying.
  647 |     |      *  On success, the cToken has redeemAmount less of cash.
  648 |     |      *  doTransferOut reverts if anything goes wrong, since we can't be sure if side effects occurred.
  649 |     |      */
  650 |     |     doTransferOut(redeemer, redeemAmount);
  651 |     | 
  652 |     |     /* We emit a Transfer event, and a Redeem event */
  653 |     |     emit Transfer(redeemer, address(this), redeemTokens);
  654 |     |     emit Redeem(redeemer, redeemAmount, redeemTokens);
  655 |     | 
  656 |     |     /* We call the defense hook */
  657 |     |     comptroller.redeemVerify(
  658 |     |       address(this),
  659 |     |       redeemer,
  660 |     |       redeemAmount,
  661 |     |       redeemTokens
  662 |     |     );
  663 |     |   }

  679 |     |   function borrowFresh(address payable borrower, uint borrowAmount) internal {
  680 |     |     /* Revert if borrower not KYC'd */

  690 |     |       revert BorrowComptrollerRejection(allowed);

  692 |     |

  697 |     | 
  698 |     |     /* Fail gracefully if protocol has insufficient underlying cash */
  699 |     |     if (getCashPrior() < borrowAmount) {

  709 |     |     uint accountBorrowsNew = accountBorrowsPrev + borrowAmount;
  710 |     |     uint totalBorrowsNew = totalBorrows + borrowAmount;
  711 |     | 
  712 |     |     /////////////////////////
  713 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  714 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)

  718 |     |          *  Note: Avoid token reentrancy attacks by writing increased borrow before external transfer.
  719 |     |         `*/
  720 |     |     accountBorrows[borrower].principal = accountBorrowsNew;
  721 |     |     accountBorrows[borrower].interestIndex = borrowIndex;
  722 |     |     totalBorrows = totalBorrowsNew;
  723 |     | 
  724 |     |     /*
  725 |     |      * We invoke doTransferOut for the borrower and the borrowAmount.
  726 |     |      *  Note: The cToken must handle variations between ERC-20 and ETH underlying.
  727 |     |      *  On success, the cToken borrowAmount less of cash.
  728 |     |      *  doTransferOut reverts if anything goes wrong, since we can't be sure if side effects occurred.

  730 |     |     doTransferOut(borrower, borrowAmount);
  731 |     | 
  732 |     |     /* We emit a Borrow event */
  733 |     |     emit Borrow(borrower, borrowAmount, accountBorrowsNew, totalBorrowsNew);
  734 |     |   }

  760 |     |   /**
  761 |     |    * @notice Borrows are repaid by another user (possibly the borrower).
  762 |     |    * @param payer the account paying off the borrow
  763 |     |    * @param borrower the account with the debt being payed off
  764 |     |    * @param repayAmount the amount of underlying tokens being returned, or -1 for the full outstanding amount
  765 |     |    * @return (uint) the actual repayment amount.
  766 |     |    */
  767 |     |   function repayBorrowFresh(
  768 |     |     address payer,
  769 |     |     address borrower,
  770 |     |     uint repayAmount
  771 |     |   ) internal returns (uint) {
  772 |     |     /* Revert if not KYC'd */
  773 |     |     require(_getKYCStatus(payer), "Payer not KYC'd");
  774 |     |     require(_getKYCStatus(borrower), "Borrower not KYC'd");
  775 |     | 
  776 |     |     /* Fail if repayBorrow not allowed */
  777 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.repayBorrowAllowed(
  778 |     |       address(this),
  779 |     |       payer,
  780 |     |       borrower,
  781 |     |       repayAmount
  782 |     |     );
  783 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
  784 |     |       revert RepayBorrowComptrollerRejection(allowed);
  785 |     |     }
  786 |     | 
  787 |     |     /* Verify market's block number equals current block number */
  788 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
  789 |     |       revert RepayBorrowFreshnessCheck();
  790 |     |     }
  791 |     | 
  792 |     |     /* We fetch the amount the borrower owes, with accumulated interest */
  793 |     |     uint accountBorrowsPrev = borrowBalanceStoredInternal(borrower);
  794 |     | 
  795 |     |     /* If repayAmount == -1, repayAmount = accountBorrows */
  796 |     |     uint repayAmountFinal = repayAmount == type(uint).max
  797 |     |       ? accountBorrowsPrev
  798 |     |       : repayAmount;
  799 |     | 
  800 |     |     /////////////////////////
  801 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  802 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  803 |     | 
  804 |     |     /*
  805 |     |      * We call doTransferIn for the payer and the repayAmount
  806 |     |      *  Note: The cToken must handle variations between ERC-20 and ETH underlying.
  807 |     |      *  On success, the cToken holds an additional repayAmount of cash.
  808 |     |      *  doTransferIn reverts if anything goes wrong, since we can't be sure if side effects occurred.
  809 |     |      *   it returns the amount actually transferred, in case of a fee.
  810 |     |      */
  811 |     |     uint actualRepayAmount = doTransferIn(payer, repayAmountFinal);
  812 |     | 
  813 |     |     /*
  814 |     |      * We calculate the new borrower and total borrow balances, failing on underflow:
  815 |     |      *  accountBorrowsNew = accountBorrows - actualRepayAmount
  816 |     |      *  totalBorrowsNew = totalBorrows - actualRepayAmount
  817 |     |      */
  818 |     |     uint accountBorrowsNew = accountBorrowsPrev - actualRepayAmount;
  819 |     |     uint totalBorrowsNew = totalBorrows - actualRepayAmount;
  820 |     | 
  821 |     |     /* We write the previously calculated values into storage */
  822 |     |     accountBorrows[borrower].principal = accountBorrowsNew;
  823 |     |     accountBorrows[borrower].interestIndex = borrowIndex;
  824 |     |     totalBorrows = totalBorrowsNew;
  825 |     | 
  826 |     |     /* We emit a RepayBorrow event */
  827 |     |     emit RepayBorrow(
  828 |     |       payer,
  829 |     |       borrower,
  830 |     |       actualRepayAmount,
  831 |     |       accountBorrowsNew,
  832 |     |       totalBorrowsNew
  833 |     |     );
  834 |     | 
  835 |     |     return actualRepayAmount;
  836 |     |   }

  838 |     |   /**

  845 |     |   function liquidateBorrowInternal(

  862 |     |   /**

  868 |     |    * @param repayAmount The amount of the underlying borrowed asset to repay
  869 |     |    */
  870 |     |   function liquidateBorrowFresh(
  871 |     |     address liquidator,
  872 |     |     address borrower,
  873 |     |     uint repayAmount,
  874 |     |     CTokenInterface cTokenCollateral
  875 |     |   ) internal {

  883 |     |     );
  884 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
  885 |     |       revert LiquidateComptrollerRejection(allowed);
  886 |     |     }
  887 |     | 
  888 |     |     /* Verify market's block number equals current block number */
  889 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
  890 |     |       revert LiquidateFreshnessCheck();
  891 |     |     }
  892 |     | 
  893 |     |     /* Verify cTokenCollateral market's block number equals current block number */
  894 |     |     if (cTokenCollateral.accrualBlockNumber() != getBlockNumber()) {
  895 |     |       revert LiquidateCollateralFreshnessCheck();
  896 |     |     }
  897 |     | 
  898 |     |     /* Fail if borrower = liquidator */
  899 |     |     if (borrower == liquidator) {
  900 |     |       revert LiquidateLiquidatorIsBorrower();
  901 |     |     }
  902 |     | 
  903 |     |     /* Fail if repayAmount = 0 */
  904 |     |     if (repayAmount == 0) {
  905 |     |       revert LiquidateCloseAmountIsZero();
  906 |     |     }
  907 |     | 
  908 |     |     /* Fail if repayAmount = -1 */
  909 |     |     if (repayAmount == type(uint).max) {
  910 |     |       revert LiquidateCloseAmountIsUintMax();
  911 |     |     }
  912 |     | 
  913 |     |     /* Fail if repayBorrow fails */
  914 |     |     uint actualRepayAmount = repayBorrowFresh(
  915 |     |       liquidator,
  916 |     |       borrower,
  917 |     |       repayAmount
  918 |     |     );
  919 |     | 
  920 |     |     /////////////////////////
  921 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  922 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  923 |     | 
  924 |     |     /* We calculate the number of collateral tokens that will be seized */
  925 |     |     (uint amountSeizeError, uint seizeTokens) = comptroller
  926 |     |       .liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens(
  927 |     |         address(this),
  928 |     |         address(cTokenCollateral),
  929 |     |         actualRepayAmount
  930 |     |       );
  931 |     |     require(
  932 |     |       amountSeizeError == NO_ERROR,
  933 |     |       "LIQUIDATE_COMPTROLLER_CALCULATE_AMOUNT_SEIZE_FAILED"
  934 |     |     );
  935 |     | 
  936 |     |     /* Revert if borrower collateral token balance < seizeTokens */
  937 |     |     require(
  938 |     |       cTokenCollateral.balanceOf(borrower) >= seizeTokens,
  939 |     |       "LIQUIDATE_SEIZE_TOO_MUCH"
  940 |     |     );
  941 |     | 
  942 |     |     // If this is also the collateral, run seizeInternal to avoid re-entrancy, otherwise make an external call
  943 |     |     if (address(cTokenCollateral) == address(this)) {
  944 |     |       seizeInternal(address(this), liquidator, borrower, seizeTokens);
  945 |     |     } else {
  946 |     |       require(
  947 |     |         cTokenCollateral.seize(liquidator, borrower, seizeTokens) == NO_ERROR,
  948 |     |         "token seizure failed"
  949 |     |       );
  950 |     |     }
  951 |     | 
  952 |     |     /* We emit a LiquidateBorrow event */
  953 |     |     emit LiquidateBorrow(
  954 |     |       liquidator,
  955 |     |       borrower,
  956 |     |       actualRepayAmount,
  957 |     |       address(cTokenCollateral),
  958 |     |       seizeTokens
  959 |     |     );
  960 |     |   }
  961 |     | 
  962 |     |   /**
  963 |     |    * @notice Transfers collateral tokens (this market) to the liquidator.
  964 |     |    * @dev Will fail unless called by another cToken during the process of liquidation.
  965 |     |    *  Its absolutely critical to use msg.sender as the borrowed cToken and not a parameter.
  966 |     |    * @param liquidator The account receiving seized collateral
  967 |     |    * @param borrower The account having collateral seized
  968 |     |    * @param seizeTokens The number of cTokens to seize
  969 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
  970 |     |    */
  971 | *   |   function seize(
  972 |     |     address liquidator,
  973 |     |     address borrower,
  974 |     |     uint seizeTokens
  975 | *   |   ) external override nonReentrant returns (uint) {
  976 |     |     seizeInternal(msg.sender, liquidator, borrower, seizeTokens);
  977 |     | 
  978 |     |     return NO_ERROR;
  979 |     |   }
  980 |     | 
  981 |     |   /**
  982 |     |    * @notice Transfers collateral tokens (this market) to the liquidator.
  983 |     |    * @dev Called only during an in-kind liquidation, or by liquidateBorrow during the liquidation of another cToken.
  984 |     |    *  Its absolutely critical to use msg.sender as the seizer cToken and not a parameter.
  985 |     |    * @param seizerToken The contract seizing the collateral (i.e. borrowed cToken)
  986 |     |    * @param liquidator The account receiving seized collateral
  987 |     |    * @param borrower The account having collateral seized
  988 |     |    * @param seizeTokens The number of cTokens to seize
  989 |     |    */
  990 |     |   function seizeInternal(
  991 |     |     address seizerToken,
  992 |     |     address liquidator,
  993 |     |     address borrower,
  994 |     |     uint seizeTokens
  995 |     |   ) internal {
  996 |     |     /* Revert if not KYC'd */
  997 |     |     require(_getKYCStatus(liquidator), "Liquidator not KYC'd");
  998 |     |     require(_getKYCStatus(borrower), "Borrower not KYC'd");
  999 |     | 
 1000 |     |     /* Fail if seize not allowed */
 1001 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.seizeAllowed(
 1002 |     |       address(this),
 1003 |     |       seizerToken,
 1004 |     |       liquidator,
 1005 |     |       borrower,
 1006 |     |       seizeTokens
 1007 |     |     );
 1008 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
 1009 |     |       revert LiquidateSeizeComptrollerRejection(allowed);
 1010 |     |     }
 1011 |     | 
 1012 |     |     /* Fail if borrower = liquidator */
 1013 |     |     if (borrower == liquidator) {
 1014 |     |       revert LiquidateSeizeLiquidatorIsBorrower();
 1015 |     |     }
 1016 |     | 
 1017 |     |     /*
 1018 |     |      * We calculate the new borrower and liquidator token balances, failing on underflow/overflow:
 1019 |     |      *  borrowerTokensNew = accountTokens[borrower] - seizeTokens
 1020 |     |      *  liquidatorTokensNew = accountTokens[liquidator] + seizeTokens
 1021 |     |      */
 1022 |     |     uint protocolSeizeTokens = mul_(
 1023 |     |       seizeTokens,
 1024 |     |       Exp({mantissa: protocolSeizeShareMantissa})
 1025 |     |     );
 1026 |     |     uint liquidatorSeizeTokens = seizeTokens - protocolSeizeTokens;
 1027 |     |     Exp memory exchangeRate = Exp({mantissa: exchangeRateStoredInternal()});
 1028 |     |     uint protocolSeizeAmount = mul_ScalarTruncate(
 1029 |     |       exchangeRate,
 1030 |     |       protocolSeizeTokens
 1031 |     |     );
 1032 |     |     uint totalReservesNew = totalReserves + protocolSeizeAmount;
 1033 |     | 
 1034 |     |     /////////////////////////
 1035 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
 1036 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
 1037 |     | 
 1038 |     |     /* We write the calculated values into storage */
 1039 |     |     totalReserves = totalReservesNew;
 1040 |     |     totalSupply = totalSupply - protocolSeizeTokens;
 1041 |     |     accountTokens[borrower] = accountTokens[borrower] - seizeTokens;
 1042 |     |     accountTokens[liquidator] =
 1043 |     |       accountTokens[liquidator] +
 1044 |     |       liquidatorSeizeTokens;
 1045 |     | 
 1046 |     |     /* Emit a Transfer event */
 1047 |     |     emit Transfer(borrower, liquidator, liquidatorSeizeTokens);
 1048 |     |     emit Transfer(borrower, address(this), protocolSeizeTokens);
 1049 |     |     emit ReservesAdded(address(this), protocolSeizeAmount, totalReservesNew);
 1050 |     |   }

 1193 |     |    * @notice Add reserves by transferring from caller
 1194 |     |    * @dev Requires fresh interest accrual
 1195 |     |    * @param addAmount Amount of addition to reserves
 1196 |     |    * @return (uint, uint) An error code (0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)) and the actual amount added, net token fees
 1197 |     |    */
 1198 |     |   function _addReservesFresh(uint addAmount) internal returns (uint, uint) {
 1199 |     |     // totalReserves + actualAddAmount
 1200 |     |     uint totalReservesNew;
 1201 |     |     uint actualAddAmount;
 1202 |     | 
 1203 |     |     // We fail gracefully unless market's block number equals current block number
 1204 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
 1205 |     |       revert AddReservesFactorFreshCheck(actualAddAmount);
 1206 |     |     }

 1208 |     |     /////////////////////////
 1209 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
 1210 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
 1211 |     | 
 1212 |     |     /*
 1213 |     |      * We call doTransferIn for the caller and the addAmount
 1214 |     |      *  Note: The cToken must handle variations between ERC-20 and ETH underlying.
 1215 |     |      *  On success, the cToken holds an additional addAmount of cash.
 1216 |     |      *  doTransferIn reverts if anything goes wrong, since we can't be sure if side effects occurred.
 1217 |     |      *  it returns the amount actually transferred, in case of a fee.
 1218 |     |      */
 1219 |     | 
 1220 |     |     actualAddAmount = doTransferIn(msg.sender, addAmount);
 1221 |     | 
 1222 |     |     totalReservesNew = totalReserves + actualAddAmount;
 1223 |     | 
 1224 |     |     // Store reserves[n+1] = reserves[n] + actualAddAmount
 1225 |     |     totalReserves = totalReservesNew;
 1226 |     | 
 1227 |     |     /* Emit NewReserves(admin, actualAddAmount, reserves[n+1]) */
 1228 |     |     emit ReservesAdded(msg.sender, actualAddAmount, totalReservesNew);
 1229 |     | 
 1230 |     |     /* Return (NO_ERROR, actualAddAmount) */
 1231 |     |     return (NO_ERROR, actualAddAmount);
 1232 |     |   }

  4 |     | /**

  7 |     |  */
  8 |     | interface EIP20Interface {
  9 |     |   function name() external view returns (string memory);
 10 |     | 
 11 |     |   function symbol() external view returns (string memory);
 12 |     | 
 13 |     |   function decimals() external view returns (uint8);
 14 |     | 
 15 |     |   /**
 16 |     |    * @notice Get the total number of tokens in circulation
 17 |     |    * @return The supply of tokens
 18 |     |    */
 19 |     |   function totalSupply() external view returns (uint256);
 20 |     | 
 21 |     |   /**
 22 |     |    * @notice Gets the balance of the specified address
 23 |     |    * @param owner The address from which the balance will be retrieved
 24 |     |    * @return balance The balance
 25 |     |    */
 26 |     |   function balanceOf(address owner) external view returns (uint256 balance);
 27 |     | 
 28 |     |   /**
 29 |     |    * @notice Transfer `amount` tokens from `msg.sender` to `dst`
 30 |     |    * @param dst The address of the destination account
 31 |     |    * @param amount The number of tokens to transfer
 32 |     |    * @return success Whether or not the transfer succeeded
 33 |     |    */
 34 |     |   function transfer(
 35 |     |     address dst,
 36 |     |     uint256 amount
 37 |     |   ) external returns (bool success);
 38 |     |

 41 |     |    * @param src The address of the source account
 42 |     |    * @param dst The address of the destination account
 43 |     |    * @param amount The number of tokens to transfer
 44 |     |    * @return success Whether or not the transfer succeeded
 45 |     |    */
 46 |     |   function transferFrom(
 47 |     |     address src,
 48 |     |     address dst,
 49 |     |     uint256 amount
 50 |     |   ) external returns (bool success);
 51 |     | 
 52 |     |   /**
 53 |     |    * @notice Approve `spender` to transfer up to `amount` from `src`
 54 |     |    * @dev This will overwrite the approval amount for `spender`
 55 |     |    *  and is subject to issues noted [here](https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-20#approve)
 56 |     |    * @param spender The address of the account which may transfer tokens
 57 |     |    * @param amount The number of tokens that are approved (-1 means infinite)
 58 |     |    * @return success Whether or not the approval succeeded
 59 |     |    */
 60 |     |   function approve(
 61 |     |     address spender,
 62 |     |     uint256 amount
 63 |     |   ) external returns (bool success);

 67 |     |    * @param owner The address of the account which owns the tokens to be spent
 68 |     |    * @param spender The address of the account which may transfer tokens
 69 |     |    * @return remaining The number of tokens allowed to be spent (-1 means infinite)
 70 |     |    */
 71 |     |   function allowance(
 72 |     |     address owner,
 73 |     |     address spender
 74 |     |   ) external view returns (uint256 remaining);
 75 |     |

 81 |     |   );

   4 |     | contract ComptrollerErrorReporter {
   5 |     |   enum Error {
   6 |     |     NO_ERROR,
   7 |     |     UNAUTHORIZED,
   8 |     |     COMPTROLLER_MISMATCH,
   9 |     |     INSUFFICIENT_SHORTFALL,
  10 |     |     INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY,
  11 |     |     INVALID_CLOSE_FACTOR,

  15 |     |     MARKET_NOT_LISTED,
  16 |     |     MARKET_ALREADY_LISTED,

  18 |     |     NONZERO_BORROW_BALANCE,
  19 |     |     PRICE_ERROR,
  20 |     |     REJECTION,
  21 |     |     SNAPSHOT_ERROR,
  22 |     |     TOO_MANY_ASSETS,
  23 |     |     TOO_MUCH_REPAY
  24 |     |   }
  25 |     | 
  26 |     |   enum FailureInfo {
  27 |     |     ACCEPT_ADMIN_PENDING_ADMIN_CHECK,
  28 |     |     ACCEPT_PENDING_IMPLEMENTATION_ADDRESS_CHECK,
  29 |     |     EXIT_MARKET_BALANCE_OWED,
  30 |     |     EXIT_MARKET_REJECTION,
  31 |     |     SET_CLOSE_FACTOR_OWNER_CHECK,
  32 |     |     SET_CLOSE_FACTOR_VALIDATION,
  33 |     |     SET_COLLATERAL_FACTOR_OWNER_CHECK,
  34 |     |     SET_COLLATERAL_FACTOR_NO_EXISTS,
  35 |     |     SET_COLLATERAL_FACTOR_VALIDATION,
  36 |     |     SET_COLLATERAL_FACTOR_WITHOUT_PRICE,
  37 |     |     SET_IMPLEMENTATION_OWNER_CHECK,
  38 |     |     SET_LIQUIDATION_INCENTIVE_OWNER_CHECK,
  39 |     |     SET_LIQUIDATION_INCENTIVE_VALIDATION,
  40 |     |     SET_MAX_ASSETS_OWNER_CHECK,
  41 |     |     SET_PENDING_ADMIN_OWNER_CHECK,
  42 |     |     SET_PENDING_IMPLEMENTATION_OWNER_CHECK,
  43 |     |     SET_PRICE_ORACLE_OWNER_CHECK,
  44 |     |     SUPPORT_MARKET_EXISTS,
  45 |     |     SUPPORT_MARKET_OWNER_CHECK,
  46 |     |     SET_PAUSE_GUARDIAN_OWNER_CHECK
  47 |     |   }
  48 |     | 
  49 |     |   /**
  50 |     |    * @dev `error` corresponds to enum Error; `info` corresponds to enum FailureInfo, and `detail` is an arbitrary
  51 |     |    * contract-specific code that enables us to report opaque error codes from upgradeable contracts.
  52 |     |    **/
  53 |     |   event Failure(uint error, uint info, uint detail);
  54 |     | 
  55 |     |   /**
  56 |     |    * @dev use this when reporting a known error from the money market or a non-upgradeable collaborator
  57 |     |    */
  58 |     |   function fail(Error err, FailureInfo info) internal returns (uint) {
  59 |     |     emit Failure(uint(err), uint(info), 0);
  60 |     | 
  61 |     |     return uint(err);
  62 |     |   }
  63 |     | 
  64 |     |   /**
  65 |     |    * @dev use this when reporting an opaque error from an upgradeable collaborator contract
  66 |     |    */
  67 |     |   function failOpaque(
  68 |     |     Error err,
  69 |     |     FailureInfo info,
  70 |     |     uint opaqueError
  71 |     |   ) internal returns (uint) {
  72 |     |     emit Failure(uint(err), uint(info), opaqueError);
  73 |     | 
  74 |     |     return uint(err);
  75 |     |   }
  76 |     | }

   4 |     | /**
   5 |     |  * @title Exponential module for storing fixed-precision decimals
   6 |     |  * @author Compound
   7 |     |  * @notice Exp is a struct which stores decimals with a fixed precision of 18 decimal places.
   8 |     |  *         Thus, if we wanted to store the 5.1, mantissa would store 5.1e18. That is:
   9 |     |  *         `Exp({mantissa: 5100000000000000000})`.
  10 |     |  */
  11 |     | contract ExponentialNoError {
  12 |     |   uint constant expScale = 1e18;
  13 |     |   uint constant doubleScale = 1e36;
  14 |     |   uint constant halfExpScale = expScale / 2;
  15 |     |   uint constant mantissaOne = expScale;
  16 |     | 
  17 |     |   struct Exp {
  18 |     |     uint mantissa;
  19 |     |   }
  20 |     | 
  21 |     |   struct Double {
  22 |     |     uint mantissa;
  23 |     |   }
  24 |     | 
  25 |     |   /**
  26 |     |    * @dev Truncates the given exp to a whole number value.
  27 |     |    *      For example, truncate(Exp{mantissa: 15 * expScale}) = 15
  28 |     |    */
  29 |     |   function truncate(Exp memory exp) internal pure returns (uint) {
  30 |     |     // Note: We are not using careful math here as we're performing a division that cannot fail
  31 |     |     return exp.mantissa / expScale;
  32 |     |   }
  33 |     | 
  34 |     |   /**
  35 |     |    * @dev Multiply an Exp by a scalar, then truncate to return an unsigned integer.
  36 |     |    */
  37 | *   |   function mul_ScalarTruncate(
  38 |     |     Exp memory a,
  39 |     |     uint scalar
  40 |     |   ) internal pure returns (uint) {
  41 |     |     Exp memory product = mul_(a, scalar);
  42 | *   |     return truncate(product);
  43 |     |   }
  44 |     | 
  45 |     |   /**
  46 |     |    * @dev Multiply an Exp by a scalar, truncate, then add an to an unsigned integer, returning an unsigned integer.
  47 |     |    */
  48 |     |   function mul_ScalarTruncateAddUInt(
  49 |     |     Exp memory a,
  50 |     |     uint scalar,
  51 |     |     uint addend
  52 |     |   ) internal pure returns (uint) {
  53 |     |     Exp memory product = mul_(a, scalar);
  54 |     |     return add_(truncate(product), addend);
  55 |     |   }

  57 |     |   /**
  58 |     |    * @dev Checks if first Exp is less than second Exp.
  59 |     |    */
  60 |     |   function lessThanExp(
  61 |     |     Exp memory left,

 184 |     |   /**
 185 |     |    * @dev Similar to EIP20 transfer, except it handles a False result from `transferFrom` and reverts in that case.
 186 |     |    *      This will revert due to insufficient balance or insufficient allowance.
 187 |     |    *      This function returns the actual amount received,
 188 |     |    *      which may be less than `amount` if there is a fee attached to the transfer.
 189 |     |    *
 190 |     |    *      Note: This wrapper safely handles non-standard ERC-20 tokens that do not return a value.
 191 |     |    *            See here: https://medium.com/coinmonks/missing-return-value-bug-at-least-130-tokens-affected-d67bf08521ca
 192 |     |    */
 193 |     |   function doTransferIn(
 194 |     |     address from,
 195 |     |     uint amount
 196 |     |   ) internal virtual override returns (uint) {
 197 |     |     // Read from storage once
 198 |     |     address underlying_ = underlying;
 199 |     |     EIP20NonStandardInterface token = EIP20NonStandardInterface(underlying_);
 200 |     |     uint balanceBefore = EIP20Interface(underlying_).balanceOf(address(this));
 201 |     |     token.transferFrom(from, address(this), amount);
 202 |     | 
 203 |     |     bool success;
 204 |     |     assembly {
 205 |     |       switch returndatasize()
 206 |     |       case 0 {
 207 |     |         // This is a non-standard ERC-20
 208 |     |         success := not(0) // set success to true
 209 |     |       }
 210 |     |       case 32 {
 211 |     |         // This is a compliant ERC-20
 212 |     |         returndatacopy(0, 0, 32)
 213 |     |         success := mload(0) // Set `success = returndata` of override external call
 214 |     |       }
 215 |     |       default {
 216 |     |         // This is an excessively non-compliant ERC-20, revert.
 217 |     |         revert(0, 0)
 218 |     |       }
 219 |     |     }
 220 |     |     require(success, "TOKEN_TRANSFER_IN_FAILED");
 221 |     | 
 222 |     |     // Calculate the amount that was *actually* transferred
 223 |     |     uint balanceAfter = EIP20Interface(underlying_).balanceOf(address(this));
 224 |     |     return balanceAfter - balanceBefore; // underflow already checked above, just subtract
 225 |     |   }
 226 |     | 
 227 |     |   /**

 229 |     |    *      error code rather than reverting. If caller has not called checked protocol's balance, this may revert due to
 230 |     |    *      insufficient cash held in this contract. If caller has checked protocol's balance prior to this call, and verified
 231 |     |    *      it is >= amount, this should not revert in normal conditions.
 232 |     |    *
 233 |     |    *      Note: This wrapper safely handles non-standard ERC-20 tokens that do not return a value.
 234 |     |    *            See here: https://medium.com/coinmonks/missing-return-value-bug-at-least-130-tokens-affected-d67bf08521ca
 235 |     |    */

 238 |     |     uint amount

 241 |     |     token.transfer(to, amount);
 242 |     | 
 243 |     |     bool success;
 244 |     |     assembly {
 245 |     |       switch returndatasize()
 246 |     |       case 0 {
 247 |     |         // This is a non-standard ERC-20
 248 |     |         success := not(0) // set success to true
 249 |     |       }
 250 |     |       case 32 {
 251 |     |         // This is a compliant ERC-20
 252 |     |         returndatacopy(0, 0, 32)
 253 |     |         success := mload(0) // Set `success = returndata` of override external call
 254 |     |       }
 255 |     |       default {
 256 |     |         // This is an excessively non-compliant ERC-20, revert.
 257 |     |         revert(0, 0)
 258 |     |       }
 259 |     |     }
 260 |     |     require(success, "TOKEN_TRANSFER_OUT_FAILED");
 261 |     |   }
 262 |     | 
 263 |     |   /**
 264 |     |    * @notice Admin call to delegate the votes of the COMP-like underlying
 265 |     |    * @param compLikeDelegatee The address to delegate votes to
 266 |     |    * @dev CTokens whose underlying are not CompLike should revert here
 267 |     |    */

 269 | *   |     require(
 270 | *   |       msg.sender == admin,
 271 |     |       "only the admin may set the comp-like delegate"
 272 |     |     );
 273 |     |     CompLike(underlying).delegate(compLikeDelegatee);

   11 |     | /**
   12 |     |  * @title Ondo's Generic CToken Contract
   13 |     |  * @notice Abstract base for CTokens w/underlying as non-CASH tokens
   14 |     |  * @dev Does sanctions and KYC checks on key functions
   15 |     |  * @author Compound + Ondo
   16 |     |  */
   17 |     | abstract contract CTokenModified is
   18 |     |   CTokenInterface,
   19 |     |   ExponentialNoError,
   20 |     |   TokenErrorReporter
   21 |     | {
   22 |     |   /**
   23 |     |    * @notice Initialize the money market
   24 |     |    * @param comptroller_ The address of the Comptroller
   25 |     |    * @param interestRateModel_ The address of the interest rate model
   26 |     |    * @param initialExchangeRateMantissa_ The initial exchange rate, scaled by 1e18
   27 |     |    * @param name_ EIP-20 name of this token
   28 |     |    * @param symbol_ EIP-20 symbol of this token
   29 |     |    * @param decimals_ EIP-20 decimal precision of this token
   30 |     |    * @param kycRegistry_ KYC Registry contract address
   31 |     |    * @param kycRequirementGroup_ KYC Requirement group to check KYC status
   32 |     |    *                             against
   33 |     |    */
   34 |     |   function initialize(
   35 |     |     ComptrollerInterface comptroller_,
   36 |     |     InterestRateModel interestRateModel_,
   37 |     |     uint initialExchangeRateMantissa_,
   38 |     |     string memory name_,
   39 |     |     string memory symbol_,
   40 |     |     uint8 decimals_,
   41 |     |     address kycRegistry_,
   42 |     |     uint256 kycRequirementGroup_
   43 |     |   ) public {
   44 | *   |     require(msg.sender == admin, "only admin may initialize the market");
   45 |     |     require(
   46 |     |       accrualBlockNumber == 0 && borrowIndex == 0,
   47 |     |       "market may only be initialized once"
   48 |     |     );
   49 |     | 
   50 |     |     // Set initial exchange rate
   51 |     |     initialExchangeRateMantissa = initialExchangeRateMantissa_;
   52 |     |     require(
   53 |     |       initialExchangeRateMantissa > 0,
   54 |     |       "initial exchange rate must be greater than zero."
   55 |     |     );
   56 |     | 
   57 |     |     // Set the comptroller
   58 |     |     uint err = _setComptroller(comptroller_);
   59 |     |     require(err == NO_ERROR, "setting comptroller failed");
   60 |     | 
   61 |     |     // Initialize block number and borrow index (block number mocks depend on comptroller being set)
   62 |     |     accrualBlockNumber = getBlockNumber();
   63 |     |     borrowIndex = mantissaOne;
   64 |     | 
   65 |     |     // Set the interest rate model (depends on block number / borrow index)
   66 |     |     err = _setInterestRateModelFresh(interestRateModel_);
   67 |     |     require(err == NO_ERROR, "setting interest rate model failed");
   68 |     | 
   69 |     |     name = name_;
   70 |     |     symbol = symbol_;
   71 |     |     decimals = decimals_;
   72 |     | 
   73 |     |     // The counter starts true to prevent changing it from zero to non-zero (i.e. smaller cost/refund)
   74 |     |     _notEntered = true;
   75 |     | 
   76 |     |     // Initialize KYCRegistryClient
   77 |     |     _setKYCRegistry(kycRegistry_);
   78 |     |     _setKYCRequirementGroup(kycRequirementGroup_);
   79 |     |   }
   80 |     | 
   81 |     |   /**
   82 |     |    * @notice Transfer `tokens` tokens from `src` to `dst` by `spender`
   83 |     |    * @dev Called by both `transfer` and `transferFrom` internally
   84 |     |    * @param spender The address of the account performing the transfer
   85 |     |    * @param src The address of the source account
   86 |     |    * @param dst The address of the destination account
   87 |     |    * @param tokens The number of tokens to transfer
   88 |     |    * @return 0 if the transfer succeeded, else revert
   89 |     |    */
   90 |     |   function transferTokens(
   91 |     |     address spender,
   92 |     |     address src,
   93 |     |     address dst,
   94 |     |     uint tokens
   95 |     |   ) internal returns (uint) {
   96 |     |     /* Revert if sanctioned */
   97 |     |     require(!sanctionsList.isSanctioned(spender), "Spender is sanctioned");
   98 |     |     require(!sanctionsList.isSanctioned(src), "Source is sanctioned");
   99 |     |     require(!sanctionsList.isSanctioned(dst), "Destination is sanctioned");
  100 |     | 
  101 |     |     /* Fail if transfer not allowed */
  102 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.transferAllowed(address(this), src, dst, tokens);
  103 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
  104 |     |       revert TransferComptrollerRejection(allowed);
  105 |     |     }
  106 |     | 
  107 |     |     /* Do not allow self-transfers */
  108 |     |     if (src == dst) {
  109 |     |       revert TransferNotAllowed();
  110 |     |     }
  111 |     | 
  112 |     |     /* Get the allowance, infinite for the account owner */
  113 |     |     uint startingAllowance = 0;
  114 |     |     if (spender == src) {
  115 |     |       startingAllowance = type(uint).max;
  116 |     |     } else {
  117 |     |       startingAllowance = transferAllowances[src][spender];
  118 |     |     }
  119 |     | 
  120 |     |     /* Do the calculations, checking for {under,over}flow */
  121 |     |     uint allowanceNew = startingAllowance - tokens;
  122 |     |     uint srcTokensNew = accountTokens[src] - tokens;
  123 |     |     uint dstTokensNew = accountTokens[dst] + tokens;
  124 |     | 
  125 |     |     /////////////////////////
  126 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  127 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  128 |     | 
  129 |     |     accountTokens[src] = srcTokensNew;
  130 |     |     accountTokens[dst] = dstTokensNew;
  131 |     | 
  132 |     |     /* Eat some of the allowance (if necessary) */
  133 |     |     if (startingAllowance != type(uint).max) {
  134 |     |       transferAllowances[src][spender] = allowanceNew;
  135 |     |     }
  136 |     | 
  137 |     |     /* We emit a Transfer event */
  138 |     |     emit Transfer(src, dst, tokens);
  139 |     | 
  140 |     |     // unused function
  141 |     |     // comptroller.transferVerify(address(this), src, dst, tokens);
  142 |     | 
  143 |     |     return NO_ERROR;
  144 |     |   }

  149 |     |    * @param amount The number of tokens to transfer
  150 |     |    * @return Whether or not the transfer succeeded
  151 |     |    */
  152 | *   |   function transfer(
  153 |     |     address dst,
  154 |     |     uint256 amount
  155 | *   |   ) external override nonReentrant returns (bool) {

  310 |     |    * @notice Return the borrow balance of account based on stored data
  311 |     |    * @param account The address whose balance should be calculated
  312 |     |    * @return (error code, the calculated balance or 0 if error code is non-zero)
  313 |     |    */
  314 |     |   function borrowBalanceStoredInternal(
  315 |     |     address account
  316 |     |   ) internal view returns (uint) {
  317 |     |     /* Get borrowBalance and borrowIndex */
  318 |     |     BorrowSnapshot storage borrowSnapshot = accountBorrows[account];
  319 |     | 
  320 |     |     /* If borrowBalance = 0 then borrowIndex is likely also 0.
  321 |     |      * Rather than failing the calculation with a division by 0, we immediately return 0 in this case.
  322 |     |      */
  323 |     |     if (borrowSnapshot.principal == 0) {
  324 |     |       return 0;
  325 |     |     }
  326 |     | 
  327 |     |     /* Calculate new borrow balance using the interest index:
  328 |     |      *  recentBorrowBalance = borrower.borrowBalance * market.borrowIndex / borrower.borrowIndex
  329 |     |      */
  330 |     |     uint principalTimesIndex = borrowSnapshot.principal * borrowIndex;
  331 |     |     return principalTimesIndex / borrowSnapshot.interestIndex;
  332 |     |   }

  352 |     |   /**
  353 |     |    * @notice Calculates the exchange rate from the underlying to the CToken
  354 |     |    * @dev This function does not accrue interest before calculating the exchange rate
  355 |     |    * @return calculated exchange rate scaled by 1e18
  356 |     |    */
  357 |     |   function exchangeRateStoredInternal() internal view virtual returns (uint) {
  358 |     |     uint _totalSupply = totalSupply;
  359 |     |     if (_totalSupply == 0) {
  360 |     |       /*
  361 |     |        * If there are no tokens minted:
  362 |     |        *  exchangeRate = initialExchangeRate
  363 |     |        */
  364 |     |       return initialExchangeRateMantissa;
  365 |     |     } else {
  366 |     |       /*
  367 |     |        * Otherwise:
  368 |     |        *  exchangeRate = (totalCash + totalBorrows - totalReserves) / totalSupply
  369 |     |        */
  370 |     |       uint totalCash = getCashPrior();
  371 |     |       uint cashPlusBorrowsMinusReserves = totalCash +
  372 |     |         totalBorrows -
  373 |     |         totalReserves;
  374 |     |       uint exchangeRate = (cashPlusBorrowsMinusReserves * expScale) /
  375 |     |         _totalSupply;
  376 |     | 
  377 |     |       return exchangeRate;
  378 |     |     }
  379 |     |   }

  389 |     |   /**
  390 |     |    * @notice Applies accrued interest to total borrows and reserves
  391 |     |    * @dev This calculates interest accrued from the last checkpointed block
  392 |     |    *   up to the current block and writes new checkpoint to storage.
  393 |     |    */
  394 | *   |   function accrueInterest() public virtual override returns (uint) {
  395 |     |     /* Remember the initial block number */
  396 |     |     uint currentBlockNumber = getBlockNumber();
  397 | *   |     uint accrualBlockNumberPrior = accrualBlockNumber;
  398 |     | 
  399 |     |     /* Short-circuit accumulating 0 interest */
  400 | *   |     if (accrualBlockNumberPrior == currentBlockNumber) {
  401 |     |       return NO_ERROR;
  402 |     |     }
  403 |     | 
  404 |     |     /* Read the previous values out of storage */
  405 | *   |     uint cashPrior = getCashPrior();
  406 |     |     uint borrowsPrior = totalBorrows;
  407 |     |     uint reservesPrior = totalReserves;
  408 |     |     uint borrowIndexPrior = borrowIndex;
  409 |     | 
  410 |     |     /* Calculate the current borrow interest rate */
  411 |     |     uint borrowRateMantissa = interestRateModel.getBorrowRate(
  412 |     |       cashPrior,
  413 |     |       borrowsPrior,
  414 |     |       reservesPrior
  415 |     |     );
  416 |     |     require(
  417 |     |       borrowRateMantissa <= borrowRateMaxMantissa,
  418 |     |       "borrow rate is absurdly high"
  419 |     |     );
  420 |     | 
  421 |     |     /* Calculate the number of blocks elapsed since the last accrual */
  422 |     |     uint blockDelta = currentBlockNumber - accrualBlockNumberPrior;
  423 |     | 
  424 |     |     /*
  425 |     |      * Calculate the interest accumulated into borrows and reserves and the new index:
  426 |     |      *  simpleInterestFactor = borrowRate * blockDelta
  427 |     |      *  interestAccumulated = simpleInterestFactor * totalBorrows
  428 |     |      *  totalBorrowsNew = interestAccumulated + totalBorrows
  429 |     |      *  totalReservesNew = interestAccumulated * reserveFactor + totalReserves
  430 |     |      *  borrowIndexNew = simpleInterestFactor * borrowIndex + borrowIndex
  431 |     |      */
  432 |     | 
  433 |     |     Exp memory simpleInterestFactor = mul_(
  434 |     |       Exp({mantissa: borrowRateMantissa}),
  435 |     |       blockDelta
  436 |     |     );
  437 |     |     uint interestAccumulated = mul_ScalarTruncate(
  438 |     |       simpleInterestFactor,
  439 |     |       borrowsPrior
  440 |     |     );
  441 |     |     uint totalBorrowsNew = interestAccumulated + borrowsPrior;
  442 |     |     uint totalReservesNew = mul_ScalarTruncateAddUInt(
  443 |     |       Exp({mantissa: reserveFactorMantissa}),
  444 |     |       interestAccumulated,
  445 |     |       reservesPrior
  446 |     |     );
  447 |     |     uint borrowIndexNew = mul_ScalarTruncateAddUInt(
  448 |     |       simpleInterestFactor,
  449 |     |       borrowIndexPrior,
  450 |     |       borrowIndexPrior
  451 |     |     );
  452 |     | 
  453 |     |     /////////////////////////
  454 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  455 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  456 |     | 
  457 |     |     /* We write the previously calculated values into storage */
  458 |     |     accrualBlockNumber = currentBlockNumber;
  459 |     |     borrowIndex = borrowIndexNew;
  460 |     |     totalBorrows = totalBorrowsNew;
  461 |     |     totalReserves = totalReservesNew;
  462 |     | 
  463 |     |     /* We emit an AccrueInterest event */
  464 |     |     emit AccrueInterest(
  465 |     |       cashPrior,
  466 |     |       interestAccumulated,
  467 |     |       borrowIndexNew,
  468 |     |       totalBorrowsNew
  469 |     |     );
  470 |     | 
  471 |     |     return NO_ERROR;
  472 |     |   }

  474 |     |   /**

  485 |     |   /**
  486 |     |    * @notice User supplies assets into the market and receives cTokens in exchange
  487 |     |    * @dev Assumes interest has already been accrued up to the current block
  488 |     |    * @param minter The address of the account which is supplying the assets
  489 |     |    * @param mintAmount The amount of the underlying asset to supply
  490 |     |    */
  491 |     |   function mintFresh(address minter, uint mintAmount) internal {
  492 |     |     /* Revert if sanctioned */
  493 |     |     require(!sanctionsList.isSanctioned(minter), "Minter is sanctioned");
  494 |     | 
  495 |     |     /* Fail if mint not allowed */
  496 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.mintAllowed(address(this), minter, mintAmount);
  497 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
  498 |     |       revert MintComptrollerRejection(allowed);
  499 |     |     }
  500 |     | 
  501 |     |     /* Verify market's block number equals current block number */
  502 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
  503 |     |       revert MintFreshnessCheck();
  504 |     |     }
  505 |     | 
  506 |     |     Exp memory exchangeRate = Exp({mantissa: exchangeRateStoredInternal()});
  507 |     | 
  508 |     |     /////////////////////////
  509 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  510 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  511 |     | 
  512 |     |     /*
  513 |     |      *  We call `doTransferIn` for the minter and the mintAmount.
  514 |     |      *  Note: The cToken must handle variations between ERC-20 and ETH underlying.
  515 |     |      *  `doTransferIn` reverts if anything goes wrong, since we can't be sure if
  516 |     |      *  side-effects occurred. The function returns the amount actually transferred,
  517 |     |      *  in case of a fee. On success, the cToken holds an additional `actualMintAmount`
  518 |     |      *  of cash.
  519 |     |      */
  520 |     |     uint actualMintAmount = doTransferIn(minter, mintAmount);
  521 |     | 
  522 |     |     /*
  523 |     |      * We get the current exchange rate and calculate the number of cTokens to be minted:
  524 |     |      *  mintTokens = actualMintAmount / exchangeRate
  525 |     |      */
  526 |     | 
  527 |     |     uint mintTokens = div_(actualMintAmount, exchangeRate);
  528 |     | 
  529 |     |     /*
  530 |     |      * We calculate the new total supply of cTokens and minter token balance, checking for overflow:
  531 |     |      *  totalSupplyNew = totalSupply + mintTokens
  532 |     |      *  accountTokensNew = accountTokens[minter] + mintTokens
  533 |     |      * And write them into storage
  534 |     |      */
  535 |     |     totalSupply = totalSupply + mintTokens;
  536 |     |     accountTokens[minter] = accountTokens[minter] + mintTokens;
  537 |     | 
  538 |     |     /* We emit a Mint event, and a Transfer event */
  539 |     |     emit Mint(minter, actualMintAmount, mintTokens);
  540 |     |     emit Transfer(address(this), minter, mintTokens);
  541 |     | 
  542 |     |     /* We call the defense hook */
  543 |     |     // unused function
  544 |     |     // comptroller.mintVerify(address(this), minter, actualMintAmount, mintTokens);
  545 |     |   }
