  569 |     |   /**
  570 |     |    * @notice User redeems cTokens in exchange for the underlying asset
  571 |     |    * @dev Assumes interest has already been accrued up to the current block
  572 |     |    * @param redeemer The address of the account which is redeeming the tokens
  573 |     |    * @param redeemTokensIn The number of cTokens to redeem into underlying (only one of redeemTokensIn or redeemAmountIn may be non-zero)
  574 |     |    * @param redeemAmountIn The number of underlying tokens to receive from redeeming cTokens (only one of redeemTokensIn or redeemAmountIn may be non-zero)
  575 |     |    */
  576 |     |   function redeemFresh(
  577 |     |     address payable redeemer,
  578 |     |     uint redeemTokensIn,
  579 |     |     uint redeemAmountIn
  580 |     |   ) internal {
  581 |     |     /* Revert if sanctioned */
  582 |     |     require(!sanctionsList.isSanctioned(redeemer), "Redeemer is sanctioned");
  583 |     | 
  584 |     |     require(
  585 |     |       redeemTokensIn == 0 || redeemAmountIn == 0,
  586 |     |       "one of redeemTokensIn or redeemAmountIn must be zero"
  587 |     |     );
  588 |     | 
  589 |     |     /* exchangeRate = invoke Exchange Rate Stored() */
  590 |     |     Exp memory exchangeRate = Exp({mantissa: exchangeRateStoredInternal()});
  591 |     | 
  592 |     |     uint redeemTokens;
  593 |     |     uint redeemAmount;
  594 |     |     /* If redeemTokensIn > 0: */
  595 |     |     if (redeemTokensIn > 0) {
  596 |     |       /*
  597 |     |        * We calculate the exchange rate and the amount of underlying to be redeemed:
  598 |     |        *  redeemTokens = redeemTokensIn
  599 |     |        *  redeemAmount = redeemTokensIn x exchangeRateCurrent
  600 |     |        */
  601 |     |       redeemTokens = redeemTokensIn;
  602 |     |       redeemAmount = mul_ScalarTruncate(exchangeRate, redeemTokensIn);
  603 |     |     } else {
  604 |     |       /*
  605 |     |        * We get the current exchange rate and calculate the amount to be redeemed:
  606 |     |        *  redeemTokens = redeemAmountIn / exchangeRate
  607 |     |        *  redeemAmount = redeemAmountIn
  608 |     |        */
  609 |     |       redeemTokens = div_(redeemAmountIn, exchangeRate);
  610 |     |       redeemAmount = redeemAmountIn;
  611 |     |     }
  612 |     | 
  613 |     |     /* Fail if redeem not allowed */
  614 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.redeemAllowed(
  615 |     |       address(this),
  616 |     |       redeemer,
  617 |     |       redeemTokens
  618 |     |     );
  619 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
  620 |     |       revert RedeemComptrollerRejection(allowed);
  621 |     |     }
  622 |     | 
  623 |     |     /* Verify market's block number equals current block number */
  624 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
  625 |     |       revert RedeemFreshnessCheck();
  626 |     |     }
  627 |     | 
  628 |     |     /* Fail gracefully if protocol has insufficient cash */
  629 |     |     if (getCashPrior() < redeemAmount) {
  630 |     |       revert RedeemTransferOutNotPossible();
  631 |     |     }
  632 |     | 
  633 |     |     /////////////////////////
  634 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  635 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  636 |     | 
  637 |     |     /*
  638 |     |      * We write the previously calculated values into storage.
  639 |     |      *  Note: Avoid token reentrancy attacks by writing reduced supply before external transfer.
  640 |     |      */
  641 |     |     totalSupply = totalSupply - redeemTokens;
  642 |     |     accountTokens[redeemer] = accountTokens[redeemer] - redeemTokens;
  643 |     | 
  644 |     |     /*
  645 |     |      * We invoke doTransferOut for the redeemer and the redeemAmount.
  646 |     |      *  Note: The cToken must handle variations between ERC-20 and ETH underlying.
  647 |     |      *  On success, the cToken has redeemAmount less of cash.
  648 |     |      *  doTransferOut reverts if anything goes wrong, since we can't be sure if side effects occurred.
  649 |     |      */
  650 |     |     doTransferOut(redeemer, redeemAmount);
  651 |     | 
  652 |     |     /* We emit a Transfer event, and a Redeem event */
  653 |     |     emit Transfer(redeemer, address(this), redeemTokens);
  654 |     |     emit Redeem(redeemer, redeemAmount, redeemTokens);
  655 |     | 
  656 |     |     /* We call the defense hook */
  657 |     |     comptroller.redeemVerify(
  658 |     |       address(this),
  659 |     |       redeemer,
  660 |     |       redeemAmount,
  661 |     |       redeemTokens
  662 |     |     );
  663 |     |   }
  664 |     | 
  665 |     |   /**
  666 |     |    * @notice Sender borrows assets from the protocol to their own address
  667 |     |    * @param borrowAmount The amount of the underlying asset to borrow
  668 |     |    */
  669 | *   |   function borrowInternal(uint borrowAmount) internal nonReentrant {
  670 |     |     accrueInterest();
  671 |     |     // borrowFresh emits borrow-specific logs on errors, so we don't need to
  672 |     |     borrowFresh(payable(msg.sender), borrowAmount);
  673 |     |   }
  674 |     | 
  675 |     |   /**
  676 |     |    * @notice Users borrow assets from the protocol to their own address
  677 |     |    * @param borrowAmount The amount of the underlying asset to borrow
  678 |     |    */
  679 |     |   function borrowFresh(address payable borrower, uint borrowAmount) internal {
  680 |     |     /* Revert if borrower not KYC'd */
  681 |     |     require(_getKYCStatus(borrower), "Borrower not KYC'd");
  682 |     | 
  683 |     |     /* Fail if borrow not allowed */
  684 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.borrowAllowed(
  685 |     |       address(this),
  686 |     |       borrower,
  687 |     |       borrowAmount
  688 |     |     );
  689 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
  690 |     |       revert BorrowComptrollerRejection(allowed);
  691 |     |     }
  692 |     | 
  693 |     |     /* Verify market's block number equals current block number */
  694 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
  695 |     |       revert BorrowFreshnessCheck();
  696 |     |     }
  697 |     | 
  698 |     |     /* Fail gracefully if protocol has insufficient underlying cash */
  699 |     |     if (getCashPrior() < borrowAmount) {
  700 |     |       revert BorrowCashNotAvailable();
  701 |     |     }
  702 |     | 
  703 |     |     /*
  704 |     |      * We calculate the new borrower and total borrow balances, failing on overflow:
  705 |     |      *  accountBorrowNew = accountBorrow + borrowAmount
  706 |     |      *  totalBorrowsNew = totalBorrows + borrowAmount
  707 |     |      */
  708 |     |     uint accountBorrowsPrev = borrowBalanceStoredInternal(borrower);
  709 |     |     uint accountBorrowsNew = accountBorrowsPrev + borrowAmount;
  710 |     |     uint totalBorrowsNew = totalBorrows + borrowAmount;
  711 |     | 
  712 |     |     /////////////////////////
  713 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  714 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  715 |     | 
  716 |     |     /*
  717 |     |          * We write the previously calculated values into storage.
  718 |     |          *  Note: Avoid token reentrancy attacks by writing increased borrow before external transfer.
  719 |     |         `*/
  720 |     |     accountBorrows[borrower].principal = accountBorrowsNew;
  721 |     |     accountBorrows[borrower].interestIndex = borrowIndex;
  722 |     |     totalBorrows = totalBorrowsNew;
  723 |     | 
  724 |     |     /*
  725 |     |      * We invoke doTransferOut for the borrower and the borrowAmount.
  726 |     |      *  Note: The cToken must handle variations between ERC-20 and ETH underlying.
  727 |     |      *  On success, the cToken borrowAmount less of cash.
  728 |     |      *  doTransferOut reverts if anything goes wrong, since we can't be sure if side effects occurred.
  729 |     |      */
  730 |     |     doTransferOut(borrower, borrowAmount);
  731 |     | 
  732 |     |     /* We emit a Borrow event */
  733 |     |     emit Borrow(borrower, borrowAmount, accountBorrowsNew, totalBorrowsNew);
  734 |     |   }
  735 |     | 
  736 |     |   /**
  737 |     |    * @notice Sender repays their own borrow
  738 |     |    * @param repayAmount The amount to repay, or -1 for the full outstanding amount
  739 |     |    */
  740 | *   |   function repayBorrowInternal(uint repayAmount) internal nonReentrant {
  741 |     |     accrueInterest();
  742 |     |     // repayBorrowFresh emits repay-borrow-specific logs on errors, so we don't need to
  743 |     |     repayBorrowFresh(msg.sender, msg.sender, repayAmount);
  744 |     |   }
  745 |     | 
  746 |     |   /**
  747 |     |    * @notice Sender repays a borrow belonging to borrower
  748 |     |    * @param borrower the account with the debt being payed off
  749 |     |    * @param repayAmount The amount to repay, or -1 for the full outstanding amount
  750 |     |    */
  751 | *   |   function repayBorrowBehalfInternal(
  752 |     |     address borrower,
  753 |     |     uint repayAmount
  754 |     |   ) internal nonReentrant {
  755 |     |     accrueInterest();
  756 |     |     // repayBorrowFresh emits repay-borrow-specific logs on errors, so we don't need to
  757 |     |     repayBorrowFresh(msg.sender, borrower, repayAmount);
  758 |     |   }
  759 |     | 
  760 |     |   /**
  761 |     |    * @notice Borrows are repaid by another user (possibly the borrower).
  762 |     |    * @param payer the account paying off the borrow
  763 |     |    * @param borrower the account with the debt being payed off
  764 |     |    * @param repayAmount the amount of underlying tokens being returned, or -1 for the full outstanding amount
  765 |     |    * @return (uint) the actual repayment amount.
  766 |     |    */
  767 |     |   function repayBorrowFresh(
  768 |     |     address payer,
  769 |     |     address borrower,
  770 |     |     uint repayAmount
  771 |     |   ) internal returns (uint) {
  772 |     |     /* Revert if not KYC'd */
  773 |     |     require(_getKYCStatus(payer), "Payer not KYC'd");
  774 |     |     require(_getKYCStatus(borrower), "Borrower not KYC'd");
  775 |     | 
  776 |     |     /* Fail if repayBorrow not allowed */
  777 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.repayBorrowAllowed(
  778 |     |       address(this),
  779 |     |       payer,
  780 |     |       borrower,
  781 |     |       repayAmount
  782 |     |     );
  783 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
  784 |     |       revert RepayBorrowComptrollerRejection(allowed);
  785 |     |     }
  786 |     | 
  787 |     |     /* Verify market's block number equals current block number */
  788 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
  789 |     |       revert RepayBorrowFreshnessCheck();
  790 |     |     }
  791 |     | 
  792 |     |     /* We fetch the amount the borrower owes, with accumulated interest */
  793 |     |     uint accountBorrowsPrev = borrowBalanceStoredInternal(borrower);
  794 |     | 
  795 |     |     /* If repayAmount == -1, repayAmount = accountBorrows */
  796 |     |     uint repayAmountFinal = repayAmount == type(uint).max
  797 |     |       ? accountBorrowsPrev
  798 |     |       : repayAmount;
  799 |     | 
  800 |     |     /////////////////////////
  801 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  802 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  803 |     | 
  804 |     |     /*
  805 |     |      * We call doTransferIn for the payer and the repayAmount
  806 |     |      *  Note: The cToken must handle variations between ERC-20 and ETH underlying.
  807 |     |      *  On success, the cToken holds an additional repayAmount of cash.
  808 |     |      *  doTransferIn reverts if anything goes wrong, since we can't be sure if side effects occurred.
  809 |     |      *   it returns the amount actually transferred, in case of a fee.
  810 |     |      */
  811 |     |     uint actualRepayAmount = doTransferIn(payer, repayAmountFinal);
  812 |     | 
  813 |     |     /*
  814 |     |      * We calculate the new borrower and total borrow balances, failing on underflow:
  815 |     |      *  accountBorrowsNew = accountBorrows - actualRepayAmount
  816 |     |      *  totalBorrowsNew = totalBorrows - actualRepayAmount
  817 |     |      */
  818 |     |     uint accountBorrowsNew = accountBorrowsPrev - actualRepayAmount;
  819 |     |     uint totalBorrowsNew = totalBorrows - actualRepayAmount;
  820 |     | 
  821 |     |     /* We write the previously calculated values into storage */
  822 |     |     accountBorrows[borrower].principal = accountBorrowsNew;
  823 |     |     accountBorrows[borrower].interestIndex = borrowIndex;
  824 |     |     totalBorrows = totalBorrowsNew;
  825 |     | 
  826 |     |     /* We emit a RepayBorrow event */
  827 |     |     emit RepayBorrow(
  828 |     |       payer,
  829 |     |       borrower,
  830 |     |       actualRepayAmount,
  831 |     |       accountBorrowsNew,
  832 |     |       totalBorrowsNew
  833 |     |     );
  834 |     | 
  835 |     |     return actualRepayAmount;
  836 |     |   }

  838 |     |   /**
  839 |     |    * @notice The sender liquidates the borrowers collateral.
  840 |     |    *  The collateral seized is transferred to the liquidator.
  841 |     |    * @param borrower The borrower of this cToken to be liquidated
  842 |     |    * @param cTokenCollateral The market in which to seize collateral from the borrower
  843 |     |    * @param repayAmount The amount of the underlying borrowed asset to repay
  844 |     |    */
  845 |     |   function liquidateBorrowInternal(
  846 |     |     address borrower,
  847 |     |     uint repayAmount,
  848 |     |     CTokenInterface cTokenCollateral
  849 |     |   ) internal nonReentrant {
  850 |     |     accrueInterest();
  851 |     | 
  852 |     |     uint error = cTokenCollateral.accrueInterest();
  853 |     |     if (error != NO_ERROR) {
  854 |     |       // accrueInterest emits logs on errors, but we still want to log the fact that an attempted liquidation failed
  855 |     |       revert LiquidateAccrueCollateralInterestFailed(error);
  856 |     |     }
  857 |     | 
  858 |     |     // liquidateBorrowFresh emits borrow-specific logs on errors, so we don't need to
  859 |     |     liquidateBorrowFresh(msg.sender, borrower, repayAmount, cTokenCollateral);
  860 |     |   }
  861 |     | 
  862 |     |   /**
  863 |     |    * @notice The liquidator liquidates the borrowers collateral.
  864 |     |    *  The collateral seized is transferred to the liquidator.
  865 |     |    * @param borrower The borrower of this cToken to be liquidated
  866 |     |    * @param liquidator The address repaying the borrow and seizing collateral
  867 |     |    * @param cTokenCollateral The market in which to seize collateral from the borrower
  868 |     |    * @param repayAmount The amount of the underlying borrowed asset to repay
  869 |     |    */
  870 |     |   function liquidateBorrowFresh(
  871 |     |     address liquidator,
  872 |     |     address borrower,
  873 |     |     uint repayAmount,
  874 |     |     CTokenInterface cTokenCollateral
  875 |     |   ) internal {
  876 |     |     /* Fail if liquidate not allowed */
  877 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.liquidateBorrowAllowed(
  878 |     |       address(this),
  879 |     |       address(cTokenCollateral),
  880 |     |       liquidator,
  881 |     |       borrower,
  882 |     |       repayAmount
  883 |     |     );
  884 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
  885 |     |       revert LiquidateComptrollerRejection(allowed);
  886 |     |     }
  887 |     | 
  888 |     |     /* Verify market's block number equals current block number */
  889 |     |     if (accrualBlockNumber != getBlockNumber()) {
  890 |     |       revert LiquidateFreshnessCheck();
  891 |     |     }
  892 |     | 
  893 |     |     /* Verify cTokenCollateral market's block number equals current block number */
  894 |     |     if (cTokenCollateral.accrualBlockNumber() != getBlockNumber()) {
  895 |     |       revert LiquidateCollateralFreshnessCheck();
  896 |     |     }
  897 |     | 
  898 |     |     /* Fail if borrower = liquidator */
  899 |     |     if (borrower == liquidator) {
  900 |     |       revert LiquidateLiquidatorIsBorrower();
  901 |     |     }
  902 |     | 
  903 |     |     /* Fail if repayAmount = 0 */
  904 |     |     if (repayAmount == 0) {
  905 |     |       revert LiquidateCloseAmountIsZero();
  906 |     |     }
  907 |     | 
  908 |     |     /* Fail if repayAmount = -1 */
  909 |     |     if (repayAmount == type(uint).max) {
  910 |     |       revert LiquidateCloseAmountIsUintMax();
  911 |     |     }
  912 |     | 
  913 |     |     /* Fail if repayBorrow fails */
  914 |     |     uint actualRepayAmount = repayBorrowFresh(
  915 |     |       liquidator,
  916 |     |       borrower,
  917 |     |       repayAmount
  918 |     |     );
  919 |     | 
  920 |     |     /////////////////////////
  921 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
  922 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
  923 |     | 
  924 |     |     /* We calculate the number of collateral tokens that will be seized */
  925 |     |     (uint amountSeizeError, uint seizeTokens) = comptroller
  926 |     |       .liquidateCalculateSeizeTokens(
  927 |     |         address(this),
  928 |     |         address(cTokenCollateral),
  929 |     |         actualRepayAmount
  930 |     |       );
  931 |     |     require(
  932 |     |       amountSeizeError == NO_ERROR,
  933 |     |       "LIQUIDATE_COMPTROLLER_CALCULATE_AMOUNT_SEIZE_FAILED"
  934 |     |     );
  935 |     | 
  936 |     |     /* Revert if borrower collateral token balance < seizeTokens */
  937 |     |     require(
  938 |     |       cTokenCollateral.balanceOf(borrower) >= seizeTokens,
  939 |     |       "LIQUIDATE_SEIZE_TOO_MUCH"
  940 |     |     );
  941 |     | 
  942 |     |     // If this is also the collateral, run seizeInternal to avoid re-entrancy, otherwise make an external call
  943 |     |     if (address(cTokenCollateral) == address(this)) {
  944 |     |       seizeInternal(address(this), liquidator, borrower, seizeTokens);
  945 |     |     } else {
  946 |     |       require(
  947 |     |         cTokenCollateral.seize(liquidator, borrower, seizeTokens) == NO_ERROR,
  948 |     |         "token seizure failed"
  949 |     |       );
  950 |     |     }
  951 |     | 
  952 |     |     /* We emit a LiquidateBorrow event */
  953 |     |     emit LiquidateBorrow(
  954 |     |       liquidator,
  955 |     |       borrower,
  956 |     |       actualRepayAmount,
  957 |     |       address(cTokenCollateral),
  958 |     |       seizeTokens
  959 |     |     );
  960 |     |   }
  961 |     | 
  962 |     |   /**
  963 |     |    * @notice Transfers collateral tokens (this market) to the liquidator.
  964 |     |    * @dev Will fail unless called by another cToken during the process of liquidation.
  965 |     |    *  Its absolutely critical to use msg.sender as the borrowed cToken and not a parameter.
  966 |     |    * @param liquidator The account receiving seized collateral
  967 |     |    * @param borrower The account having collateral seized
  968 |     |    * @param seizeTokens The number of cTokens to seize
  969 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
  970 |     |    */
  971 | *   |   function seize(
  972 |     |     address liquidator,
  973 |     |     address borrower,
  974 |     |     uint seizeTokens
  975 | *   |   ) external override nonReentrant returns (uint) {
  976 |     |     seizeInternal(msg.sender, liquidator, borrower, seizeTokens);
  977 |     | 
  978 |     |     return NO_ERROR;
  979 |     |   }
  980 |     | 
  981 |     |   /**
  982 |     |    * @notice Transfers collateral tokens (this market) to the liquidator.
  983 |     |    * @dev Called only during an in-kind liquidation, or by liquidateBorrow during the liquidation of another CToken.
  984 |     |    *  Its absolutely critical to use msg.sender as the seizer cToken and not a parameter.
  985 |     |    * @param seizerToken The contract seizing the collateral (i.e. borrowed cToken)
  986 |     |    * @param liquidator The account receiving seized collateral
  987 |     |    * @param borrower The account having collateral seized
  988 |     |    * @param seizeTokens The number of cTokens to seize
  989 |     |    */
  990 |     |   function seizeInternal(
  991 |     |     address seizerToken,
  992 |     |     address liquidator,
  993 |     |     address borrower,
  994 |     |     uint seizeTokens
  995 |     |   ) internal {
  996 |     |     /* Revert if sanctioned */
  997 |     |     require(
  998 |     |       !sanctionsList.isSanctioned(liquidator),
  999 |     |       "Liquidator is sanctioned"
 1000 |     |     );
 1001 |     |     require(!sanctionsList.isSanctioned(borrower), "Borrower is sanctioned");
 1002 |     | 
 1003 |     |     /* Fail if seize not allowed */
 1004 |     |     uint allowed = comptroller.seizeAllowed(
 1005 |     |       address(this),
 1006 |     |       seizerToken,
 1007 |     |       liquidator,
 1008 |     |       borrower,
 1009 |     |       seizeTokens
 1010 |     |     );
 1011 |     |     if (allowed != 0) {
 1012 |     |       revert LiquidateSeizeComptrollerRejection(allowed);
 1013 |     |     }
 1014 |     | 
 1015 |     |     /* Fail if borrower = liquidator */
 1016 |     |     if (borrower == liquidator) {
 1017 |     |       revert LiquidateSeizeLiquidatorIsBorrower();
 1018 |     |     }
 1019 |     | 
 1020 |     |     /*
 1021 |     |      * We calculate the new borrower and liquidator token balances, failing on underflow/overflow:
 1022 |     |      *  borrowerTokensNew = accountTokens[borrower] - seizeTokens
 1023 |     |      *  liquidatorTokensNew = accountTokens[liquidator] + seizeTokens
 1024 |     |      */
 1025 |     |     uint protocolSeizeTokens = mul_(
 1026 |     |       seizeTokens,
 1027 |     |       Exp({mantissa: protocolSeizeShareMantissa})
 1028 |     |     );
 1029 |     |     uint liquidatorSeizeTokens = seizeTokens - protocolSeizeTokens;
 1030 |     |     Exp memory exchangeRate = Exp({mantissa: exchangeRateStoredInternal()});
 1031 |     |     uint protocolSeizeAmount = mul_ScalarTruncate(
 1032 |     |       exchangeRate,
 1033 |     |       protocolSeizeTokens
 1034 |     |     );
 1035 |     |     uint totalReservesNew = totalReserves + protocolSeizeAmount;
 1036 |     | 
 1037 |     |     /////////////////////////
 1038 |     |     // EFFECTS & INTERACTIONS
 1039 |     |     // (No safe failures beyond this point)
 1040 |     | 
 1041 |     |     /* We write the calculated values into storage */
 1042 |     |     totalReserves = totalReservesNew;
 1043 |     |     totalSupply = totalSupply - protocolSeizeTokens;
 1044 |     |     accountTokens[borrower] = accountTokens[borrower] - seizeTokens;
 1045 |     |     accountTokens[liquidator] =
 1046 |     |       accountTokens[liquidator] +
 1047 |     |       liquidatorSeizeTokens;
 1048 |     | 
 1049 |     |     /* Emit a Transfer event */
 1050 |     |     emit Transfer(borrower, liquidator, liquidatorSeizeTokens);
 1051 |     |     emit Transfer(borrower, address(this), protocolSeizeTokens);
 1052 |     |     emit ReservesAdded(address(this), protocolSeizeAmount, totalReservesNew);
 1053 |     |   }

 1110 |     |   /**
 1111 |     |    * @notice Sets a new comptroller for the market
 1112 |     |    * @dev Admin function to set a new comptroller
 1113 |     |    * @return uint 0=success, otherwise a failure (see ErrorReporter.sol for details)
 1114 |     |    */
 1115 |     |   function _setComptroller(
 1116 |     |     ComptrollerInterface newComptroller
 1117 |     |   ) public override returns (uint) {
 1118 |     |     // Check caller is admin
 1119 |     |     if (msg.sender != admin) {
 1120 |     |       revert SetComptrollerOwnerCheck();
 1121 |     |     }
 1122 |     | 
 1123 |     |     ComptrollerInterface oldComptroller = comptroller;
 1124 |     |     // Ensure invoke comptroller.isComptroller() returns true

 267 |     |     // Give create a role for the default KYC group and then

 270 |     |     registry.assignRoletoKYCGroup(kycRequirementGroup, KYC_GROUP_2_ROLE);

 308 |     |   function _formatACRevert(
 309 |     |     address account,
 310 |     |     bytes32 role
 311 |     |   ) internal pure returns (bytes memory) {
 312 |     |     string memory error1 = "AccessControl: account ";
 313 |     |     string memory error2 = " is missing role ";
 314 |     |     return
 315 |     |       abi.encodePacked(
 316 |     |         error1,
 317 |     |         Strings.toHexString(uint160(account), 20),
 318 |     |         error2,
 319 |     |         Strings.toHexString(uint256(role))
 320 |     |       );
 321 |     |   }

 324 |     |     address[] memory addressesToKYC = new address[](1);
 325 |     |     addressesToKYC[0] = account;
 326 |     |     registry.addKYCAddresses(level, addressesToKYC);
 327 |     |   }
 328 |     | 
 329 |     |   function _removeAddressFromKYC(uint256 level, address account) internal {
 330 |     |     address[] memory addressesToRemoveKYC = new address[](1);
 331 |     |     addressesToRemoveKYC[0] = account;
 332 |     |     registry.removeKYCAddresses(level, addressesToRemoveKYC);
 333 |     |   }
 334 |     | 
 335 |     |   function _addAddressToSanctionsList(address sanctionedAccount) internal {
 336 |     |     address[] memory newSanctions = new address[](1);
 337 |     |     newSanctions[0] = sanctionedAccount;
 338 |     |     vm.prank(SANCTIONS_ORACLE.owner());
 339 |     |     SANCTIONS_ORACLE.addToSanctionsList(newSanctions);
 340 |     |   }
 341 |     | 
 342 |     |   function _removeAddressFromSanctionsList(address account) internal {
 343 |     |     address[] memory removeSanctions = new address[](1);
 344 |     |     removeSanctions[0] = account;
 345 |     |     vm.prank(SANCTIONS_ORACLE.owner());
 346 |     |     SANCTIONS_ORACLE.removeFromSanctionsList(removeSanctions);
 347 |     |   }

/home/user/2023-01-ondo/forge-tests/cash/cash_manager/Epoch.t.sol
   1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: UNLICENSED
   2 |     | pragma solidity 0.8.16;
   3 |     | 
   4 |     | import "forge-tests/cash/BasicDeployment.sol";
   5 |     | 
   6 |     | contract TestEpoch is BasicDeployment {
   7 |     |   function setUp() public {
   8 |     |     createDeploymentCash();
   9 |     | 
  10 |     |     // Seed address with 1000000 USDC
  11 |     |     vm.prank(USDC_WHALE);
  12 |     |     USDC.transfer(address(this), INIT_BALANCE_USDC);
  13 |     | 
  14 |     |     // Grant admin role to this contract
  15 |     |     vm.startPrank(managerAdmin);
  16 |     |     cashManager.grantRole(cashManager.MANAGER_ADMIN(), address(this));
  17 |     |     vm.stopPrank();
  18 |     | 
  19 |     |     vm.prank(guardian);
  20 |     |     cashManager.grantRole(cashManager.SETTER_ADMIN(), address(this));
  21 |     |   }
  22 |     | 
  23 |     |   /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
  24 |     |                     Epoch Transition - Mints
  25 |     |   //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
  26 |     | 
  27 |     |   function test_epochTransition_singleEpoch() public {
  28 |     |     uint256 epochTimestampBefore = cashManager.currentEpochStartTimestamp();
  29 |     | 
  30 |     |     // Increase timestamp
  31 |     |     vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days);
  32 |     | 
  33 |     |     // Set mint exchange rate to advance epochs
  34 |     |     cashManager.setMintExchangeRate(2e6, 0);
  35 |     | 
  36 |     |     // Check Epochs
  37 |     |     assertEq(cashManager.currentEpoch(), 1);
  38 |     |     // Start timestamp be aligned to a day
  39 |     |     assertEq(cashManager.currentEpochStartTimestamp() % 1 days, 0);
  40 |     |     assertEq(
  41 |     |       cashManager.currentEpochStartTimestamp() - epochTimestampBefore,
  42 |     |       1 days
  43 |     |     );
  44 |     |   }
  45 |     | 
  46 |     |   function test_epochTransition_multiEpoch() public {
  47 |     |     uint256 epochTimestampBefore = cashManager.currentEpochStartTimestamp();
  48 |     | 
  49 |     |     // Increase timestamp
  50 |     |     vm.warp(block.timestamp + 2 days);
  51 |     | 
  52 |     |     // Set mint exchange rate to advance epochs
  53 |     |     cashManager.setMintExchangeRate(2e6, 1);
  54 |     | 
  55 |     |     // Check Epochs
  56 |     |     assertEq(cashManager.currentEpoch(), 2);
  57 |     |     // Start timestamp be aligned to a day
  58 |     |     assertEq(cashManager.currentEpochStartTimestamp() % 1 days, 0);
  59 |     |     assertEq(
  60 |     |       cashManager.currentEpochStartTimestamp() - epochTimestampBefore,
  61 |     |       2 days
  62 |     |     );
  63 |     |   }
  64 |     | 
  65 |     |   function test_fuzz_epochTransition(uint32 timestampIncrement) public {
  66 |     |     uint256 epochDuration = cashManager.epochDuration();
  67 |     |     uint256 epochTimestampBefore = cashManager.currentEpochStartTimestamp();
  68 |     | 
  69 |     |     // Increase Timestamp
  70 |     |     vm.warp(block.timestamp + timestampIncrement);
  71 |     | 
  72 |     |     // Set mint exchange rate to advance epochs
  73 |     |     if ((timestampIncrement / epochDuration) > 1) {
  74 |     |       cashManager.setMintExchangeRate(
  75 |     |         2e6,
  76 |     |         (timestampIncrement / epochDuration) - 1
  77 |     |       );
  78 |     |     }
  79 |     | 
  80 |     |     // Get timestamp diff between epochs
  81 |     |     uint256 epochTimestampDiff = cashManager.currentEpochStartTimestamp() -
  82 |     |       epochTimestampBefore;
  83 |     | 
  84 |     |     // If timestamp increment is less than epoch duration, epoch should not change
  85 |     |     if (epochTimestampDiff < epochDuration) {
  86 |     |       assertEq(cashManager.currentEpoch(), 0);
  87 |     |       assertEq(cashManager.currentEpochStartTimestamp(), epochTimestampBefore);
  88 |     |     } else {
  89 |     |       // Epoch transition math in CashManager should be equivalent to:
  90 |     |       // expectedEpochTimestmap = epochDuration * expectedEpochsPassed + prevEpochStartTimestamp
  91 |     |       // or, expectedEpochsPassed = (expectedEpochTimestmap - prevEpochStartTimestamp) / epochDuration
  92 |     |       uint256 expectedEpochTimestamp = block.timestamp -
  93 |     |         (block.timestamp % epochDuration);
  94 |     |       uint256 expectedEpoch = (expectedEpochTimestamp - epochTimestampBefore) /
  95 |     |         epochDuration;
  96 |     |       assertEq(cashManager.currentEpoch(), expectedEpoch);
  97 |     |       assertEq(
  98 |     |         cashManager.currentEpochStartTimestamp(),
  99 |     |         expectedEpochTimestamp
 100 |     |       );
 101 |     |       assertEq(epochTimestampDiff, expectedEpoch * epochDuration);
 102 |     |     }
 103 |     |   }
 104 |     | }
 105 |     |

 217 |     |     USDC.approve(address(cashManager), 10e6);

 225 |     |     assertEq(cashManager.mintRequestsPerEpoch(0, alice), 10e6);
 226 |     |     assertEq(USDC.balanceOf(alice), 990e6);
 227 |     | 
 228 |     |     // Clear pending balance.
 229 |     |     vm.expectEmit(true, true, true, true);
 230 |     |     emit PendingMintBalanceSet(alice, 0, 10e6, 0);
 231 |     |     vm.prank(managerAdmin);
 232 |     |     cashManager.setPendingMintBalance(alice, 0, 10e6, 0);
 233 |     |     assertEq(cashManager.mintRequestsPerEpoch(0, alice), 0);
 234 |     |     vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days);
 235 |     | 
 236 |     |     // Enable claims on epoch 0 by setting exchange rate
 237 |     |     cashManager.setMintExchangeRate(1e6, 0);
 238 |     |     // Claim fails because Alice's pending deposit amount was
 239 |     |     // deleted
 240 |     |     vm.prank(alice);
 241 |     |     vm.expectRevert(ICashManager.NoCashToClaim.selector);
 242 |     |     cashManager.claimMint(alice, 0);
 243 |     |   }

/home/user/2023-01-ondo/forge-tests/cash/cash_manager/MultiCall.t.sol
  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: UNLICENSED
  2 |     | pragma solidity 0.8.16;
  3 |     | 
  4 |     | import "forge-tests/cash/BasicDeployment.sol";
  5 |     | import "contracts/cash/interfaces/IMulticall.sol";
  6 |     | 
  7 |     | contract TestMultiCall is BasicDeployment {
  8 |     |   // Sourced from contracts/external/openzeppelin/contracts/token/IERC20.sol
  9 |     |   bytes4 private constant FUNC_SELECTOR =
 10 |     |     bytes4(keccak256("transfer(address,uint256)"));
 11 |     |   IMulticall.ExCallData[] functors;
 12 |     | 
 13 |     |   function setUp() public {
 14 |     |     createDeploymentCash();
 15 |     |     delete functors;
 16 |     | 
 17 |     |     vm.startPrank(managerAdmin);
 18 |     |     cashManager.grantRole(cashManager.MANAGER_ADMIN(), address(this));
 19 |     |     cashManager.grantRole(cashManager.SETTER_ADMIN(), address(this));
 20 |     |     vm.stopPrank();
 21 |     | 
 22 |     |     vm.prank(pauser);
 23 |     |     cashManager.pause();
 24 |     | 
 25 |     |     // Seed the cash manager contract with USDC. This should not happen in
 26 |     |     // normal operation.
 27 |     |     vm.prank(USDC_WHALE);
 28 |     |     USDC.transfer(address(cashManager), INIT_BALANCE_USDC);
 29 |     |   }
 30 |     | 
 31 |     |   function addTransferToFunctors() private {
 32 |     |     // Transfer 1 USDC to Alice.
 33 |     |     bytes memory data = abi.encodeWithSelector(FUNC_SELECTOR, alice, 1e6);
 34 |     |     IMulticall.ExCallData memory functor;
 35 |     |     functor.data = data;
 36 |     |     functor.target = address(0xA0b86991c6218b36c1d19D4a2e9Eb0cE3606eB48);
 37 |     |     functors.push(functor);
 38 |     |   }
 39 |     | 
 40 |     |   function test_successful_return() public {
 41 |     |     assertEq(USDC.balanceOf(address(cashManager)), INIT_BALANCE_USDC);
 42 |     |     addTransferToFunctors();
 43 |     |     vm.prank(managerAdmin);
 44 |     |     bytes[] memory result = cashManager.multiexcall(functors);
 45 |     |     assertEq(USDC.balanceOf(address(cashManager)), INIT_BALANCE_USDC - 1e6);
 46 |     |     assertEq(USDC.balanceOf(address(alice)), 1e6);
 47 |     |     assertEq(result.length, 1);
 48 |     |     assertEq(uint256(bytes32(result[0])), 1);
 49 |     |   }
 50 |     | 
 51 |     |   function test_wrong_caller() public {
 52 |     |     assertEq(USDC.balanceOf(address(cashManager)), INIT_BALANCE_USDC);
 53 |     |     addTransferToFunctors();
 54 |     |     vm.expectRevert(_formatACRevert(alice, cashManager.MANAGER_ADMIN()));
 55 |     |     vm.prank(alice);
 56 |     |     cashManager.multiexcall(functors);
 57 |     |   }
 58 |     | 
 59 |     |   function test_not_paused() public {
 60 |     |     assertEq(USDC.balanceOf(address(cashManager)), INIT_BALANCE_USDC);
 61 |     |     addTransferToFunctors();
 62 |     |     vm.startPrank(managerAdmin);
 63 |     |     cashManager.unpause();
 64 |     |     vm.expectRevert("Pausable: not paused");
 65 |     |     cashManager.multiexcall(functors);
 66 |     |     vm.stopPrank();
 67 |     |   }
 68 |     | }

 348 |     |     // Move forward to the next epoch
 349 |     |     vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days);
 350 |     |     vm.prank(managerAdmin);
 351 |     |     cashManager.setMintExchangeRate(2e6, 0);
 352 |     | 
 353 |     |     // Approve the cashManager contract from the assetSender account
 354 |     |     _seedSenderWithCollateral(1850e6);
 355 |     | 
 356 |     |     // Airdrop Alice and bob their collateral
 357 |     |     toWithdraw.push(alice);
 358 |     |     toWithdraw.push(bob);
 359 |     | 
 360 |     |     vm.prank(managerAdmin);
 361 |     |     cashManager.completeRedemptions(
 362 |     |       toWithdraw, // Addresses to issue collateral to
 363 |     |       toRefund, // Addresses to refund cash
 364 |     |       1850e6, // Total amount of money to dist incl fees
 365 |     |       0, // Epoch we wish to process
 366 |     |       50e6 // Fee amount to be transferred to ondo
 367 |     |     );
 368 |     | 
 369 |     |     // assert that bob gets 5/6ths of the total amount - fees
 370 |     |     uint256 expectedBob = (5 * 1800e6) / 6;
 371 |     |     uint256 expectedAlice = 1800e6 / 6;
 372 |     |     assertEq(USDC.balanceOf(alice), expectedAlice);
 373 |     |     assertEq(USDC.balanceOf(bob), expectedBob);
 374 |     |     assertEq(USDC.balanceOf(feeRecipient), 50e6);
 375 |     |   }

 405 |     |   function test_redeem_clear_pending() public {
 406 |     |     _seed(100e18, 100e18, 0);
 407 |     | 
 408 |     |     // Have alice request to withdraw 100 cash tokens
 409 |     |     vm.startPrank(alice);
 410 |     |     tokenProxied.approve(address(cashManager), 100e18);
 411 |     |     cashManager.requestRedemption(100e18);
 412 |     |     vm.stopPrank();
 413 |     | 
 414 |     |     vm.startPrank(bob);
 415 |     |     tokenProxied.approve(address(cashManager), 100e18);
 416 |     |     cashManager.requestRedemption(100e18);
 417 |     |     vm.stopPrank();
 418 |     | 
 419 |     |     // Move forward to the next epoch
 420 |     |     vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days);
 421 |     |     vm.prank(managerAdmin);
 422 |     |     vm.expectEmit(true, true, true, true);
 423 |     |     emit PendingRedemptionBalanceSet(alice, 0, 0, 100e18);
 424 |     |     cashManager.setPendingRedemptionBalance(alice, 0, 0);
 425 |     |     // Bob still has 100 pending
 426 |     |     assertEq(cashManager.redemptionInfoPerEpoch(0), 100e18);
 427 |     |     assertEq(cashManager.getBurnedQuantity(0, alice), 0);
 428 |     |     assertEq(cashManager.getBurnedQuantity(0, bob), 100e18);
 429 |     | 
 430 |     |     // Approve the cashMinter contract from the assetSender account
 431 |     |     _seedSenderWithCollateral(200e6);
 432 |     | 
 433 |     |     toWithdraw.push(bob);
 434 |     |     vm.prank(managerAdmin);
 435 |     |     cashManager.completeRedemptions(toWithdraw, toRefund, 200e6, 0, 10e6);
 436 |     |     assertEq(tokenProxied.balanceOf(alice), 0);
 437 |     |     assertEq(tokenProxied.balanceOf(bob), 0);
 438 |     |     assertEq(USDC.balanceOf(address(feeRecipient)), 10e6);
 439 |     |     assertEq(USDC.balanceOf(alice), 0);
 440 |     |     assertEq(USDC.balanceOf(bob), 190e6);
 441 |     |   }

 447 |     |   function _seedUser(address user) internal {
 448 |     |     vm.prank(guardian);

 453 |     |   function _removeRedeemLimit() internal {
 454 |     |     vm.prank(managerAdmin);
 455 |     |     cashManager.setRedeemLimit(type(uint256).max);
 456 |     |   }

 458 |     |   function _seed(
 459 |     |     uint256 aliceAmt,
 460 |     |     uint256 bobAmt,
 461 |     |     uint256 charlieAmt
 462 |     |   ) internal {
 463 |     |     vm.startPrank(guardian);
 464 |     |     tokenProxied.mint(alice, aliceAmt);
 465 |     |     tokenProxied.mint(bob, bobAmt);
 466 |     |     tokenProxied.mint(charlie, charlieAmt);
 467 |     |     vm.stopPrank();
 468 |     |   }
 469 |     | 
 470 |     |   function _seedSenderWithCollateral(uint256 usdcAmount) internal {
 471 |     |     vm.prank(USDC_WHALE);
 472 |     |     USDC.transfer(assetSender, usdcAmount);
 473 |     |     vm.prank(assetSender);
 474 |     |     USDC.approve(address(cashManager), usdcAmount);
 475 |     |   }

 11 |     | // GNU General Public License for more details.
 12 |     | 
 13 |     | // You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 14 |     | // along with this program.  If not, see <http://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 15 |     | 
 16 |     | pragma solidity >=0.4.23;
 17 |     | 
 18 |     | import "forge-std/Test.sol";
 19 |     | import "forge-std/Vm.sol";
 20 |     | 
 21 |     | contract DSTestPlus is Test {
 22 |     |   uint256 constant ALMOST_EQ_PERCENT = 1;
 23 |     | 
 24 |     |   function assertAlmostEq(uint256 a, uint256 b) internal {
 25 |     |     uint256 delta = (a * ALMOST_EQ_PERCENT) / 100;
 26 |     |     if (a < b - delta || a > b + delta) {
 27 |     |       emit log("Error: a == b not satisfied [uint]");
 28 |     |       emit log_named_uint("  Expected", b);
 29 |     |       emit log_named_uint("    Actual", a);
 30 |     |       fail();
 31 |     |     }
 32 |     |   }
 33 |     | 
 34 |     |   function assertAlmostEq(
 35 |     |     uint256 a,
 36 |     |     uint256 b,
 37 |     |     uint256 _acceptableError
 38 |     |   ) internal {
 39 |     |     // Handle underflow scenario where acceptableError > b by setting the
 40 |     |     // lower bound of comparison to 0 rather than a negative number
 41 |     |     uint256 lowerBound = _acceptableError >= b ? 0 : b - _acceptableError;
 42 |     | 
 43 |     |     if (a < lowerBound || a > b + _acceptableError) {
 44 |     |       emit log("Error: a == b not satisfied w/n acceptable error");
 45 |     |       emit log_named_uint("  Expected", b);
 46 |     |       emit log_named_uint("    Actual", a);
 47 |     |       fail();
 48 |     |     }
 49 |     |   }
 50 |     | 
 51 |     |   function assertAlmostEqBps(
 52 |     |     uint256 a,
 53 |     |     uint256 b,
 54 |     |     uint256 bpsAcceptableError
 55 |     |   ) internal {
 56 |     |     uint256 delta = (a * bpsAcceptableError) / 10000;
 57 |     |     if (a < b - delta || a > b + delta) {
 58 |     |       emit log("Error: a == b not satisfied [uint]");
 59 |     |       emit log_named_uint("  Expected", b);
 60 |     |       emit log_named_uint("    Actual", a);
 61 |     |       fail();
 62 |     |     }
 63 |     |   }
 64 |     | 
 65 |     |   function assertAlmostEq(uint256 a, uint256 b, string memory err) internal {
 66 |     |     uint256 delta = (a * ALMOST_EQ_PERCENT) / 100;
 67 |     |     if (a < b - delta || a > b + delta) {
 68 |     |       emit log_named_string("Error", err);
 69 |     |       assertEq(a, b);
 70 |     |     }
 71 |     |   }
 72 |     | }

   1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: UNLICENSED
   2 |     | pragma solidity 0.8.16;

   4 |     | import "forge-tests/cash/BasicDeployment.sol";

   7 |     | abstract contract TestCashLifeCycle is BasicDeployment {
   8 |     |   address[] toRedeem;
   9 |     |   address[] toRefund;
  10 |     |   uint256 totalDeposits;
  11 |     |   uint256 lastEpochSaved;
  12 |     | 
  13 |     |   /*//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
  14 |     |                             Unit Tests
  15 |     |     //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////*/
  16 |     | 
  17 |     |   /**
  18 |     |    * @notice tests that a single user is able to request mint and claim
  19 |     |    */
  20 |     |   function test_request_and_claim() public {
  21 |     |     test_fuzz_request_and_claim(500e6);
  22 |     |   }
  23 |     | 
  24 |     |   /**
  25 |     |    * @notice tests Cash backing invariant assuming multiple users request to mint
  26 |     |    *         w/n the same epoch.
  27 |     |    */
  28 |     |   function test_request_and_claim_multiple_users() public {
  29 |     |     test_fuzz_amount_request_and_claim_multiple_users(100e6);
  30 |     |   }
  31 |     | 
  32 |     |   /**
  33 |     |    * @notice Test for basic mint -> redeem logic
  34 |     |    */
  35 |     |   function test_request_claim_redeem() public {
  36 |     |     test_fuzz_request_claim_redeem(500e6);
  37 |     |   }
  38 |     | 
  39 |     |   /**
  40 |     |    * @notice Example to cover scenarios in which multiple users:
  41 |     |    *      1) requestMint
  42 |     |    *      2) claimMint
  43 |     |    *      3) requestRedemption
  44 |     |    * This test ensures that users are airdropped collateral
  45 |     |    * corresponding to their respective ratio of collateral provided
  46 |     |    */
  47 |     |   function test_request_claim_redeem_2_users() public {
  48 |     |     test_fuzz_request_claim_redeem_2_users(500e6, 1200e6);
  49 |     |   }
  50 |     | 
  51 |     |   /**
  52 |     |    * @notice Example to cover scenarios in which value accrual is discrete.
  53 |     |    *         Namely that interest is distributed to only those users who hold
  54 |     |    *         cash tokens prior to value being accrued to the NAV
  55 |     |    */
  56 |     |   function test_value_accrues_to_correct_users() public {
  57 |     |     for (uint256 i = 0; i < 20; ++i) {
  58 |     |       seed_and_request_user(users[i], (i * 10e6) + 1e6);
  59 |     |     }
  60 |     | 
  61 |     |     vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days); // E0 -> E1
  62 |     |     cashManager.setMintExchangeRate(1e6, 0);
  63 |     | 
  64 |     |     for (uint256 i = 0; i < 20; ++i) {
  65 |     |       claim_mint_user(users[i], 0);
  66 |     |       assertEq(tokenProxied.balanceOf(users[i]), ((i * 10e6) + 1e6) * 1e12);
  67 |     |     }
  68 |     | 
  69 |     |     vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days); // E1 -> E2 (NAV constant)

 258 |     |   /**
 259 |     |    * @notice Test case to ensure that groups of users who deposit w/n given
 260 |     |    *         epochs are credited different amounts of interest earned assuming
 261 |     |    *         that both of these groups of users `requestRedemption` w/n the same
 262 |     |    *         epoch
 263 |     |    */
 264 |     |   function test_fuzz_constant_accrual(uint64 amt1, uint64 amt2) public {
 265 |     |     vm.assume(amt1 >= 100e6 && amt1 < 50_000e6);
 266 |     |     vm.assume(amt2 >= 100e6 && amt2 < 50_000e6);
 267 |     |     for (uint256 i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
 268 |     |       seed_and_request_user(users[i], amt1);
 269 |     |     }
 270 |     | 
 271 |     |     vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days); // E0 -> E1
 272 |     |     cashManager.setMintExchangeRate(1e6, 0);
 273 |     |     console.log("The nav at the end of E0", get_predetermined_nav());
 274 |     |     console.log("The current epoch is", cashManager.currentEpoch());
 275 |     | 
 276 |     |     // Have users 0-9 claim their tokens and credit their deposits to the account
 277 |     |     for (uint256 i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
 278 |     |       claim_mint_user(users[i], 0);
 279 |     |       totalDeposits += uint256(amt1);
 280 |     |       // assertEq(tokenProxied.balanceOf(users[i]), amt1 * 1e12);
 281 |     |     }
 282 |     | 
 283 |     |     // Have users 10-14 request to deposit their money is in transit
 284 |     |     for (uint256 i = 10; i < 15; ++i) {
 285 |     |       seed_and_request_user(users[i], amt2);
 286 |     |     }
 287 |     | 
 288 |     |     // Move to the next epoch
 289 |     |     vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days); // E1 -> E2
 290 |     |     cashManager.transitionEpoch();
 291 |     |     // Accrue interest on money in the account
 292 |     |     get_predetermined_nav();
 293 |     |     // Determine the mint rate for users who requested to mint in E1
 294 |     |     uint256 rate = ((totalDeposits) * 1e18) / tokenProxied.totalSupply();
 295 |     |     console.log("The solved rate is", rate);
 296 |     |     cashManager.setMintExchangeRate(rate, 1);
 297 |     |     for (uint256 i = 10; i < 15; ++i) {
 298 |     |       claim_mint_user(users[i], 1);
 299 |     |       totalDeposits += amt2;
 300 |     |     }
 301 |     | 
 302 |     |     console.log("The current epoch is", cashManager.currentEpoch());
 303 |     |     console.log("The nav at this epoch", get_predetermined_nav());
 304 |     |     console.log("The total supply of cash", tokenProxied.totalSupply());
 305 |     | 
 306 |     |     // Fast forward 10 epochs
 307 |     |     for (uint256 i = 0; i < 10; ++i) {
 308 |     |       vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days);
 309 |     |       cashManager.transitionEpoch();
 310 |     |       get_predetermined_nav();
 311 |     |     }
 312 |     | 
 313 |     |     // Have all users request to redemption in Epoch 12
 314 |     |     for (uint256 i = 0; i < 15; ++i) {
 315 |     |       request_redemption_user(users[i], tokenProxied.balanceOf(users[i]));
 316 |     |       toRedeem.push(users[i]);
 317 |     |     }
 318 |     | 
 319 |     |     vm.warp(block.timestamp + 1 days);
 320 |     |     cashManager.transitionEpoch();
 321 |     |     console.log(
 322 |     |       "The epoch in which redemptions are serviced",
 323 |     |       cashManager.currentEpoch()
 324 |     |     );
 325 |     |     console.log(
 326 |     |       "The current nav @ time of redemption:",
 327 |     |       get_predetermined_nav()
 328 |     |     );
 329 |     |     serviceEpoch(toRedeem, toRefund, totalDeposits, 12);
 330 |     | 
 331 |     |     // Calculate the interest accrued to each user and assert that is ~1bps of the
 332 |     |     // value that they receive
 333 |     |     assertAlmostEqBps(
 334 |     |       USDC.balanceOf(users[1]),
 335 |     |       (_rpow(10010, 12, 1e4) * amt1) / 1e4,
 336 |     |       1
 337 |     |     );
 338 |     |     assertAlmostEqBps(
 339 |     |       USDC.balanceOf(users[11]),
 340 |     |       (_rpow(10010, 11, 1e4) * amt2) / 1e4,
 341 |     |       1
 342 |     |     );
 343 |     |   }

 356 |     |   function serviceEpoch(
 357 |     |     address[] memory users,
 358 |     |     address[] memory _toRefund,
 359 |     |     uint256 amountToDist,
 360 |     |     uint256 epoch
 361 |     |   ) public {
 362 |     |     vm.prank(USDC_WHALE);
 363 |     |     USDC.transfer(assetSender, amountToDist);
 364 |     |     vm.startPrank(assetSender);
 365 |     |     USDC.approve(address(cashManager), amountToDist);
 366 |     |     vm.stopPrank();
 367 |     | 
 368 |     |     vm.prank(managerAdmin);
 369 |     |     cashManager.completeRedemptions(
 370 |     |       users,
 371 |     |       _toRefund, // no users to refund cash token
 372 |     |       amountToDist,
 373 |     |       epoch,
 374 |     |       0 // 0 fees
 375 |     |     );
 376 |     |   }

 378 |     |   function seed_and_request_user(address user, uint256 amount) public {
 379 |     |     USDC.transfer(user, amount);
 380 |     |     _addAddressToKYC(kycRequirementGroup, user);
 381 |     |     vm.startPrank(user);
 382 |     |     USDC.approve(address(cashManager), amount);
 383 |     |     cashManager.requestMint(amount);
 384 |     |     vm.stopPrank();
 385 |     |   }

 387 |     |   function claim_mint_user(address user, uint256 epoch) public {
 388 |     |     vm.prank(user);

 390 |     |   }

 392 |     |   function get_predetermined_nav() public returns (uint256) {
 393 |     |     if (cashManager.currentEpoch() - lastEpochSaved > 0) {
 394 |     |       totalDeposits =
 395 |     |         ((10010 * (cashManager.currentEpoch() - lastEpochSaved)) *
 396 |     |           totalDeposits) /
 397 |     |         1e4;
 398 |     |       lastEpochSaved = cashManager.currentEpoch();
 399 |     |       return totalDeposits;
 400 |     |     } else {
 401 |     |       return totalDeposits;
 402 |     |     }
 403 |     |   }

 405 |     |   uint256 private constant ONE = 10 ** 27;
 406 |     | 
 407 |     |   // Copied from https://github.com/makerdao/dss/blob/master/src/jug.sol
 408 |     |   function _rpow(
 409 |     |     uint256 x,
 410 |     |     uint256 n,
 411 |     |     uint256 base
 412 |     |   ) internal pure returns (uint256 z) {
 413 |     |     assembly {
 414 |     |       switch x
 415 |     |       case 0 {
 416 |     |         switch n
 417 |     |         case 0 {
 418 |     |           z := base
 419 |     |         }
 420 |     |         default {
 421 |     |           z := 0
 422 |     |         }
 423 |     |       }
 424 |     |       default {
 425 |     |         switch mod(n, 2)
 426 |     |         case 0 {
 427 |     |           z := base
 428 |     |         }
 429 |     |         default {
 430 |     |           z := x
 431 |     |         }
 432 |     |         let half := div(base, 2) // for rounding.
 433 |     |         for {
 434 |     |           n := div(n, 2)
 435 |     |         } n {
 436 |     |           n := div(n, 2)
 437 |     |         } {
 438 |     |           let xx := mul(x, x)
 439 |     |           if iszero(eq(div(xx, x), x)) {
 440 |     |             revert(0, 0)
 441 |     |           }
 442 |     |           let xxRound := add(xx, half)
 443 |     |           if lt(xxRound, xx) {
 444 |     |             revert(0, 0)
 445 |     |           }
 446 |     |           x := div(xxRound, base)
 447 |     |           if mod(n, 2) {
 448 |     |             let zx := mul(z, x)
 449 |     |             if and(iszero(iszero(x)), iszero(eq(div(zx, x), z))) {
 450 |     |               revert(0, 0)
 451 |     |             }
 452 |     |             let zxRound := add(zx, half)
 453 |     |             if lt(zxRound, zx) {
 454 |     |               revert(0, 0)
 455 |     |             }
 456 |     |             z := div(zxRound, base)
 457 |     |           }
 458 |     |         }
 459 |     |       }
 460 |     |     }
 461 |     |   }
 462 |     | 
 463 |     |   function _rmul(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256 z) {
 464 |     |     z = _mul(x, y) / ONE;
 465 |     |   }
 466 |     | 
 467 |     |   function _mul(uint256 x, uint256 y) internal pure returns (uint256 z) {
 468 |     |     require(y == 0 || (z = x * y) / y == x);
 469 |     |   }
 470 |     | }

/home/user/2023-01-ondo/forge-tests/cash/registry/RegistrySignature.t.sol
   1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: UNLICENSED
   2 |     | pragma solidity 0.8.16;
   3 |     | 
   4 |     | import "forge-tests/cash/BasicDeployment.sol";
   5 |     | import "forge-std/console2.sol";
   6 |     | import "contracts/cash/external/openzeppelin/contracts/utils/cryptography/ECDSA.sol";
   7 |     | 
   8 |     | contract SigUtils {
   9 |     |   bytes32 internal DOMAIN_SEPARATOR;
  10 |     |   bytes32 internal APPROVAL_TYPEHASH;
  11 |     | 
  12 |     |   constructor(bytes32 _DOMAIN_SEPARATOR, bytes32 _APPROVAL_TYPEHASH) {
  13 |     |     DOMAIN_SEPARATOR = _DOMAIN_SEPARATOR;
  14 |     |     APPROVAL_TYPEHASH = _APPROVAL_TYPEHASH;
  15 |     |   }
  16 |     | 
  17 |     |   struct KYCApproval {
  18 |     |     uint256 kycRequirementGroup;
  19 |     |     address user;
  20 |     |     uint256 deadline;
  21 |     |   }
  22 |     | 
  23 |     |   // Computes the hash of a KYCApproval
  24 |     |   function getStructHash(
  25 |     |     KYCApproval memory _approval
  26 |     |   ) internal view returns (bytes32) {
  27 |     |     return
  28 |     |       keccak256(
  29 |     |         abi.encode(
  30 |     |           APPROVAL_TYPEHASH,
  31 |     |           _approval.kycRequirementGroup,
  32 |     |           _approval.user,
  33 |     |           _approval.deadline
  34 |     |         )
  35 |     |       );
  36 |     |   }
  37 |     | 
  38 |     |   function getTypedDataHash(
  39 |     |     KYCApproval memory _approval
  40 |     |   ) public view returns (bytes32) {
  41 |     |     return
  42 |     |       keccak256(
  43 |     |         abi.encodePacked("\x19\x01", DOMAIN_SEPARATOR, getStructHash(_approval))
  44 |     |       );
  45 |     |   }
  46 |     | }
  47 |     | 
  48 |     | contract TestKYCRegistry is BasicDeployment {
  49 |     |   address verifyingContract = address(registry);
  50 |     |   SigUtils internal sigUtils;
  51 |     |   uint256 internal signerPrivateKey;
  52 |     |   address internal signer;
  53 |     |   bytes32 public constant KYC_GROUP_1_ROLE = keccak256("KYC_GROUP_1_ROLE");
  54 |     | 
  55 |     |   address user1 = address(0x5);
  56 |     |   address user2 = address(0x6);
  57 |     |   uint256 deadline = 500;
  58 |     | 
  59 |     |   uint8 v;
  60 |     |   bytes32 r;
  61 |     |   bytes32 s;
  62 |     | 
  63 |     |   function setUp() public {
  64 |     |     deployKYCRegistry();
  65 |     |     sigUtils = new SigUtils(
  66 |     |       registry.DOMAIN_SEPARATOR(),
  67 |     |       registry._APPROVAL_TYPEHASH()
  68 |     |     );
  69 |     |     signerPrivateKey = 0xB0B;
  70 |     |     signer = vm.addr(signerPrivateKey);
  71 |     |     vm.startPrank(registryAdmin);
  72 |     |     registry.assignRoletoKYCGroup(1, KYC_GROUP_1_ROLE);
  73 |     |     // Signer can sign transactions that modify kyc requirement group 1.
  74 |     |     registry.grantRole(KYC_GROUP_1_ROLE, signer);
  75 |     |     vm.stopPrank();
  76 |     |     vm.warp(deadline - 1);
  77 |     | 
  78 |     |     // Create signature under test
  79 |     |     SigUtils.KYCApproval memory approval = SigUtils.KYCApproval({
  80 |     |       kycRequirementGroup: 1,
  81 |     |       user: user1,
  82 |     |       deadline: deadline
  83 |     |     });
  84 |     |     // EIP 712
  85 |     |     bytes32 digest = sigUtils.getTypedDataHash(approval);
  86 |     |     (uint8 _v, bytes32 _r, bytes32 _s) = vm.sign(signerPrivateKey, digest);
  87 |     |     v = _v;
  88 |     |     r = _r;
  89 |     |     s = _s;
  90 |     |   }
  91 |     | 
  92 |     |   function test_signature_add_happy_case() public {
  93 |     |     vm.expectEmit(true, true, true, true);
  94 |     |     emit KYCAddressAddViaSignature(address(this), user1, signer, 1, deadline);
  95 |     |     registry.addKYCAddressViaSignature(1, user1, deadline, v, r, s);
  96 |     |     assertEq(registry.getKYCStatus(1, user1), true);
  97 |     |   }
  98 |     | 
  99 |     |   function test_signature_add_fail_because_noop() public {
 100 |     |     registry.addKYCAddressViaSignature(1, user1, deadline, v, r, s);
 101 |     |     assertEq(registry.getKYCStatus(1, user1), true);
 102 |     |     // Revert rather than perform no-op operation.
 103 |     |     vm.expectRevert("KYCRegistry: user already verified");
 104 |     |     registry.addKYCAddressViaSignature(1, user1, deadline, v, r, s);
 105 |     |     assertEq(registry.getKYCStatus(1, user1), true);
 106 |     |   }
 107 |     | 
 108 |     |   function test_signature_add_fail_expiry() public {
 109 |     |     // Change Block.timestamp to be > deadline
 110 |     |     vm.warp(501);
 111 |     |     vm.expectRevert("KYCRegistry: signature expired");
 112 |     |     registry.addKYCAddressViaSignature(1, user1, deadline, v, r, s);
 113 |     |     assertEq(registry.getKYCStatus(1, user1), false);
 114 |     |   }
 115 |     | 
 116 |     |   function test_signature_add_fail_bad_v() public {
 117 |     |     vm.expectRevert("KYCRegistry: invalid v value in signature");
 118 |     |     registry.addKYCAddressViaSignature(1, user1, deadline, 29, r, s);
 119 |     |     vm.expectRevert("KYCRegistry: invalid v value in signature");
 120 |     |     registry.addKYCAddressViaSignature(1, user1, deadline, 26, r, s);
 121 |     |     assertEq(registry.getKYCStatus(1, user1), false);
 122 |     |   }
 123 |     | 
 124 |     |   function test_signature_add_group_mismatch() public {
 125 |     |     SigUtils.KYCApproval memory approval = SigUtils.KYCApproval({
 126 |     |       kycRequirementGroup: 2, // Group 2 instead of 1
 127 |     |       user: user1,
 128 |     |       deadline: deadline
 129 |     |     });
 130 |     |     bytes32 digest = sigUtils.getTypedDataHash(approval);
 131 |     |     (uint8 _v, bytes32 _r, bytes32 _s) = vm.sign(signerPrivateKey, digest);
 132 |     |     // Will revert based on "access control"
 133 |     |     // because the groups mismatch in the computed hashes
 134 |     |     // causing ecrecover to resolve to an incorrect address (0x62...);
 135 |     |     vm.expectRevert(
 136 |     |       _formatACRevert(
 137 |     |         address(0xA04476a7Ed0401D81d0192c22EE55B7b59c1EE6a),
 138 |     |         KYC_GROUP_1_ROLE
 139 |     |       )
 140 |     |     );
 141 |     |     registry.addKYCAddressViaSignature(1, user1, deadline, _v, _r, _s);
 142 |     |   }
 143 |     | 
 144 |     |   function test_signature_add_fail_access_control() public {
 145 |     |     SigUtils.KYCApproval memory approval = SigUtils.KYCApproval({
 146 |     |       kycRequirementGroup: 2, // Group 2 instead of 1
 147 |     |       user: user1,
 148 |     |       deadline: deadline
 149 |     |     });
 150 |     |     bytes32 digest = sigUtils.getTypedDataHash(approval);
 151 |     |     (uint8 _v, bytes32 _r, bytes32 _s) = vm.sign(signerPrivateKey, digest);
 152 |     | 
 153 |     |     // Signature is correct, but signer doesn't have access to add to kyc
 154 |     |     // requirement group 2.
 155 |     |     vm.expectRevert(_formatACRevert(signer, KYC_GROUP_2_ROLE));
 156 |     |     registry.addKYCAddressViaSignature(2, user1, deadline, _v, _r, _s);
 157 |     |   }
 158 |     | 
 159 |     |   function test_signature_add_fail_bad_user() public {
 160 |     |     // Will revert based on "access control"
 161 |     |     // because the users mismatch in the computed hashes
 162 |     |     // causing ecrecover to resolve to an incorrect address
 163 |     |     vm.expectRevert(
 164 |     |       _formatACRevert(

 167 |     |       )
 168 |     |     );
 169 |     |     // User 2 instead of user 1
 170 |     |     registry.addKYCAddressViaSignature(1, user2, deadline, v, r, s);
 171 |     |   }

 181 |     |       )
 182 |     |     );
 183 |     |     // Deadline is different than what is hashed and signed.

 11 |     | contract TestCashFactory is DSTestPlus {

 13 |     |   CashFactory cashFactory;
 14 |     | 
 15 |     |   bytes32 public constant MINTER_ROLE = keccak256("MINTER_ROLE");
 16 |     |   bytes32 public constant PAUSER_ROLE = keccak256("PAUSER_ROLE");
 17 |     |   bytes32 public constant DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE = bytes32(0);
 18 |     |   bytes32 public constant TRANSFER_ROLE = keccak256("TRANSFER_ROLE");
 19 |     |

 25 |     |   event CashDeployed(
 26 |     |     address proxy,
 27 |     |     address proxyAdmin,
 28 |     |     address implementation,
 29 |     |     string name,
 30 |     |     string ticker
 31 |     |   );

 35 |     |     cashFactory.deployCash("Cash", "CASH");
 36 |     |   }

 38 |     |   function test_cash_factory_deploy() public {
 39 |     |     vm.prank(address(guardian));
 40 |     |     vm.expectEmit(true, true, true, false);
 41 |     |     emit CashDeployed(address(0x0), address(0x0), address(0x0), "Cash", "CASH");
 42 |     |     (address proxy, address admin, address impl) = cashFactory.deployCash(
 43 |     |       "Cash",
 44 |     |       "CASH"
 45 |     |     );
 46 |     | 
 47 |     |     Cash cash = Cash(proxy);
 48 |     |     ProxyAdmin proxyAdmin = ProxyAdmin(admin);
 49 |     |     // Guardian owns proxy admin.
 50 |     |     assertEq(proxyAdmin.owner(), address(guardian));
 51 |     | 
 52 |     |     // Assert cash proxy has correct admin and impl.
 53 |     |     vm.startPrank(admin);
 54 |     |     TokenProxy iProxy = TokenProxy(payable(proxy));
 55 |     |     assertEq(iProxy.admin(), admin);
 56 |     |     assertEq(iProxy.implementation(), impl);
 57 |     |     vm.stopPrank();
 58 |     | 
 59 |     |     assertEq(cash.totalSupply(), 0);
 60 |     | 
 61 |     |     assertEq(cash.getRoleAdmin(TRANSFER_ROLE), DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
 62 |     |     assertEq(cash.getRoleAdmin(MINTER_ROLE), DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
 63 |     |     assertEq(cash.getRoleAdmin(PAUSER_ROLE), DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE);
 64 |     | 
 65 |     |     assertEq(cash.getRoleMemberCount(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE), 1);
 66 |     |     assertEq(cash.getRoleMemberCount(PAUSER_ROLE), 1);
 67 |     |     assertEq(cash.getRoleMember(PAUSER_ROLE, 0), address(guardian));
 68 |     |     assertEq(cash.getRoleMember(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, 0), address(guardian));
 69 |     | 
 70 |     |     // Minter and transfer role must be granted at a later stage.
 71 |     |     assertEq(cash.getRoleMemberCount(MINTER_ROLE), 0);
 72 |     |     assertEq(cash.getRoleMemberCount(TRANSFER_ROLE), 0);
 73 |     |   }

 184 |     |   function getSupplyRateCheck(
 185 |     |     uint256 util,
 186 |     |     uint256 borrowRate,
 187 |     |     uint256 reserveFactor
 188 |     |   ) public returns (uint256) {
 189 |     |     uint256 oneMinusReserve = 1e18 - reserveFactor;
 190 |     |     uint256 result = (util * ((borrowRate * oneMinusReserve) / 1e18)) / 1e18;
 191 |     |     return result;
 192 |     |   }

 219 |     |   // Seed Lending Pool Utils
 220 |     |   function seedLendingPool(address fToken) public {
 221 |     |     if (fToken == address(fDAI)) {
 222 |     |       seedDAILendingPool();
 223 |     |     } else if (fToken == address(fUSDC)) {
 224 |     |       seedUSDCLendingPool();
 225 |     |     } else if (fToken == address(fFRAX)) {
 226 |     |       seedFRAXLendingPool();
 227 |     |     } else if (fToken == address(fLUSD)) {
 228 |     |       seedLUSDLendingPool();
 229 |     |     } else if (fToken == address(fUSDT)) {
 230 |     |       seedUSDTLendingPool();
 231 |     |     }
 232 |     |   }
 233 |     |

 235 |     |     vm.startPrank(USDT_WHALE);

 266 |     |     vm.stopPrank();
 267 |     |   }
 268 |     | 
 269 |     |   // Lending Market Utils
 270 |     |   function getExpectedUtilizationRate(
 271 |     |     uint256 borrows,
 272 |     |     uint256 cash,
 273 |     |     uint256 reserves
 274 |     |   ) public pure returns (uint256) {
 275 |     |     return (borrows * 1e18) / (cash + borrows - reserves);
 276 |     |   }
 277 |     | 
 278 |     |   function getExpectedBorrowRate(
 279 |     |     uint256 util,
 280 |     |     uint256 kink,
 281 |     |     uint256 blockMultiplier,
 282 |     |     uint256 jumpBlockMultiplier,
 283 |     |     uint256 baseRatePerBlock
 284 |     |   ) public pure returns (uint256 result) {
 285 |     |     if (util <= kink) {
 286 |     |       result = ((util * blockMultiplier) / 1e18) + baseRatePerBlock;
 287 |     |     } else if (util > kink) {
 288 |     |       result =
 289 |     |         (((util - kink) * jumpBlockMultiplier) / 1e18) +
 290 |     |         ((util * blockMultiplier) / 1e18) +
 291 |     |         baseRatePerBlock;
 292 |     |     }
 293 |     |   }
 294 |     | 
 295 |     |   function getBorrowedAmount(
 296 |     |     uint256 initial,
 297 |     |     uint256 rate,
 298 |     |     uint256 blocksPassed
 299 |     |   ) public pure returns (uint256) {
 300 |     |     return initial + (((rate * blocksPassed) * initial) / 1e18);
 301 |     |   }
 302 |     | 
 303 |     |   function getSupplyAmount(
 304 |     |     uint256 initial,
 305 |     |     uint256 rate,
 306 |     |     uint256 blocksPassed
 307 |     |   ) public pure returns (uint256) {
 308 |     |     return initial + ((initial * (rate * blocksPassed)) / 1e18);
 309 |     |   }
 310 |     | 
 311 |     |   function _expectFail(
 312 |     |     ComptrollerErrorReporter.Error err,
 313 |     |     ComptrollerErrorReporter.FailureInfo info
 314 |     |   ) internal {
 315 |     |     vm.expectEmit(true, true, true, true);
 316 |     |     emit Failure(uint256(err), uint256(info), 0);
 317 |     |   }
 318 |     | 
 319 |     |   event Failure(uint error, uint info, uint detail);
 320 |     | }

   9 |     |   function setUp() public override {
  10 |     |     super.setUp();
  11 |     |     oComptroller._setCollateralFactor(address(fDAI), 75 * 1e16);
  12 |     |   }
  13 |     | 
  14 |     |   function test_getHypotheticalAccountLiquidity_market_not_entered() public {
  15 |     |     (, uint256 accountLiquidity, uint256 shortFall) = oComptroller
  16 |     |       .getHypotheticalAccountLiquidity(charlie, address(fDAI), 1000e18, 500e18);
  17 |     |     assertEq(0, accountLiquidity);
  18 |     |     assertEq(0, shortFall);
  19 |     |   }
  20 |     | 
  21 |     |   function test_supplyRatePerBlock_on_init_fDAI() public {
  22 |     |     enterMarkets(charlie, address(fDAI), 100e18);
  23 |     |     uint256 supplyRateUSDC = fDAI.supplyRatePerBlock();
  24 |     |     assertEq(supplyRateUSDC, 0);
  25 |     |   }
  26 |     | 
  27 |     |   function test_supplyRatePerBlock_on_init_fCASH() public {
  28 |     |     enterMarkets(charlie, address(fCASH), 100e18);
  29 |     |     uint256 supplyRateCash = fCASH.supplyRatePerBlock();
  30 |     |     assertEq(supplyRateCash, 0);
  31 |     |   }
  32 |     | 
  33 |     |   function test_getAccountLiquidity_market_not_entered() public {
  34 |     |     (, uint256 liquidity, uint256 shortfall) = oComptroller.getAccountLiquidity(
  35 |     |       charlie
  36 |     |     );
  37 |     |     assertEq(liquidity, 0);
  38 |     |     assertEq(shortfall, 0);
  39 |     |   }
  40 |     | 
  41 |     |   function test_supplyRatePerBlock_withBorrows_dai() public {
  42 |     |     _addAddressToKYC(kycRequirementGroup, charlie);
  43 |     |     enterMarkets(charlie, address(fDAI), 1000e18);
  44 |     |     vm.prank(charlie);
  45 |     |     fDAI.borrow(500e18);
  46 |     |     uint256 daiBorrowed = DAI.balanceOf(charlie);
  47 |     |     assertEq(daiBorrowed, 500e18);
  48 |     |     uint256 supplyRateUsdc = fDAI.supplyRatePerBlock();
  49 |     |     assertGt(supplyRateUsdc, 0);
  50 |     |   }
  51 |     | 
  52 |     |   function test_fuzz_total_account_liquidity_after_supplying_amount(
  53 |     |     uint256 amount
  54 |     |   ) public {
  55 |     |     vm.assume(amount <= DAI.balanceOf(DAI_WHALE) - 1e18);
  56 |     |     amount += 1e18; // Avoid very small amounts
  57 |     |     enterMarkets(charlie, address(fDAI), amount);
  58 |     | 
  59 |     |     uint256 scaledLiquidity = _getScaledLiquidity(address(fDAI), amount);
  60 |     |     (, uint256 liquidity, ) = oComptroller.getAccountLiquidity(charlie);
  61 |     |     assertAlmostEq(scaledLiquidity, liquidity, 5);
  62 |     |   }
  63 |     | 
  64 |     |   function test_fuzz_borrow_mint_amount_should_shortfall(
  65 |     |     uint256 amount
  66 |     |   ) public {
  67 |     |     test_fuzz_total_account_liquidity_after_supplying_amount(amount);
  68 |     |     amount += 1e18;
  69 |     |     (, uint256 liquidity, uint256 shortfall) = oComptroller
  70 |     |       .getHypotheticalAccountLiquidity(charlie, address(fDAI), 0, amount);
  71 |     | 
  72 |     |     (, uint256 collateralFactor) = oComptroller.markets(address(fDAI));
  73 |     |     uint256 scaledLiqidity = _getScaledLiquidity(address(fDAI), amount);
  74 |     | 
  75 |     |     // CollateralFactor = 75e18, which gives us 25e18 in leftover liquidity
  76 |     |     // 75e18/(1e18 - 75e18) = 3 (3x the amount of leftover)
  77 |     |     // NOTE: Math below only works if collateralFactor > 50%
  78 |     |     uint256 liquidityDivisor = collateralFactor / (1e18 - collateralFactor);
  79 |     |     uint256 scaledShortfall = scaledLiqidity / liquidityDivisor;
  80 |     |     assertEq(liquidity, 0);
  81 |     |     assertAlmostEq(shortfall, scaledShortfall, 5);
  82 |     |   }
  83 |     | 
  84 |     |   function test_fuzz_redeem_total_liquidity_should_be_0(uint256 amount) public {
  85 |     |     test_fuzz_total_account_liquidity_after_supplying_amount(amount);
  86 |     |     (, uint256 liquidity, uint256 shortfall) = oComptroller
  87 |     |       .getHypotheticalAccountLiquidity(
  88 |     |         charlie,
  89 |     |         address(fDAI),
  90 |     |         fDAI.balanceOf(charlie),
  91 |     |         0
  92 |     |       );
  93 |     |     assertEq(liquidity, 0);
  94 |     |     assertEq(shortfall, 0);
  95 |     |   }
  96 |     | 
  97 |     |   /// @dev Assumed 18 decimals underlying
  98 |     |   function _getScaledLiquidity(
  99 |     |     address oToken,
 100 |     |     uint256 amount
 101 |     |   ) internal returns (uint256) {
 102 |     |     uint256 price = ondoOracle.getUnderlyingPrice(oToken);
 103 |     |     (, uint256 collateralFactor) = oComptroller.markets(oToken);
 104 |     |     uint256 scaledLiquidityWithCF = (amount * collateralFactor) / 1e18;
 105 |     |     uint256 scaledLiquidityWithPrice = (scaledLiquidityWithCF * price) / 1e18;
 106 |     |     return scaledLiquidityWithPrice;
 107 |     |   }
 108 |     | }

  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0
  2 |     | pragma solidity ^0.8.0;
  3 |     | 
  4 |     | import {Setup} from "./Setup.sol";
  5 |     | import {SelectorStorage} from "./SelectorStorage.sol";
  6 |     | 
  7 |     | // ghost variables for tracking state variable values before and after function calls
  8 |     | abstract contract BeforeAfter is Setup {
  9 |     | 
 10 |     |    // Tracks which function selector is currently executing
 11 |     |     // Using bytes4 selector instead of enum to avoid 256 member limit
 12 | *   |     bytes4 public currentOperation;
 13 |     | 
 14 |     |     struct Vars {
 15 |     |         uint256 __ignore__;
 16 |     |     }
 17 |     | 
 18 |     |     Vars internal _before;
 19 |     |     Vars internal _after;
 20 |     | 
 21 |     |     modifier updateGhosts {
 22 |     |         __before();
 23 |     |         _;
 24 |     |         __after();
 25 |     |     }
 26 |     | 
 27 |     | 
 28 |     |   // Sets currentOperation to the function selector before execution
 29 |     |     modifier trackOp(bytes4 op) {
 30 | *   |         currentOperation = op;
 31 |     |         __before();
 32 |     |         _;
 33 | *   |         __after();
 34 |     |     }
 35 |     | 
 36 |     |     function __before() internal {
 37 |     | 
 38 |     |     }
 39 |     | 
 40 |     |     function __after() internal {
 41 |     | 
 42 |     |     }
 43 |     | }

/home/user/2023-01-ondo/lib/chimera/src/CryticAsserts.sol
  1 |     | // SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
  2 |     | pragma solidity ^0.8.0;
  3 |     | 
  4 |     | import {Asserts} from "./Asserts.sol";
  5 |     | 
  6 |     | contract CryticAsserts is Asserts {
  7 |     |     event Log(string);
  8 |     | 
  9 |     |     function gt(uint256 a, uint256 b, string memory reason) internal virtual override {
 10 |     |         if (!(a > b)) {
 11 |     |             emit Log(reason);
 12 |     |             assert(false);
 13 |     |         }
 14 |     |     }
 15 |     | 
 16 |     |     function gte(uint256 a, uint256 b, string memory reason) internal virtual override {
 17 |     |         if (!(a >= b)) {
 18 |     |             emit Log(reason);
 19 |     |             assert(false);
 20 |     |         }
 21 |     |     }
 22 |     | 
 23 |     |     function lt(uint256 a, uint256 b, string memory reason) internal virtual override {
 24 |     |         if (!(a < b)) {
 25 |     |             emit Log(reason);
 26 |     |             assert(false);
 27 |     |         }
 28 |     |     }
 29 |     | 
 30 |     |     function lte(uint256 a, uint256 b, string memory reason) internal virtual override {
 31 |     |         if (!(a <= b)) {
 32 |     |             emit Log(reason);
 33 |     |             assert(false);
 34 |     |         }
 35 |     |     }
 36 |     | 
 37 |     |     function eq(uint256 a, uint256 b, string memory reason) internal virtual override {
 38 |     |         if (!(a == b)) {
 39 |     |             emit Log(reason);
 40 |     |             assert(false);
 41 |     |         }
 42 |     |     }
 43 |     | 
 44 |     |     function t(bool b, string memory reason) internal virtual override {
 45 |     |         if (!b) {
 46 |     |             emit Log(reason);
 47 |     |             assert(false);
 48 |     |         }
 49 |     |     }
 50 |     | 
 51 |     |     function between(uint256 value, uint256 low, uint256 high) internal virtual override returns (uint256) {
 52 |     |         if (value < low || value > high) {
 53 |     |             uint256 ans = low + (value % (high - low + 1));
 54 |     |             return ans;
 55 |     |         }
 56 |     |         return value;
 57 |     |     }
 58 |     | 
 59 |     |     function between(int256 value, int256 low, int256 high) internal virtual override returns (int256) {
 60 |     |         if (value < low || value > high) {
 61 |     |             int256 range = high - low + 1;
 62 |     |             int256 clamped = (value - low) % (range);
 63 |     |             if (clamped < 0) clamped += range;
 64 |     |             int256 ans = low + clamped;
 65 |     |             return ans;
 66 |     |         }
 67 |     |         return value;
 68 |     |     }
 69 |     | 
 70 |     |     function precondition(bool p) internal virtual override {
 71 |     |         require(p);
 72 |     |     }
 73 |     | }
 74 |     |

 33 |     |         if (value < low || value > high) {
 34 |     |             uint256 ans = low + (value % (high - low + 1));
 35 |     |             return ans;
 36 |     |         }
 37 |     |         return value;
 38 |     |     }
 39 |     | 
 40 |     |     function between(int256 value, int256 low, int256 high) internal virtual override returns (int256) {
 41 |     |         if (value < low || value > high) {
 42 |     |             int256 range = high - low + 1;
 43 |     |             int256 clamped = (value - low) % (range);
 44 |     |             if (clamped < 0) clamped += range;
 45 |     |             int256 ans = low + clamped;
 46 |     |             return ans;
 47 |     |         }
 48 |     |         return value;
 49 |     |     }
 50 |     | 
 51 |     |     function precondition(bool p) internal virtual override {
 52 |     |         vm.assume(p);
 53 |     |     }
 54 |     | }

 448 |     |                     ok = false;
 449 |     |                 }
 450 |     |             }
 451 |     |         } else {
 452 |     |             ok = false;
 453 |     |         }
 454 |     |     }

 456 |     |         if (!checkEq0(a, b)) {
 457 |     |             emit log("Error: a == b not satisfied [bytes]");
 458 |     |             emit log_named_bytes("  Expected", b);

 152 |     |         uint256 maxPercentDelta // An 18 decimal fixed point number, where 1e18 == 100%
 153 |     |     ) internal virtual {

 163 |     |             emit log_named_decimal_uint("     % Delta", percentDelta, 18);
 164 |     |             fail();
 165 |     |         }
 166 |     |     }

 13 |     |         string name;
 14 |     |         // The chain's Chain ID.
 15 |     |         uint256 chainId;
 16 |     |         // A default RPC endpoint for this chain.
 17 |     |         // NOTE: This default RPC URL is included for convenience to facilitate quick tests and
 18 |     |         // experimentation. Do not use this RPC URL for production test suites, CI, or other heavy
 19 |     |         // usage as you will be throttled and this is a disservice to others who need this endpoint.
 20 |     |         string rpcUrl;
 21 |     |     }
 22 |     | 
 23 |     |     bool private initialized;
 24 |     | 
 25 |     |     // Maps from a chain's key (matching the alias in the `foundry.toml` file) to chain data.
 26 |     |     mapping(string => Chain) private chains;
 27 |     |     // Maps from a chain ID to that chain's key name
 28 |     |     mapping(uint256 => string) private idToKey;
 29 |     | 
 30 |     |     function getChain(string memory key) internal virtual returns (Chain memory) {
 31 |     |         initialize();
 32 |     |         return chains[key];
 33 |     |     }
 34 |     |
